patterns.name: 部门属性补充
keyConditions: 200030: REF_BOOK按当日快照取账簿ID与部门，最终LEFT JOIN到风险结果并直接输出部门；未看到后续部门过滤或计算。
200078: REF_BOOK按当日快照取账簿ID与部门，最终LEFT JOIN到风险结果并直接输出部门；未看到后续部门过滤或计算。
215700: 构造REF_BOOK后左连接风险结果，通过NVL(账簿部门, 原风险部门)写出部门；账簿未匹配时使用原部门回退。
patterns.distinction: 账簿ID连接后输出部门；200078/200030无回退，215700以原风险部门回退
patterns.groupingLevel: 同主题不同规则（回退差异）

patterns.name: OTC账簿资格闸门
keyConditions: 114782: 在互换净值、期权净值两个任务内临时分支中，以账簿ID+修饰符内连接，仅保留当日、OTC部门账簿；合格分支随后并入客户账户总资产并按客户汇总。
184662: 在互换净值、期权净值两个临时分支中，以账簿ID+修饰符内连接筛选当日OTC账簿；分支进入账户级临时表，并继续汇总到账户、ECIF、UID三个写入。
patterns.distinction: 账簿ID+修饰符内连接，限定当日OTC部门；不直接输出账簿字段
patterns.groupingLevel: 局部规则一致（限定两类资产分支）

patterns.name: GFS_FICC账簿范围
keyConditions: 209894: 三个互换名义本金窗口和一个期权名义本金分支分别内连接当日GFS_FICC账簿，再按合约、账簿、状态等维度汇总规模。
221300: 互换、期权两个分支均沿交易到账簿关系，以账簿ID内连接当日GFS_FICC账簿，只让固收账簿对应合约进入指标使用情况统计。
243918: 目标表自身的GFS_FICC、来源和业务日期过滤定义固收账簿范围。
patterns.distinction: 按当日账簿和Bel_Dept=GFS_FICC限制合约/指标范围
patterns.groupingLevel: 局部规则一致（范围相同，输出作用不同）

patterns.name: 双别名账簿角色
keyConditions: 234256: 同一任务两次引用：rb以账簿ID内连接当前账簿资格；bb中的第二个别名以账簿ID连接名称，并用生效/到期日筛选后输出Bel_Dept。
patterns.distinction: 一个别名校验账簿存在，另一个带有效期并补部门

patterns.name: 账簿属性驱动分类
keyConditions: 176610: 三个互换事件分支分别内连接当日OTC或GFS_FICC账簿，并把Bel_Dept通过CASE映射为系统名称‘股衍/固收’。
241773: 期权分支左连接账簿取Cntr参与北上QIS分类；互换分支内连接账簿取Bel_Dept/Bel_Co参与OTC_HK、GFS_HK等合约标签CASE。
patterns.distinction: Bel_Dept/Bel_Co/Cntr进入CASE或标签分类；连接类型决定缺匹配是否留存
patterns.groupingLevel: 同主题不同规则（字段与连接类型不同）

patterns.name: 报送资格控制
keyConditions: 143830: 履保映射分支沿交易到账簿关系内连接当日账簿，并在WHERE要求Rep_Risk_Flag=1，限定进入风险合约与保证金账户映射的账簿。
171179: 直接读取目标表的两个互换分支都以账簿ID内连接Rep_Fin_Flag=1的当日账簿，同时输出Bel_Dept；其他文本命中是T98表的src_tbl常量，不是再次读取目标物理表。
patterns.distinction: Rep_Fin_Flag或Rep_Risk_Flag参与范围过滤，标志不可互换
patterns.groupingLevel: 同主题不同规则（标志不可互换）

patterns.name: 账簿维表投影
keyConditions: 134167: 以GFS_HK账簿快照为驱动，输出账簿公司、部门、柜台和各类开关；若干0/1开关通过CASE转成Y/N，并内连接有效账簿名称。
145871: 以当日D_REF_BOOK快照为驱动，直接透传柜台、部门、公司及各类开关，再左连接协议、名称和持有人名称，生成T98账簿信息。
243918: 账簿字段的输出绑定、名称/主体连接和柜台代码解释构成维表投影。
patterns.distinction: 以目标表为驱动，输出账簿属性和开关，再补名称/主体/代码描述
patterns.groupingLevel: 同主题不同规则（范围与转换不同）

patterns.name: 香港公司账簿范围
keyConditions: 234175: 期权通用信息先连接子交易，再按Book_Agt_Id内连接当日Bel_Co=GFS_HK账簿，仅保留香港公司账簿关联的标的信息。

patterns.name: 原账簿到目标账簿重映射
keyConditions: 107018: 多次引用目标表验证映射后的目标账簿存在；主分支又按账簿ID+修饰符连接，输出Bel_Dept。合约可按合约号、交易对手或默认规则从原账簿重映射到目标账簿。
209119: 三个映射分支以目标账簿Book_Agt_Id做存在性校验；首分支只有业务日期条件，另两支还有src_tbl条件。
patterns.distinction: 依据规则表/关系表形成目标账簿并由目标表验证存在
patterns.groupingLevel: 同主题不同规则（规则来源与输出不同）

patterns.name: 部门条件加硬编码例外
keyConditions: 138186: 按账簿ID内连接当日账簿，WHERE采用‘Bel_Dept=ED 或指定合约/标的白名单’的复合条件控制权益TRS标的输出范围。
patterns.distinction: ED部门或合约/标的白名单，OR分支不可被归一化掉

patterns.name: 动态对冲收益映射与汇总
keyConditions: 230202: 只保留Cntr=DYNAMIC_HEDGING账簿，按账簿ID内连接持仓；Map_Undrl_Cd空时回退证券分类，按映射标的×业务日期汇总Tdy_Yield，并把聚合收益接入创收公式。
patterns.distinction: 账簿提供动态对冲范围及映射/分组依据；收益数值来自持仓

patterns.name: 创收常速互换范围
keyConditions: 243650: 常速互换标签分支按账簿ID内连接当日账簿，并在WHERE要求Bel_Dept=OTC；再叠加合约状态、日期和非内部互换条件形成创收合约范围。
patterns.distinction: OTC账簿条件与状态、日期、非内部互换条件共同限定一个UNION分支

patterns.name: 原/目标账簿属性并列输出
keyConditions: 209119: 主查询的rb_ori/rb角色分别提供Map_Undrl_Cd以及Bel_Dept/Cntr，并绑定到目标输出字段。
patterns.distinction: 原账簿提供映射标的，目标账簿提供部门和柜台

FROM (select * from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_INFO where busi_date='2026-05-23'  and src_tbl='ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_TRS' ) RT --REF_TRS
JOIN (select * from pdata_n.T03_AGT_STATI_INFO_H where strt_date<='2026-05-23'  and end_date>'2026-05-23'  and Agt_Stati_Info_Type_Cd='09' AND SRC_TBL='ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE' ) TT
ON RT.Swap_Comp_Agt_Id  = TT.Agt_Id
AND RT.Swap_Comp_Agt_Modifr=TT.Agt_Modifr
JOIN (select * from PDATA_N.T03_AGT_CLAS_H where strt_date<='2026-05-23'  and end_date>'2026-05-23'  and Agt_Clas_Type_Cd='05' AND SRC_TBL='ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE') TOT
ON TT.Agt_Id  = TOT.Agt_Id
AND TT.Agt_Modifr=TOT.Agt_Modifr
JOIN (select * from pdata_n.T03_AGT_RELA_H where strt_date<='2026-05-23'  and end_date>'2026-05-23'  and Agt_Rela_Type_Cd='N03' AND SRC_TBL='ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE' ) TOT1
ON TT.Agt_Id  = TOT1.Agt_Id
AND TT.Agt_Modifr=TOT1.Agt_Modifr
JOIN (select * from PDATA_N.T03_AGT_NAME_H WHERE strt_date<='2026-05-23'  and end_date>'2026-05-23'  AND SRC_TBL='ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK')RB
on TOT1.Rela_Agt_Id =RB.Agt_Id
AND TOT1.Rela_Agt_Modifr=RB.Agt_Modifr

ON TOT1.Rela_Agt_Id =RB1.Book_Agt_Id
AND TOT1.Rela_Agt_Modifr=RB1.Book_Agt_Modifr

ON RT.Swap_Comp_Agt_Id  = RTL.Swap_Comp_Agt_Id
AND  RT.Swap_Comp_Agt_Modifr  = RTL.Swap_Comp_Agt_Modifr
AND RTL.Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'STRUCTURE_LEG_TYPE'
JOIN (select * from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_HOLD_INFO a
where src_tbl='ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_TRS_LEG_HIS_POS'
and exists (select 1 from D_POS_TRS_LEG_HIS_POS_TEMP b where a.busi_date=b.busi_date)  --取得当前有更新的日期更新
) HP
ON RTL.Leg_Glbl_Seq_No  = HP.Leg_Glbl_Seq_No
JOIN  (select * from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info  WHERE src_id='TIT' and grp_id = '01') RI
ON HP.Prd_Id = RI.src_sys_prdno
LEFT JOIN pdata_news_n.t02_fxr_cfets_quot RRM
ON  HP.BUSI_DATE =default.datekey2date(RRM.trd_dt )
AND RT.Crrc_Cd = RRM.src_crrc_cd
and RRM.src_id='TIT'
and RRM.grp_id = '01'
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM PDATA_NEWS_N.t02_fut_base_info  WHERE src_id='TIT' AND grp_id = '01' )  FP
ON  RI.scr_type = 'FUT'
AND  RI.src_sys_prdno  = FP.src_sys_prdno
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM PDATA_NEWS_N.T02_PUB_CST_INFO  WHERE  const_type_cd='var00001')  PS
ON   FP.Futr_Type_Cd=PS.CONST_CD
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM PDATA_N.T01_PTY_NAME  WHERE  SRC_TBL='ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_COUNTER_PARTY' AND BUSI_DATE='2026-05-23')  CFN
ON   RT.Cutp_Pty_Id=CFN.pty_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM PDATA_N.T01_PTY_CUTP  WHERE  SRC_TBL='ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_COUNTER_PARTY' AND BUSI_DATE='2026-05-23')  CLE
ON   CFN.pty_id=CLE.pty_id
WHERE RT.Comp_Stat_Cd NOT IN ('230','254','253','218','255')

JOIN (select * from pdata_n.T03_AGT_STATI_INFO_H where strt_date<='2026-05-23'   and end_date>'2026-05-23'   and Agt_Stati_Info_Type_Cd='09' and src_tbl='ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE' ) TT
ON RT.Swap_Comp_Agt_Id  = TT.Agt_Id
AND RT.Swap_Comp_Agt_Modifr=TT.Agt_Modifr
JOIN (select * from PDATA_N.T03_AGT_CLAS_H where strt_date<='2026-05-23'   and end_date>'2026-05-23'   and Agt_Clas_Type_Cd='05' and src_tbl='ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE' ) TOT
ON TT.Agt_Id  = TOT.Agt_Id
AND TT.Agt_Modifr=TOT.Agt_Modifr
JOIN (select * from pdata_n.T03_AGT_RELA_H where strt_date<='2026-05-23'   and end_date>'2026-05-23'   and Agt_Rela_Type_Cd='N03' and src_tbl='ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE' ) TOT1
ON TT.Agt_Id  = TOT1.Agt_Id
AND TT.Agt_Modifr=TOT1.Agt_Modifr
JOIN MAPPING MP
ON TOT.Agt_Id = MP.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID
AND TOT1.Rela_Agt_Id= MP.KEY_BOOK_ID_FROM
JOIN (select * from PDATA_N.T03_AGT_NAME_H WHERE strt_date<='2026-05-23'   and end_date>'2026-05-23'   AND SRC_TBL='ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK')RB
ON MP.KEY_BOOK_ID_TO =RB.Agt_Id
JOIN (select * from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_ADTNL_INFO where busi_date='2026-05-23' AND SRC_TBL='ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK' )RB1
ON MP.KEY_BOOK_ID_TO =RB1.Book_Agt_Id
JOIN (select * from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_LEG_INFO where busi_date='2026-05-23'   and src_tbl='ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_TRS_LEG') RTL
ON RT.Swap_Comp_Agt_Id  = RTL.Swap_Comp_Agt_Id
AND  RT.Swap_Comp_Agt_Modifr  = RTL.Swap_Comp_Agt_Modifr
AND RTL.Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'STRUCTURE_LEG_TYPE'
JOIN (select * from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_HOLD_INFO a
where src_tbl='ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_TRS_LEG_HIS_POS'
and exists (select 1 from D_POS_TRS_LEG_HIS_POS_TEMP b where a.busi_date=b.busi_date)  --取得当前有更新的日期更新
) HP
ON RTL.Leg_Glbl_Seq_No  = HP.Leg_Glbl_Seq_No
JOIN  (select * from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info  WHERE src_id='TIT' and grp_id = '01') RI
ON HP.Prd_Id = RI.src_sys_prdno
LEFT JOIN pdata_news_n.t02_fxr_cfets_quot RRM
ON  HP.BUSI_DATE =default.datekey2date(RRM.trd_dt )
AND RT.Crrc_Cd = RRM.src_crrc_cd
and RRM.src_id='TIT'
and RRM.grp_id = '01'
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM PDATA_NEWS_N.t02_fut_base_info  WHERE src_id='TIT' AND grp_id = '01' )  FP
ON  RI.scr_type = 'FUT'
AND  RI.src_sys_prdno  = FP.src_sys_prdno
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM PDATA_NEWS_N.T02_PUB_CST_INFO  WHERE  const_type_cd='var00001')  PS
ON   FP.Futr_Type_Cd=PS.CONST_CD
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM PDATA_N.T01_PTY_NAME  WHERE  SRC_TBL='ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_COUNTER_PARTY' AND BUSI_DATE='2026-05-23' )  CFN
ON   RT.Cutp_Pty_Id=CFN.pty_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM PDATA_N.T01_PTY_CUTP  WHERE  SRC_TBL='ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_COUNTER_PARTY' AND BUSI_DATE='2026-05-23')  CLE

WHERE RT.Comp_Stat_Cd NOT IN ('230','254','253','218','255')

targetRelations.sourceText:
select
Book_Agt_Id as KEY_BOOK_ID,  --账簿ID
Eff_Date as VALID_STARTDATE,  --生效日期
Exp_Date as VALID_ENDDATE,  --失效日期
Agt_Full_Name as BOOK_NAME,  --账簿名称
Remark as DESCRIPTION,  --描述
Cntr as DESK,  --柜台
Bel_Dept as DEPARTMENT,  --部门
Bel_Co as COMPANY,  --公司
'' as CREATED_DATETIME,  --创建时间
'' as CREATED_BY,  --创建人
'' as UPDATED_DATETIME,  --修改时间
'' as UPDATED_BY,  --修改人
Agt_Shor_Name as SHORT_NAME,
split(Pty_Id,'-')[1] as KEY_CTPTY_ID,  --账簿归属主体对应交易对手id
CASE WHEN Rep_Fin_Flag = '1' THEN 'Y'
     WHEN Rep_Fin_Flag = '0' THEN 'N'
     ELSE Rep_Fin_Flag END as ENABLE_FINANCIAL,  --是否报送财务
CASE WHEN Rep_Risk_Flag = '1' THEN 'Y'
     WHEN Rep_Risk_Flag = '0' THEN 'N'
     ELSE Rep_Risk_Flag END as ENABLE_RISK,  --是否报送风控
CASE WHEN Enable_Rgst_Flag = '1' THEN 'Y'
     WHEN Enable_Rgst_Flag = '0' THEN 'N'
     ELSE Enable_Rgst_Flag END as ENABLE_REPORT,  --是否启用报备
CASE WHEN Enable_Sett_Ntfc_Flag = '1' THEN 'Y'
     WHEN Enable_Sett_Ntfc_Flag = '0' THEN 'N'
     ELSE Enable_Sett_Ntfc_Flag END as ENABLE_SETTLEMENT,  --是否启用结算通知书
CASE WHEN Enable_Trd_Cfm_Flag = '1' THEN 'Y'
     WHEN Enable_Trd_Cfm_Flag = '0' THEN 'N'
     ELSE Enable_Trd_Cfm_Flag END as ENABLE_CONFIRMATION,  --是否启用交易确认书
CASE WHEN Enable_Ast_Module_Flag = '1' THEN 'Y'
     WHEN Enable_Ast_Module_Flag = '0' THEN 'N'
     ELSE Enable_Ast_Module_Flag END as ENABLE_CAPITAL,  --是否启用资金模块
CASE WHEN Enable_Risk_Qta_Flag = '1' THEN 'Y'
     WHEN Enable_Risk_Qta_Flag = '0' THEN 'N'
     ELSE Enable_Risk_Qta_Flag END as ENABLE_LIMIT,  --是否启用风险限额
Ost_Otc_Ind as MARKET_TYPE,  --场内外标识
CASE WHEN Enable_Scdtm_Revw_Flag = '1' THEN 'Y'
     WHEN Enable_Scdtm_Revw_Flag = '0' THEN 'N'
     ELSE Enable_Scdtm_Revw_Flag END as ENABLE_REPEAT_CHECK,  --是否启用二次复核
'${yyyy-MM-dd}' as busi_date  --业务日期
from (
    select * from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_ADTNL_INFO
    where SRC_TBL = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK' and BUSI_DATE = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Bel_Co = 'GFS_HK'
    ) a
inner join (
    select * from PDATA_N.T03_AGT_NAME_H
    where SRC_TBL = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK' and strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}' 
    ) b
on a.Book_Agt_Id = b.Agt_Id
left join (
    select * from PDATA_N.T03_AGT_PTY_RELA_H
    where SRC_TBL = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK' and Agt_Pty_Rela_Type_Cd = '01' and strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}' 
    ) c
on a.Book_Agt_Id = c.Agt_Id

targetRelations.sourceText:
select 
    t.busi_date                             as src_busi_date      --交易日
   ,mm.key_mrg_acct_id                      as key_mrg_acct_id    --保证金编号     
   ,tot2.stati_cont_desc                    as contract_code      --合约编号
   ,mm.bundle_id                            as bundle_id          --组合id
   ,tbi.src_comb_type                       as bundle_type        --组合类型
   ,rocmp.enable_perf_marg_type_cd          as support_margin     --是否启用履保     
   ,rocmp.mtm_type_cd                       as mark_market        --盯市类型
   ,NVL(rocmp.marg_dir_type_cd,
      case when cast(ROCMP.init_perf_prtc_amt as double) >= 0 then 'CHARGE' 
           when cast(ROCMP.init_perf_prtc_amt as double) < 0 then 'PAY' 
           else 'CHARGE' END)               as margin_direction   --保证金方向
   ,rb.bel_dept                             as department         --部门
   ,'${yyyy-MM-dd}'                         as busi_date          --数据日期
from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_CUTP_MARG_ACCT_PERF_GUAR_RSLT t
  left join CONTRACT_MARGIN_MAPPING MM   
     on T.comb_agt_grp_id = MM.bundle_id
  left join PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_COMP_COMB_ADTNL_INFO TBI    
     on TBI.AGT_GRP_ID = MM.bundle_id
     and TBI.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_BUNDLE_INFO'
  inner join pdata_n.t03_agt_prd_rela_h tot
     on MM.ENTITY_ID = tot.src_prd_id
     and tot.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE' 
     and tot.strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' 
     and tot.end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  inner join pdata_n.t03_agt_rela_h tot1
    on tot.agt_id = tot1.agt_id
    and tot1.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE' 
    and tot1.strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' 
    and tot1.end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  inner join pdata_n.t03_agt_stati_info_h tot2
    on tot.agt_id = tot2.agt_id
    and tot2.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE' 
    and tot2.strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' 
    and tot2.end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  inner join pdata_n.t03_otc_deri_book_adtnl_info RB
     on TOT1.rela_agt_id = RB.BOOK_agt_ID
     and rb.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK'
     and rb.busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  left join PDATA_N.T03_OTC_COMP_PERF_MARG_REF rocmp     
     on TOT.agt_id = rocmp.otc_comp_agt_id
     and rocmp.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_OTC_CONTR_MARGIN_PARAM'
where t.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_BUNDLE_MARGIN_DAILY_RESULT'
  and rb.rep_risk_flag = '1'

    null as Upd_Date,

SELECT Inr_Comp_No,
	Agt_Type_Cd,
	src_busi_date,
	Busi_Type,
	Acct_Name,
	Sett_Crrc_Cd,
	Amt,
	Upd_Date,
	Book_Name,
	Book_Bel_Dept,
	data_time,
	grp_id,
	busi_date FROM (
	 SELECT
    U.Inr_Comp_No,  --内部合约编号
    U.Agt_Type_Cd,  --协议类型代码
    U.busi_date as src_busi_date,  --源业务日期
    U.Busi_Type,  --业务类型
    CASE WHEN U.Agt_Type_Cd IN ('AIRBAGX','AIRBAGM') AND U.Busi_Type IN ( 'PREMIUM', 'ACCRUAL_PREMIUM' ) AND U.Acct_Name LIKE '%买入期末%' THEN '场外期权：买入期权费终止'
         WHEN U.Agt_Type_Cd IN ('AIRBAGX','AIRBAGM') AND U.Busi_Type IN ( 'PREMIUM', 'ACCRUAL_PREMIUM' ) AND U.Acct_Name LIKE '%卖出期末%' THEN '场外期权：卖出期权费终止'
         WHEN U.Agt_Type_Cd NOT IN ( 'AUTOCALL' ) AND U.Busi_Type IN ( 'PREMIUM', 'ACCRUAL_PREMIUM' ) AND U.Acct_Name LIKE '%买入%' THEN '场外期权：买入期权费'
         WHEN U.Agt_Type_Cd NOT IN ( 'AUTOCALL' ) AND U.Busi_Type IN ( 'PREMIUM', 'ACCRUAL_PREMIUM' ) AND U.Acct_Name LIKE '%卖出%' THEN '场外期权：卖出期权费'
         ELSE U.Acct_Name END AS Acct_Name,  --账目名称
    U.Sett_Crrc_Cd,  --结算币种代码
    round(U.Amt, 2) as Amt,  --金额
    U.Upd_Date,  --更新日期
    U.Book_Name,  --账簿名称
    U.Book_Bel_Dept,  --账簿所属部门
    from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') as data_time,  --数据时间
    '01' AS grp_id,  --分组标识
    '${yyyy-MM-dd}' as busi_date  --业务日期
FROM (
    SELECT
        OD.Inr_Ord_Id AS Inr_Comp_No,
        OD.Src_Agt_Type_Cd as Agt_Type_Cd,
        'NEW_CONTRACT' AS Busi_Type,
        CASE WHEN OD.Book_Bel_Dept != 'OTC_HK' and OD.Sler_Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name IN ('GFS', '广发证券') THEN '场外期权：卖出期初'
             WHEN OD.Book_Bel_Dept = 'OTC_HK' and OD.Sler_Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name IN ('广发全球资本') THEN '场外期权：卖出期初'
             ELSE '场外期权：买入期初' END AS Acct_Name,
        OD.Crrc_Cd as Sett_Crrc_Cd,
        CASE WHEN OD.Src_Agt_Type_Cd NOT IN ('AUTOCALL', 'AIRBAGX', 'AIRBAGM') THEN OD.Opt_Fee
             WHEN OD.Src_Agt_Type_Cd IN ('AIRBAGX','AIRBAGM') THEN CM.Init_Pv * - 1
             ELSE 0 END AS Amt,
        CASE WHEN OD.Src_Agt_Type_Cd IN ('AIRBAGX', 'AIRBAGM') THEN CM.Create_Time
             ELSE OD.Bgng_Prcg_Date END AS Upd_Date,
        OD.Book_Name,
        OD.Book_Bel_Dept,
        ds.Actl_Appr_Vld_Date as busi_date
    FROM (
        select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO
        where src_tbl = 'PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
            and Comp_Stat_Cd NOT IN ('230', '218', '255', '254', '253') and Rep_Fin_Flag = '1' and Busi_Type_Cd NOT IN ('OPTION_INNER')
            and ((Book_Bel_Dept != 'OTC_HK' and Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name NOT IN ('GFS', '广发证券', '权益及衍生品投资部'))
                or Book_Bel_Dept = 'OTC_HK')        
        ) OD
    JOIN (
        select * from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_STRU_ELMN_INFO
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_OPTION_DEAL_STRUCTURE' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
        ) ds
    ON ds.Opt_Comp_Agt_Id = OD.Opt_Comp_Agt_Id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
            IM.Opt_Comp_Agt_Id,
            max(substr(im.Create_Time,1,10)) as Create_Time,
            sum(IM.Pv) as Init_Pv
        FROM (
            select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_OTC_OPT_SUB_TRD_PRCG_INDX
            where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_RISK_OPTION_INITIAL_METRIC' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
            ) IM
        JOIN (
            select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO
            where src_tbl = 'PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
            ) OD
        ON OD.Opt_Comp_Agt_Id = IM.Opt_Comp_Agt_Id AND IM.Prcg_Date = OD.Bgng_Prcg_Date and IM.Prcg_Env_Name = case od.Book_Bel_Dept when 'GFS_FICC' then 'OFFICIAL_FICC' when 'OTC_HK' then 'OFFICIAL_OTCHK' else 'OFFICIAL' end
        GROUP BY IM.Opt_Comp_Agt_Id
        ) CM
    ON CM.Opt_Comp_Agt_Id = OD.Opt_Comp_Agt_Id
    
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        OD.Inr_Ord_Id AS Inr_Comp_No,
        OD.Src_Agt_Type_Cd as Agt_Type_Cd,
        TT.Recv_Pymt_Type_Cd AS Busi_Type,
        CASE WHEN TT.Clr_Date = nvl(od.Erly_Trmt_Date, OD.End_Prcg_Date) AND OD.Book_Bel_Dept != 'OTC_HK' and OD.Sler_Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name in ('GFS', '广发证券') THEN '场外期权：卖出期末结算'
             WHEN TT.Clr_Date <> nvl(od.Erly_Trmt_Date, OD.End_Prcg_Date) AND OD.Book_Bel_Dept != 'OTC_HK' and OD.Sler_Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name in ('GFS', '广发证券') THEN '场外期权：卖出期中结算'
             WHEN TT.Clr_Date = nvl(od.Erly_Trmt_Date, OD.End_Prcg_Date) AND OD.Book_Bel_Dept != 'OTC_HK' and OD.Sler_Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name not in ('GFS', '广发证券') THEN '场外期权：买入期末结算'
             WHEN TT.Clr_Date <> nvl(od.Erly_Trmt_Date, OD.End_Prcg_Date) AND OD.Book_Bel_Dept != 'OTC_HK' and OD.Sler_Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name not in ('GFS', '广发证券') THEN '场外期权：买入期中结算'
             WHEN TT.Clr_Date = nvl(od.Erly_Trmt_Date, OD.End_Prcg_Date) AND OD.Book_Bel_Dept = 'OTC_HK' and OD.Sler_Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name in ('广发全球资本') THEN '场外期权：卖出期末结算'
             WHEN TT.Clr_Date <> nvl(od.Erly_Trmt_Date, OD.End_Prcg_Date) AND OD.Book_Bel_Dept = 'OTC_HK' and OD.Sler_Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name in ('广发全球资本') THEN '场外期权：卖出期中结算'
             WHEN TT.Clr_Date = nvl(od.Erly_Trmt_Date, OD.End_Prcg_Date) AND OD.Book_Bel_Dept = 'OTC_HK' and OD.Sler_Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name not in ('广发全球资本') THEN '场外期权：买入期末结算'
             WHEN TT.Clr_Date <> nvl(od.Erly_Trmt_Date, OD.End_Prcg_Date) AND OD.Book_Bel_Dept = 'OTC_HK' and OD.Sler_Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name not in ('广发全球资本') THEN '场外期权：买入期中结算'
             ELSE '' END AS Acct_Name,
        OD.Crrc_Cd as Sett_Crrc_Cd,
        NVL(TT.Aft_Adj_Amt, 0) AS Amt,
        substr(TT.Upd_Time,1,10) as Upd_Date,
        OD.Book_Name,
        OD.Book_Bel_Dept,
        substr(TT.Upd_Time,1,10) AS busi_date
    FROM (
        select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO
        where src_tbl = 'PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Book_Name <> 'OTC-互换-内部交易'
            and Comp_Stat_Cd NOT IN ('230', '218', '255', '254', '253') and Rep_Fin_Flag = '1' and Busi_Type_Cd NOT IN ('OPTION_INNER')
            and ((Book_Bel_Dept != 'OTC_HK' and Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name NOT IN ('GFS', '广发证券', '权益及衍生品投资部'))
                or Book_Bel_Dept = 'OTC_HK')
        ) OD
    inner join (
        select * from PDATA_N.T05_OTC_RECV_PYMT_EVT
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_TRANSFER' and Recv_Pymt_Stat_Cd IN ('VERIFIED', 'SETTLED') and del_flag = '0'
        ) TT
    ON OD.Comp_Prd_Id = TT.Src_Prd_Id OR OD.Inr_Ord_Id = TT.Comp_No

    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        CM.Prd_Shor_Name as Inr_Comp_No,
        CM.Src_Agt_Type_Cd as Agt_Type_Cd,
        'INIT_PREMIUM_ADJUSTED' as Busi_Type,
        CASE WHEN CM.Buy_Sell_Dir_Cd = '2' THEN '场外期权：卖出期初期权费调整'
             WHEN CM.Buy_Sell_Dir_Cd = '1' THEN '场外期权：买入期初期权费调整'
             ELSE NULL END Acct_Name,
        CM.Sett_Crrc_Cd,
        CM.Bgng_Opt_Fee_Adj as Amt,
        substr(CM.Upd_Time,1,10) as Upd_Date,
        OD.Book_Name,
        OD.Book_Bel_Dept,
        CM.busi_date
    FROM (
        select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_TIT_DAY_HOLD_INDX
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_EOD_CALC_METRICS'
            and cast(nvl(Bgng_Opt_Fee_Adj, '0') as double) <> 0
        ) CM
    JOIN (
        select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO
        where src_tbl = 'PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
            and Rep_Fin_Flag = '1' and Busi_Type_Cd NOT IN ('OPTION_INNER')
            and ((Book_Bel_Dept != 'OTC_HK' and Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name NOT IN ('GFS', '广发证券', '权益及衍生品投资部'))
                or Book_Bel_Dept = 'OTC_HK')
        ) OD
    on OD.Comp_Prd_Id = CM.Prd_id and OD.Book_Agt_Id = CM.Book_Agt_Id
    
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        CM.Prd_Shor_Name as Inr_Comp_No,
        CM.Src_Agt_Type_Cd as Agt_Type_Cd,
        'INIT_PREMIUM_CONFIRM' as Busi_Type,
        CASE WHEN CM.Buy_Sell_Dir_Cd = '2' THEN '场外期权：卖出期初期权费确认'
             WHEN CM.Buy_Sell_Dir_Cd = '1' THEN '场外期权：买入期初期权费确认'
             ELSE NULL END Acct_Name,
        CM.Sett_Crrc_Cd,
        CM.Bgng_Opt_Fee_Cfm as Amt,
        substr(CM.Upd_Time,1,10) as Upd_Date,
        OD.Book_Name,
        OD.Book_Bel_Dept,
        CM.busi_date
    FROM (
        select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_TIT_DAY_HOLD_INDX
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_EOD_CALC_METRICS'
            and cast(nvl(Bgng_Opt_Fee_Cfm, '0') as double) <> 0
        ) CM
    JOIN (
        select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO
        where src_tbl = 'PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
            and Rep_Fin_Flag = '1' and Busi_Type_Cd NOT IN ('OPTION_INNER')
            and ((Book_Bel_Dept != 'OTC_HK' and Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name NOT IN ('GFS', '广发证券', '权益及衍生品投资部'))
                or Book_Bel_Dept = 'OTC_HK')
        ) OD
    on OD.Comp_Prd_Id = CM.Prd_id and OD.Book_Agt_Id = CM.Book_Agt_Id
    
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        CM.Prd_Shor_Name as Inr_Comp_No,
        CM.Src_Agt_Type_Cd as Agt_Type_Cd,
        'DAILY_PREMIUM' as Busi_Type,
        CASE WHEN CM.Buy_Sell_Dir_Cd = '2' THEN '场外期权：卖出期权费每日摊销'
             WHEN CM.Buy_Sell_Dir_Cd = '1' THEN '场外期权：买入期权费每日摊销'
             ELSE NULL END Acct_Name,
        CM.Sett_Crrc_Cd,
        CM.Eday_Amrt_Opt_Fee as Amt,
        substr(CM.Upd_Time,1,10) as Upd_Date,
        OD.Book_Name,
        OD.Book_Bel_Dept,
        CM.busi_date
    FROM (
        select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_TIT_DAY_HOLD_INDX
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_EOD_CALC_METRICS'
            and cast(nvl(Eday_Amrt_Opt_Fee, '0') as double) <> 0
        ) CM
    JOIN (
        select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO
        where src_tbl = 'PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
            and Rep_Fin_Flag = '1' and Busi_Type_Cd NOT IN ('OPTION_INNER')
            and ((Book_Bel_Dept != 'OTC_HK' and Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name NOT IN ('GFS', '广发证券', '权益及衍生品投资部'))
                or Book_Bel_Dept = 'OTC_HK')
        ) OD
    on OD.Comp_Prd_Id = CM.Prd_id and OD.Book_Agt_Id = CM.Book_Agt_Id
    ) U
union all

targetRelations.fullCondition:
SELECT Inr_Comp_No,
	Agt_Type_Cd,
	src_busi_date,
	Busi_Type,
	Acct_Name,
	Sett_Crrc_Cd,
	Amt,
	Upd_Date,
	Book_Name,
	Book_Bel_Dept,
	data_time,
	grp_id,
	busi_date FROM (
	 SELECT
    U.Inr_Comp_No,  --内部合约编号
    U.Agt_Type_Cd,  --协议类型代码
    U.busi_date as src_busi_date,  --源业务日期
    U.Busi_Type,  --业务类型
    CASE WHEN U.Agt_Type_Cd IN ('AIRBAGX','AIRBAGM') AND U.Busi_Type IN ( 'PREMIUM', 'ACCRUAL_PREMIUM' ) AND U.Acct_Name LIKE '%买入期末%' THEN '场外期权：买入期权费终止'
         WHEN U.Agt_Type_Cd IN ('AIRBAGX','AIRBAGM') AND U.Busi_Type IN ( 'PREMIUM', 'ACCRUAL_PREMIUM' ) AND U.Acct_Name LIKE '%卖出期末%' THEN '场外期权：卖出期权费终止'
         WHEN U.Agt_Type_Cd NOT IN ( 'AUTOCALL' ) AND U.Busi_Type IN ( 'PREMIUM', 'ACCRUAL_PREMIUM' ) AND U.Acct_Name LIKE '%买入%' THEN '场外期权：买入期权费'
         WHEN U.Agt_Type_Cd NOT IN ( 'AUTOCALL' ) AND U.Busi_Type IN ( 'PREMIUM', 'ACCRUAL_PREMIUM' ) AND U.Acct_Name LIKE '%卖出%' THEN '场外期权：卖出期权费'
         ELSE U.Acct_Name END AS Acct_Name,  --账目名称
    U.Sett_Crrc_Cd,  --结算币种代码
    round(U.Amt, 2) as Amt,  --金额
    U.Upd_Date,  --更新日期
    U.Book_Name,  --账簿名称
    U.Book_Bel_Dept,  --账簿所属部门
    from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') as data_time,  --数据时间
    '01' AS grp_id,  --分组标识
    '${yyyy-MM-dd}' as busi_date  --业务日期
FROM (
    SELECT
        OD.Inr_Ord_Id AS Inr_Comp_No,
        OD.Src_Agt_Type_Cd as Agt_Type_Cd,
        'NEW_CONTRACT' AS Busi_Type,
        CASE WHEN OD.Book_Bel_Dept != 'OTC_HK' and OD.Sler_Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name IN ('GFS', '广发证券') THEN '场外期权：卖出期初'
             WHEN OD.Book_Bel_Dept = 'OTC_HK' and OD.Sler_Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name IN ('广发全球资本') THEN '场外期权：卖出期初'
             ELSE '场外期权：买入期初' END AS Acct_Name,
        OD.Crrc_Cd as Sett_Crrc_Cd,
        CASE WHEN OD.Src_Agt_Type_Cd NOT IN ('AUTOCALL', 'AIRBAGX', 'AIRBAGM') THEN OD.Opt_Fee
             WHEN OD.Src_Agt_Type_Cd IN ('AIRBAGX','AIRBAGM') THEN CM.Init_Pv * - 1
             ELSE 0 END AS Amt,
        CASE WHEN OD.Src_Agt_Type_Cd IN ('AIRBAGX', 'AIRBAGM') THEN CM.Create_Time
             ELSE OD.Bgng_Prcg_Date END AS Upd_Date,
        OD.Book_Name,
        OD.Book_Bel_Dept,
        ds.Actl_Appr_Vld_Date as busi_date
    FROM (
        select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO
        where src_tbl = 'PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
            and Comp_Stat_Cd NOT IN ('230', '218', '255', '254', '253') and Rep_Fin_Flag = '1' and Busi_Type_Cd NOT IN ('OPTION_INNER')
            and ((Book_Bel_Dept != 'OTC_HK' and Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name NOT IN ('GFS', '广发证券', '权益及衍生品投资部'))
                or Book_Bel_Dept = 'OTC_HK')        
        ) OD
    JOIN (
        select * from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_STRU_ELMN_INFO
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_OPTION_DEAL_STRUCTURE' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
        ) ds
    ON ds.Opt_Comp_Agt_Id = OD.Opt_Comp_Agt_Id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
            IM.Opt_Comp_Agt_Id,
            max(substr(im.Create_Time,1,10)) as Create_Time,
            sum(IM.Pv) as Init_Pv
        FROM (
            select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_OTC_OPT_SUB_TRD_PRCG_INDX
            where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_RISK_OPTION_INITIAL_METRIC' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
            ) IM
        JOIN (
            select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO
            where src_tbl = 'PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
            ) OD
        ON OD.Opt_Comp_Agt_Id = IM.Opt_Comp_Agt_Id AND IM.Prcg_Date = OD.Bgng_Prcg_Date and IM.Prcg_Env_Name = case od.Book_Bel_Dept when 'GFS_FICC' then 'OFFICIAL_FICC' when 'OTC_HK' then 'OFFICIAL_OTCHK' else 'OFFICIAL' end
        GROUP BY IM.Opt_Comp_Agt_Id
        ) CM
    ON CM.Opt_Comp_Agt_Id = OD.Opt_Comp_Agt_Id
    
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        OD.Inr_Ord_Id AS Inr_Comp_No,
        OD.Src_Agt_Type_Cd as Agt_Type_Cd,
        TT.Recv_Pymt_Type_Cd AS Busi_Type,
        CASE WHEN TT.Clr_Date = nvl(od.Erly_Trmt_Date, OD.End_Prcg_Date) AND OD.Book_Bel_Dept != 'OTC_HK' and OD.Sler_Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name in ('GFS', '广发证券') THEN '场外期权：卖出期末结算'
             WHEN TT.Clr_Date <> nvl(od.Erly_Trmt_Date, OD.End_Prcg_Date) AND OD.Book_Bel_Dept != 'OTC_HK' and OD.Sler_Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name in ('GFS', '广发证券') THEN '场外期权：卖出期中结算'
             WHEN TT.Clr_Date = nvl(od.Erly_Trmt_Date, OD.End_Prcg_Date) AND OD.Book_Bel_Dept != 'OTC_HK' and OD.Sler_Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name not in ('GFS', '广发证券') THEN '场外期权：买入期末结算'
             WHEN TT.Clr_Date <> nvl(od.Erly_Trmt_Date, OD.End_Prcg_Date) AND OD.Book_Bel_Dept != 'OTC_HK' and OD.Sler_Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name not in ('GFS', '广发证券') THEN '场外期权：买入期中结算'
             WHEN TT.Clr_Date = nvl(od.Erly_Trmt_Date, OD.End_Prcg_Date) AND OD.Book_Bel_Dept = 'OTC_HK' and OD.Sler_Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name in ('广发全球资本') THEN '场外期权：卖出期末结算'
             WHEN TT.Clr_Date <> nvl(od.Erly_Trmt_Date, OD.End_Prcg_Date) AND OD.Book_Bel_Dept = 'OTC_HK' and OD.Sler_Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name in ('广发全球资本') THEN '场外期权：卖出期中结算'
             WHEN TT.Clr_Date = nvl(od.Erly_Trmt_Date, OD.End_Prcg_Date) AND OD.Book_Bel_Dept = 'OTC_HK' and OD.Sler_Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name not in ('广发全球资本') THEN '场外期权：买入期末结算'
             WHEN TT.Clr_Date <> nvl(od.Erly_Trmt_Date, OD.End_Prcg_Date) AND OD.Book_Bel_Dept = 'OTC_HK' and OD.Sler_Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name not in ('广发全球资本') THEN '场外期权：买入期中结算'
             ELSE '' END AS Acct_Name,
        OD.Crrc_Cd as Sett_Crrc_Cd,
        NVL(TT.Aft_Adj_Amt, 0) AS Amt,
        substr(TT.Upd_Time,1,10) as Upd_Date,
        OD.Book_Name,
        OD.Book_Bel_Dept,
        substr(TT.Upd_Time,1,10) AS busi_date
    FROM (
        select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO
        where src_tbl = 'PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Book_Name <> 'OTC-互换-内部交易'
            and Comp_Stat_Cd NOT IN ('230', '218', '255', '254', '253') and Rep_Fin_Flag = '1' and Busi_Type_Cd NOT IN ('OPTION_INNER')
            and ((Book_Bel_Dept != 'OTC_HK' and Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name NOT IN ('GFS', '广发证券', '权益及衍生品投资部'))
                or Book_Bel_Dept = 'OTC_HK')
        ) OD
    inner join (
        select * from PDATA_N.T05_OTC_RECV_PYMT_EVT
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_TRANSFER' and Recv_Pymt_Stat_Cd IN ('VERIFIED', 'SETTLED') and del_flag = '0'
        ) TT
    ON OD.Comp_Prd_Id = TT.Src_Prd_Id OR OD.Inr_Ord_Id = TT.Comp_No

    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        CM.Prd_Shor_Name as Inr_Comp_No,
        CM.Src_Agt_Type_Cd as Agt_Type_Cd,
        'INIT_PREMIUM_ADJUSTED' as Busi_Type,
        CASE WHEN CM.Buy_Sell_Dir_Cd = '2' THEN '场外期权：卖出期初期权费调整'
             WHEN CM.Buy_Sell_Dir_Cd = '1' THEN '场外期权：买入期初期权费调整'
             ELSE NULL END Acct_Name,
        CM.Sett_Crrc_Cd,
        CM.Bgng_Opt_Fee_Adj as Amt,
        substr(CM.Upd_Time,1,10) as Upd_Date,
        OD.Book_Name,
        OD.Book_Bel_Dept,
        CM.busi_date
    FROM (
        select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_TIT_DAY_HOLD_INDX
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_EOD_CALC_METRICS'
            and cast(nvl(Bgng_Opt_Fee_Adj, '0') as double) <> 0
        ) CM
    JOIN (
        select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO

targetRelations.sourceText:
SELECT
    trs.Strt_Pric_Date AS OC_DATE,  --发生日期
    ca.Ast_Acct_Bnk_Name AS FUND_ACCOUNT,  --资金账号
    NULL AS STOCK_ACCOUNT,  --股东账号
    NULL AS BRANCH_NO,  --营业部号
    RCM.Rela_Pty_Id AS CLIENT_ID,  --客户号
    trs.Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name AS CLIENT_NAME,  --客户姓名
    NULL AS SERIAL_NO,  --流水号
    NULL AS ENTRUST_NO,  --委托编号
    NULL AS ENTRUST_DATE,  --委托日期
    NULL AS ENTRUST_TIME,  --委托时间
    substr(trs.Trd_Date,1,10) AS BUSINESS_DATE,  --成交日期
    substr(trs.Trd_Date,1,10) AS BUSINESS_TIME,  --成交时间
    trs.Comp_Stat_Cd AS BUSINESS_FLAG,  --业务标识
    trs.Comp_Stat_Desc AS BUSINESS_FLAG_NAME,  --业务标识(中文)
    NULL AS ENTRUST_WAY,  --委托方式
    NULL AS ENTRUST_WAY_NAME,  --委托方式(中文)
    tp.src_mkt_cd AS EXCHANGE_TYPE,  --市场代码
    NVL(CDD.Dw_Cd_Val_Desc,tp.src_mkt_cd) AS EXCHANGE_TYPE_NAME,  --市场代码(中文)
    tp.scr_type_src AS STOCK_TYPE,  --证券类别
    CASE WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'EQUITY' THEN '股票' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'INDEX' THEN '股指' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'FUTURE' THEN '期货' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'COMMODITY' THEN '商品' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'FUND' THEN '基金' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'OTCOPTION' THEN '场外期权' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'LISTEDOPTION' THEN '场内期权' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'STRUCTURED_NOTES' THEN '收益凭证' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'OTC_OPTION_CONTRACT' THEN '场外期权合约' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'RATE_INDEX' THEN '浮动利率' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'TRS' THEN '收益互换' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'AB_TRS' THEN 'AB款收益互换' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'OTC_TRS_MAIN_CONTRACT' THEN 'TRS主合约' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'HEDGE_FUND' THEN '私募' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'FEE' THEN '费用' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'FEE_PAYMENT_SCHEDULE' THEN '费用-支付日期' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'FX' THEN '货币对' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'QIS' THEN '策略指数' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'BASKET' THEN '一篮子股票' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'GDR' THEN 'GDR' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'BOND' THEN '债券' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'WAR' THEN 'WAR认股权证' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'CBBC' THEN 'CBBC牛熊证' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'LONG_SHORT_SWAP' THEN '多空互换' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'N_CROSS_DMA_SWAP' THEN '北上DMA' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'FX_FORWARD' THEN '外汇远期合约' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'CASH' THEN '货币资金' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'NOTE' THEN '票据' 
         ELSE tp.scr_type_src END AS STOCK_TYPE_NAME,  --证券类别名称
    TP.wind_cd_src AS STOCK_CODE,  --证券代码
    TP.INS_SHT_DESC AS STOCK_NAME,  --证券名称
    '1' AS CAPITAL_DIRECTION,  --资金流向
    NULL AS BUSINESS_NO,  --成交编号
    TP.Vol AS BUSINESS_AMOUNT,  --成交数量
    TP.Bgng_Pric AS BUSINESS_PRICE,  --成交价格
    TP.Bgng_Pric * TP.Vol AS BUSINESS_BALANCE,  --成交金额
    DB.Begn_Bal AS FUND_BALANCE,  --资金余额
    NULL AS STOCK_BALANCE,  --证券余额
    NULL AS BLOCK_TYPE,  --大宗交易标识
    NULL AS REBATE_FARE,  --佣金
    NULL AS IP_ADDRESS,  --IP地址
    NULL AS MAC_ADDRESS,  --MAC地址
    NULL AS MOBILE_IMEI,  --手机IMEI码
    NULL AS MOBILE_IMSI,  --手机IMSI码
    NULL AS UUID,  --通用唯一识别码
    NULL AS MOBILE_PHONE,  --委托电话
    NULL AS SUMMARY,  --摘要
    TP.CURRENCY AS MONEY_TYPE,  --币种
    cr.dw_cd_val_desc AS MONEY_TYPE_NAME,  --币种(中文)
    NULL AS ASSET_PROP,  --资产属性
    NULL AS ASSET_PROP_NAME,  --资产属性(中文)
    NULL AS OP_STATION,  --操作员站点
    NULL AS HARD_DISK_NO,  --硬盘序列号
    NULL AS SRC_BUSINESS_FLAG,  --源系统业务标识
    NULL AS SRC_BUSINESS_NAME,  --源系统业务标识名称
    NULL AS ANDROID_ID,  --安卓识别号
    NULL AS SEAT_NO,  --席位编号
    NULL AS ENTRUST_PROP,  --委托属性
    NULL AS ENTRUST_PROP_NAME,  --委托属性(中文)
    tp.undrl_minor_cate AS SUB_STOCK_TYPE,  --证券类别子类
    CASE WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'STOCK' THEN '股票' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'STOCK_INDEX' THEN '股指' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'NEEQ_STOCK_LIST' THEN '新三板挂牌股票' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'HK_STOCK' THEN '香港股票' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'HK_STOCK_INDEX' THEN '香港股指' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'SPECIAL_FUND' THEN '基金及基金专户' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'BONDS' THEN '债券' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'GOLD_FUTURES' THEN '黄金期货' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'TREASURY_FUTURES' THEN '国债期货' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'SHARE_PRICE_INDEX_FUTURES' THEN '股指期货' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'OTHER_FUTURES' THEN '其他期货' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'GOLD_SPOT' THEN '黄金现货' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'OTHER_OVERSEAS' THEN '其他现货' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'OVERSEAS_FUTURES' THEN '境外期货' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'OVERSEAS_OVERSEAS' THEN '境外现货' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'OVERSEAS_STOCK' THEN '境外股票' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'OVERSEAS_STOCK_INDEX' THEN '境外股指' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'EXCHANGE_RATE' THEN '汇率' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'SHIBOR' THEN 'Shibor' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'FIXING_REPO_RATE' THEN '银行间回购定盘（Fixing Repo Rate）' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'OTHER_INTEREST_RATE' THEN '其他利率' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'OTHER_UNDERLYING' THEN '其他标的' 
         ELSE tp.undrl_minor_cate END AS SUB_STOCK_TYPE_NAME,  --证券类别子类(中文)
    NULL AS OPTION_CODE,  --期权代码
    trs.Inr_Comp_No AS OPTION_NAME,  --期权合约名称
    NULL AS OPPO_SEAT_NO,  --对方席位
    NULL AS POSITION_STR,  --定位串
    NULL AS ACTUAL_MOBILE_PHONE,  --实际使用手机号
    case when rb.Bel_Dept = 'OTC' then '股衍'
         when rb.Bel_Dept = 'GFS_FICC' then '固收'
         end as system_name,  --系统名称
    '03' as grp_id  --分组标识
FROM (
    select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_OTC_SWAP_COMP_INFO
    where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
        and Comp_Stat_Cd != '218' and Strt_Pric_Date >= '2022-01-01'
    ) trs
inner join (
    select * from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_ADTNL_INFO
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Bel_Dept IN ('OTC','GFS_FICC')
    ) rb
ON trs.Book_Agt_Id = RB.Book_Agt_Id 
LEFT JOIN (
    select * from PDATA_N.T01_PTY_RELA_H
    where SRC_TBL = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_CTPTY_MAPPING' and Pty_Rela_Type_Cd = '01'
        and strt_date < '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and end_date >= '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
    ) RCM
ON trs.Cutp_Pty_Id = RCM.Pty_Id
LEFT JOIN trs_pos TP
ON trs.Swap_Comp_Agt_Id = TP.Swap_Comp_Agt_Id AND trs.Strt_Pric_Date = TP.BUSI_DATE
LEFT JOIN (
    select distinct dw_cd_val,dw_cd_val_desc from PDATA_N.REF_DW_CD_VAL
    where dw_cd_id = 'CD035'
    ) cr
on cr.dw_cd_val = TP.CURRENCY
LEFT JOIN (
    select * from PDATA_N.REF_DW_CD_VAL
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_CFG_DICTIONARY_DESC' and dw_cd_id = 'CD082'
    ) CDD
ON TP.src_mkt_cd = CDD.Dw_Cd_Val
LEFT JOIN (
    select * from PDATA_N.T03_AST_CRRC_ACCT_BAL
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_CAPITAL_ACCT_DAILY_BALANCE'
    ) DB
ON trs.Ast_Acct_Agt_Id = DB.Ast_Acct_Agt_Id AND DB.BUSI_DATE = trs.Strt_Pric_Date
left join (
    select * from PDATA_N.T03_TIT_AST_ACCT_ADTNL_INFO
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_CAPITAL_ACCOUNT' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
    ) ca
on ca.Agt_Id = trs.Ast_Acct_Agt_Id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT SRC_CD_VAL, DW_CD_VAL
    FROM PDATA_N.REF_CD_CVT_MAP
    WHERE TGT_TAB_NAME = 'T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO'
        AND TGT_TAB_FLD = 'Comp_Stat_Cd'
        AND SRC_TAB_NAME = 'REF_OTC_OPTION_DEAL'
        AND SRC_FLD_NAME = 'CONTR_STATUS'
        AND SRC_SYS_NAME = 'TIT'
    ) B
ON trs.Comp_Stat_Cd = B.DW_CD_VAL

on ca.Agt_Id = trs.Ast_Acct_Agt_Id

    where SRC_TBL = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_TRS_EVENT_STRUC_DETAIL'

         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'FUND' THEN '基金'

         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'FEE_PAYMENT_SCHEDULE' THEN '费用-支付日期' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'FX' THEN '货币对' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'QIS' THEN '策略指数' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'BASKET' THEN '一篮子股票' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'GDR' THEN 'GDR' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'BOND' THEN '债券' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'WAR' THEN 'WAR认股权证' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'CBBC' THEN 'CBBC牛熊证' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'LONG_SHORT_SWAP' THEN '多空互换' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'N_CROSS_DMA_SWAP' THEN '北上DMA'

    NULL AS MOBILE_IMSI,
    NULL AS UUID,

    case when rb.Bel_Dept = 'OTC' then '股衍'
         when rb.Bel_Dept = 'GFS_FICC' then '固收'
         end as system_name,

FROM (

    where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
        and Comp_Stat_Cd != '218' and Strt_Pric_Date >= '2022-01-01'

ON trs.Cutp_Pty_Id = RCM.Pty_Id
LEFT JOIN trs_pos TP

LEFT JOIN (

on cr.dw_cd_val = TP.CURRENCY
LEFT JOIN (

ON TP.src_mkt_cd = CDD.Dw_Cd_Val
LEFT JOIN (
    select * from PDATA_N.T03_AST_CRRC_ACCT_BAL
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_CAPITAL_ACCT_DAILY_BALANCE'
    ) DB
ON trs.Ast_Acct_Agt_Id = DB.Ast_Acct_Agt_Id AND DB.BUSI_DATE = NVL(TOCR.Actl_Sett_Date,trs.End_Pric_Date)
left join (
    select * from PDATA_N.T03_TIT_AST_ACCT_ADTNL_INFO
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_CAPITAL_ACCOUNT' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
    ) ca
on ca.Agt_Id = trs.Ast_Acct_Agt_Id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT SRC_CD_VAL, DW_CD_VAL
    FROM PDATA_N.REF_CD_CVT_MAP

        AND SRC_FLD_NAME = 'CONTR_STATUS'
        AND SRC_SYS_NAME = 'TIT'
    ) B
ON trs.Comp_Stat_Cd = B.DW_CD_VAL                  --CONTR_STATUS 转码

SELECT OC_DATE,
	FUND_ACCOUNT,
	STOCK_ACCOUNT,
	BRANCH_NO,
	CLIENT_ID,
	CLIENT_NAME,
	SERIAL_NO,
	ENTRUST_NO,
	ENTRUST_DATE,
	ENTRUST_TIME,
	BUSINESS_DATE,
	BUSINESS_TIME,
	BUSINESS_FLAG,
	BUSINESS_FLAG_NAME,
	ENTRUST_WAY,
	ENTRUST_WAY_NAME,
	EXCHANGE_TYPE,
	EXCHANGE_TYPE_NAME,
	STOCK_TYPE,
	STOCK_TYPE_NAME,
	STOCK_CODE,
	STOCK_NAME,
	CAPITAL_DIRECTION,
	BUSINESS_NO,
	BUSINESS_AMOUNT,
	BUSINESS_PRICE,
	BUSINESS_BALANCE,
	FUND_BALANCE,
	STOCK_BALANCE,
	BLOCK_TYPE,
	REBATE_FARE,
	IP_ADDRESS,
	MAC_ADDRESS,
	MOBILE_IMEI,
	MOBILE_IMSI,
	UUID,
	MOBILE_PHONE,
	SUMMARY,
	MONEY_TYPE,
	MONEY_TYPE_NAME,
	ASSET_PROP,
	ASSET_PROP_NAME,
	OP_STATION,
	HARD_DISK_NO,
	SRC_BUSINESS_FLAG,
	SRC_BUSINESS_NAME,
	ANDROID_ID,
	SEAT_NO,
	ENTRUST_PROP,
	ENTRUST_PROP_NAME,
	SUB_STOCK_TYPE,
	SUB_STOCK_TYPE_NAME,
	OPTION_CODE,
	OPTION_NAME,
	OPPO_SEAT_NO,
	POSITION_STR,
	ACTUAL_MOBILE_PHONE,
	system_name,
	grp_id FROM (
	 
--互换开仓
SELECT
    trs.Strt_Pric_Date AS OC_DATE,  --发生日期
    ca.Ast_Acct_Bnk_Name AS FUND_ACCOUNT,  --资金账号
    NULL AS STOCK_ACCOUNT,  --股东账号
    NULL AS BRANCH_NO,  --营业部号
    RCM.Rela_Pty_Id AS CLIENT_ID,  --客户号
    trs.Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name AS CLIENT_NAME,  --客户姓名
    NULL AS SERIAL_NO,  --流水号
    NULL AS ENTRUST_NO,  --委托编号
    NULL AS ENTRUST_DATE,  --委托日期
    NULL AS ENTRUST_TIME,  --委托时间
    substr(trs.Trd_Date,1,10) AS BUSINESS_DATE,  --成交日期
    substr(trs.Trd_Date,1,10) AS BUSINESS_TIME,  --成交时间
    trs.Comp_Stat_Cd AS BUSINESS_FLAG,  --业务标识
    trs.Comp_Stat_Desc AS BUSINESS_FLAG_NAME,  --业务标识(中文)
    NULL AS ENTRUST_WAY,  --委托方式
    NULL AS ENTRUST_WAY_NAME,  --委托方式(中文)
    tp.src_mkt_cd AS EXCHANGE_TYPE,  --市场代码
    NVL(CDD.Dw_Cd_Val_Desc,tp.src_mkt_cd) AS EXCHANGE_TYPE_NAME,  --市场代码(中文)
    tp.scr_type_src AS STOCK_TYPE,  --证券类别
    CASE WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'EQUITY' THEN '股票' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'INDEX' THEN '股指' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'FUTURE' THEN '期货' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'COMMODITY' THEN '商品' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'FUND' THEN '基金' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'OTCOPTION' THEN '场外期权' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'LISTEDOPTION' THEN '场内期权' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'STRUCTURED_NOTES' THEN '收益凭证' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'OTC_OPTION_CONTRACT' THEN '场外期权合约' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'RATE_INDEX' THEN '浮动利率' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'TRS' THEN '收益互换' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'AB_TRS' THEN 'AB款收益互换' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'OTC_TRS_MAIN_CONTRACT' THEN 'TRS主合约' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'HEDGE_FUND' THEN '私募' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'FEE' THEN '费用' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'FEE_PAYMENT_SCHEDULE' THEN '费用-支付日期' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'FX' THEN '货币对' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'QIS' THEN '策略指数' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'BASKET' THEN '一篮子股票' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'GDR' THEN 'GDR' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'BOND' THEN '债券' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'WAR' THEN 'WAR认股权证' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'CBBC' THEN 'CBBC牛熊证' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'LONG_SHORT_SWAP' THEN '多空互换' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'N_CROSS_DMA_SWAP' THEN '北上DMA' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'FX_FORWARD' THEN '外汇远期合约' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'CASH' THEN '货币资金' 
         WHEN tp.scr_type_src = 'NOTE' THEN '票据' 
         ELSE tp.scr_type_src END AS STOCK_TYPE_NAME,  --证券类别名称
    TP.wind_cd_src AS STOCK_CODE,  --证券代码
    TP.INS_SHT_DESC AS STOCK_NAME,  --证券名称
    '1' AS CAPITAL_DIRECTION,  --资金流向
    NULL AS BUSINESS_NO,  --成交编号
    TP.Vol AS BUSINESS_AMOUNT,  --成交数量
    TP.Bgng_Pric AS BUSINESS_PRICE,  --成交价格
    TP.Bgng_Pric * TP.Vol AS BUSINESS_BALANCE,  --成交金额
    DB.Begn_Bal AS FUND_BALANCE,  --资金余额
    NULL AS STOCK_BALANCE,  --证券余额
    NULL AS BLOCK_TYPE,  --大宗交易标识
    NULL AS REBATE_FARE,  --佣金
    NULL AS IP_ADDRESS,  --IP地址
    NULL AS MAC_ADDRESS,  --MAC地址
    NULL AS MOBILE_IMEI,  --手机IMEI码
    NULL AS MOBILE_IMSI,  --手机IMSI码
    NULL AS UUID,  --通用唯一识别码
    NULL AS MOBILE_PHONE,  --委托电话
    NULL AS SUMMARY,  --摘要

    cr.dw_cd_val_desc AS MONEY_TYPE_NAME,  --币种(中文)
    NULL AS ASSET_PROP,  --资产属性
    NULL AS ASSET_PROP_NAME,  --资产属性(中文)
    NULL AS OP_STATION,  --操作员站点
    NULL AS HARD_DISK_NO,  --硬盘序列号
    NULL AS SRC_BUSINESS_FLAG,  --源系统业务标识
    NULL AS SRC_BUSINESS_NAME,  --源系统业务标识名称
    NULL AS ANDROID_ID,  --安卓识别号
    NULL AS SEAT_NO,  --席位编号
    NULL AS ENTRUST_PROP,  --委托属性
    NULL AS ENTRUST_PROP_NAME,  --委托属性(中文)
    tp.undrl_minor_cate AS SUB_STOCK_TYPE,  --证券类别子类
    CASE WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'STOCK' THEN '股票' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'STOCK_INDEX' THEN '股指' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'NEEQ_STOCK_LIST' THEN '新三板挂牌股票' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'HK_STOCK' THEN '香港股票' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'HK_STOCK_INDEX' THEN '香港股指' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'SPECIAL_FUND' THEN '基金及基金专户' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'BONDS' THEN '债券'

         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'GOLD_SPOT' THEN '黄金现货' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'OTHER_OVERSEAS' THEN '其他现货' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'OVERSEAS_FUTURES' THEN '境外期货'

         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'EXCHANGE_RATE' THEN '汇率' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'SHIBOR' THEN 'Shibor' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'FIXING_REPO_RATE' THEN '银行间回购定盘（Fixing Repo Rate）' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'OTHER_INTEREST_RATE' THEN '其他利率' 
         WHEN tp.undrl_minor_cate = 'OTHER_UNDERLYING' THEN '其他标的' 
         ELSE tp.undrl_minor_cate END AS SUB_STOCK_TYPE_NAME,  --证券类别子类(中文)
    NULL AS OPTION_CODE,  --期权代码
    trs.Inr_Comp_No AS OPTION_NAME,  --期权合约名称
    NULL AS OPPO_SEAT_NO,  --对方席位
    NULL AS POSITION_STR,  --定位串

    case when rb.Bel_Dept = 'OTC' then '股衍'
         when rb.Bel_Dept = 'GFS_FICC' then '固收'
         end as system_name,  --系统名称
    '03' as grp_id  --分组标识
FROM (
    select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_OTC_SWAP_COMP_INFO

inner join (

targetRelations.sourceText:
SELECT
DR.BUSI_DATE as src_busi_date, --日期
DR.BUNDLE_ID, --组合编号
TOT.INTERNAL_TRADE_ID, --合约编号
BU.UNDERLYING_INFO AS UNDERLYING_INFO, --标的证券
BUT.UNDERLYING_TYPE AS INTEROTC_NAME, --标的类型
CASE WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'DIGITAL' THEN '二值'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'EUROPEAN_VANILLA' THEN '欧式香草'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'SPREAD' THEN '价差'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'SHARKFIN' THEN '鲨鱼鳍'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'BUTTERFLY' THEN '蝶式'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'STRADDLE' THEN '跨式'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'BARRIER' THEN '障碍'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'DAILYRANGEACCRUAL' THEN '区间累积'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'AUTOCALL' THEN '自动赎回'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'AIRBAG' THEN '安全气囊'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'RISKY' THEN 'Risky'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'AMERICAN_VANILLA' THEN '美式香草'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'PARTICIPATORY' THEN '参与型看涨'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'AIRBAGX' THEN '安全气囊X'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'LADDER_CALL' THEN '阶梯看涨'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'ACCUMULATOR' THEN '累购'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'DECCUMULATOR' THEN '累沽'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'AIRBAGL' THEN '安全气囊L'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'KIPUT' THEN '敲入看跌'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'AIRBAGM' THEN '安全气囊M'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'CUSTOMISED' THEN '自定义'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'CALL_SWAP' THEN '多头互换'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'PUT_SWAP' THEN '空头互换'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'LEND_SWAP' THEN '借券互换'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'INDEX_ENHANCE_SWAP' THEN '指数增强'

from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_OPT_COMP_SUB_TRD_BASE_INFO a
  left join PDATA_N.REF_CD_CVT_MAP b                           --CONTR_STATUS 转码
    on a.opt_comp_stat_cd = b.dw_cd_val
    and b.tgt_tab_name = 'T03_AGT_STAT_H'
    and b.tgt_tab_fld  = 'Agt_Stat_Cd'
    and b.src_tab_name = 'REF_TRS'
    and b.src_fld_name = 'CONTR_STATUS'
    and b.src_sys_name = 'TIT'
  left join PDATA_N.REF_CD_CVT_MAP c                           --TRADESTATUS 转码
    on a.sub_trd_trd_stat_cd = c.dw_cd_val
    and c.tgt_tab_name = 'T98_OTC_OPT_COMP_SUB_TRD_BASE_INFO'
    and c.tgt_tab_fld  = 'Sub_Trd_Trd_Stat_Cd'
    and c.src_tab_name = 'V_RISK_OPTION_INFO'
    and c.src_fld_name = 'TRADESTATUS'
    and c.src_sys_name = 'TIT'
  left join (
    select agt_clas_cd as business_type,agt_id as key_otc_trade_id
    from PDATA_N.T03_AGT_CLAS_H  
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE'
      and strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) tot
    ON a.opt_comp_agt_id = tot.key_otc_trade_id
  left join MAPPING ON a.opt_comp_agt_id = MAPPING.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID
  left join (
    select book_agt_id as key_book_id,map_undrl_cd as mapping_wind_code
    from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_ADTNL_INFO
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) rb_ori 
    on mapping.key_book_id_from = rb_ori.key_book_id
  left join (
      select opt_comp_agt_id as key_otc_trade_id,src_prd_id as underlying_ins_id,bask_type as basket_type
      from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_STRU_ELMN_INFO 
      where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_OPTION_DEAL_STRUCTURE'
        and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) rods  
    on a.opt_comp_agt_id = rods.key_otc_trade_id
  left join (
      select opt_comp_agt_id as key_otc_trade_id,fred_fee_paid_date as front_fee_payment_date,term_days as time_to_maturity
      from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO
      where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_OTC_OPTION_DEAL'
        and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) rood
    ON tot.key_otc_trade_id = ROOD.key_otc_trade_id
  left join (
        select in_code as key_instrument_id,undrl_clas as summary_mapping 
        from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info 
        where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01' 
  ) RI  
    ON rods.underlying_ins_id = ri.key_instrument_id
  left join (
      select a.book_agt_id,a.bel_dept,a.cntr,b.agt_full_name
      from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_ADTNL_INFO a
      left join PDATA_N.T03_AGT_NAME_H b 
        on a.book_agt_id = b.agt_id and b.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK' and b.strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and b.end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
      where a.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) rb 
    on MAPPING.KEY_BOOK_ID_TO = RB.book_agt_id
where a.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_V_RISK_OPTION_INFO'
  and a.busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'

	data_time,
	busi_date FROM (
	 


select
    a.opt_comp_agt_id                                                          as key_otc_trade_id
   ,a.sub_trd_id                                                               as trade_id
   ,a.src_agt_type_cd                                                          as contract_type                     --期权合约类型
   ,a.src_agt_sub_type_cd                                                      as contract_sub_type                 --期权合约子类型
   ,regexp_replace(a.cutp_pty_id,'TIT060-','TITANS_')                          as counterparty_id                   --交易对手ID
   ,a.cutp_pty_shor_name                                                       as counterparty                      --交易对手
   ,case a.cutp_type_cd when '1' then 'COMPANY'
                      when '2' then 'PRODUCT'
                      when '0' then 'INDIVIDUAL'
                      else  a.cutp_type_cd end                                 as ctpty_type                        --期权合约类型
   ,a.cutp_legal_enty                                                          as manager_name
   ,a.cutp_prd_id                                                              as ins_record_code
   ,a.encb_pric                                                                as barrierspct
   ,rb.agt_full_name                                                           as book
   ,nvl(b.src_cd_val,a.opt_comp_stat_cd)                                       as contr_status                      --期权合约状态
   ,nvl(c.src_cd_val,a.sub_trd_trd_stat_cd)                                    as tradestatus
   ,a.opt_sler_cutp_shor_name                                                  as contract_seller                   --期权卖方

           then (case a.buy_sell_dir_cd when '2' then 'Buy' 
                                        when '1' then 'Sell' end)   
    else (case a.buy_sell_dir_cd when '1' then 'Buy' 
                                 when '2' then 'Sell'end) end                  as buy_sell

   ,a.down_redp_encb                                                           as callabletriggerdown
   ,a.up_redp_encb                                                             as callabletriggerup

   ,a.redp_yield                                                               as callsize
   ,a.call_exer_pric                                                           as callstrike
   ,a.opt_init_nom_prin                                                        as contract_fined

   ,a.up_coup_rate_encb                                                        as couponbarrierupout

   ,a.ko_encb                                                                  as barrier_pct                       --敲出障碍(%)
   ,a.down_accum_coef                                                          as cum_coef                          --下累计系数

   ,a.pay_delay_days                                                           as payment_defer_days                --敲出结算日在敲出日基础上递延天数

   ,a.fix_amt                                                                  as fixed_amount                      --每日若为上方累计支付固定金额值
   ,a.prtc_pd_strt_date                                                        as guarantee_period_start_date       --保护期开始日   
   ,a.prtc_pd_end_date                                                         as guarantee_period_end_date         --保护期结束日   
   ,a.ko_sett_date                                                             as ko_settle_date                    --敲出后结算日    
   ,a.obsv_scop_trd_days_str                                                   as obs_days                          --每个结算期观察日天数
   ,a.obsv_scop_sett_date_str                                                  as settlement_schedule               --合约所有的定期结算日日期
   ,a.obsv_scop_pay_date_str                                                   as payment_schedule                  --合约所有的定期兑付日日期
   ,a.opt_sub_trd_nom_prin                                                     as abs_fined
   ,a.prtc_rate                                                                as contract_rate
   ,a.prtc_rate                                                                as contract_rate2
   ,a.qty                                                                      as amount
   ,a.ko_yield                                                                 as option_rebate
   ,a.opt_fee                                                                  as premium_cost

   ,a.call_put_type_cd                                                         as rise_fall
   ,a.up_encb_type                                                             as up_obstruct

   ,a.undrl_cd                                                                 as wind_code
   ,concat(substr(a.obsv_pd_type_cd,1,1),lower(substr(a.obsv_pd_type_cd,2)))   as monitoring_duration
   ,a.obsv_strt_date                                                           as begin_date
   ,a.obsv_day_coup_rate_str                                                   as couponrate
   ,a.obsv_end_date                                                            as end_date
   ,a.creator                                                                  as entered_user
   ,a.exp_date                                                                 as final_date
   ,a.inr_comp_no                                                              as internal_reference
   ,a.coup_encb_obsv_day_str                                                   as p_coupondates
   ,a.prd_abbr                                                                 as qx
   ,a.obsv_strt_date                                                           as start_date                        
   ,a.src_prd_sub_type                                                         as sub_type
   ,rods.basket_type                                                           as basket_type                       --篮子类型
   ,''                                                                         as amortization_type
   ,''                                                                         as fee_rebate_amount

   ,''                                                                         as hedge

   ,''                                                                         as notional_exchange_final
   ,''                                                                         as notional_exchange_initial
   ,''                                                                         as payment_daycount
   ,''                                                                         as accrualdates
   ,''                                                                         as trading_portfolio
   ,a.risk_obsv_date_str                                                       as p_kidates
   ,null                                                                       as nranges

select
    a.opt_comp_agt_id                                                          as key_otc_trade_id
   ,a.sub_trd_id                                                               as trade_id
   ,a.src_agt_type_cd                                                          as contract_type                     --期权合约类型
   ,a.src_agt_sub_type_cd                                                      as contract_sub_type                 --期权合约子类型
   ,regexp_replace(a.cutp_pty_id,'TIT060-','TITANS_')                          as counterparty_id                   --交易对手ID
   ,a.cutp_pty_shor_name                                                       as counterparty                      --交易对手
   ,case a.cutp_type_cd when '1' then 'COMPANY'
                      when '2' then 'PRODUCT'
                      when '0' then 'INDIVIDUAL'
                      else  a.cutp_type_cd end                                 as ctpty_type                        --期权合约类型
   ,a.cutp_legal_enty                                                          as manager_name
   ,a.cutp_prd_id                                                              as ins_record_code
   ,a.encb_pric                                                                as barrierspct
   ,rb.agt_full_name                                                           as book
   ,nvl(b.src_cd_val,a.opt_comp_stat_cd)                                       as contr_status                      --期权合约状态
   ,nvl(c.src_cd_val,a.sub_trd_trd_stat_cd)                                    as tradestatus
   ,a.opt_sler_cutp_shor_name                                                  as contract_seller                   --期权卖方
   ,case when mapping.key_book_id_from != mapping.key_book_id_to 
           then (case a.buy_sell_dir_cd when '2' then 'Buy' 
                                        when '1' then 'Sell' end)   
    else (case a.buy_sell_dir_cd when '1' then 'Buy' 
                                 when '2' then 'Sell'end) end                  as buy_sell
   ,a.up_redp_encb_pct                                                         as callabletrigger
   ,a.down_redp_encb                                                           as callabletriggerdown
   ,a.up_redp_encb                                                             as callabletriggerup
   ,a.call_max_los                                                             as callcap
   ,a.redp_yield                                                               as callsize
   ,a.call_exer_pric                                                           as callstrike
   ,a.opt_init_nom_prin                                                        as contract_fined
   ,a.down_coup_rate_encb                                                      as couponbarrierdownout
   ,a.up_coup_rate_encb                                                        as couponbarrierupout
   ,if(a.ko_imdt_pay_flag = '1','true',null)                                   as couponpaidatko
   ,a.obsv_day_coup_rate_str                                                   as couponrates
   ,a.two_val_opt_qty                                                          as digital_amount
   ,a.eur_ame_exec_type                                                        as dr_style
   ,a.down_encb_type                                                           as dw_obstruct
   ,a.down_encb_pric                                                           as dw_obstruct_price
   ,a.down_ki_encb                                                             as kibarrier
   ,a.down_risk_encb                                                           as kibarrierdown
   ,a.up_risk_encb                                                             as kibarrierup
   ,a.exp_date                                                                 as maturity_date
   ,a.un_redp_yield                                                            as noncallsize
   ,a.un_ki_yield                                                              as nonkisize
   ,a.redp_obsv_date_str                                                       as p_callabledates
   ,a.pay_plan_term_days                                                       as plane_term
   ,a.call_prtc_rate                                                           as prcall
   ,a.opt_fee_rate                                                             as premium_rate
   ,a.fee_arr_date                                                             as profit_date                       --
   ,a.put_prtc_rate                                                            as prput
   ,a.put_max_los                                                              as putcap
   ,a.put_exer_pric                                                            as putstrike
   ,a.exer_pric                                                                as strike_price
   ,a.actl_trmt_date                                                           as actual_terminate_date             
   ,a.opt_scop_area_val_str                                                    as couponbarrier                     --票息障碍
   ,a.undrl_crrc_cd                                                            as underlying_currency
   ,a.undrl_bgng_pric                                                          as begin_price
   ,a.src_prd_sub_type_shor_name                                               as br_type
   ,a.ki_yield                                                                 as ki_size                           --敲入收益率
   ,a.scop_accum_obsv_date_str                                                 as obs_date
   ,a.lizard_ko_lvl                                                            as lizard_level
   ,a.lizard_real_bal_coup_rate_str                                            as netting_coupon_rate
   ,a.lizard_pay_date_str                                                      as delivery_date
   ,a.lizard_ki_date                                                           as event_date
   ,a.sub_trd_ko_date                                                          as knocked_out_date                  
   ,a.sub_trd_encb_trgr_line_date                                              as knocked_in_date                   
   ,a.ko_call_prtc_rate                                                        as knockout_extra_par
   ,a.disc_opps_rate                                                           as ki_discount_rate
   ,a.coll_pymt_amt                                                            as maturity_profit
   ,a.quanto_bgng_rate                                                         as fix_exchange_rate
   ,a.cross_crrc_type_cd                                                       as cross_currency_type
   ,a.sett_crrc_cd                                                             as payoff_currency
   ,a.opt_lbl                                                                  as optioncontractlabel
   ,a.up_ko_yield                                                              as up_rebate_percent
   ,a.down_ko_yield                                                            as down_rebate_percent
   ,a.opt_dir_type_cd                                                          as direction                         --期权合约方向
   ,a.accum_type                                                               as cumulator_type                    --产品类型,累购或累沽
   ,a.opt_exec_pric                                                            as strike_pct                        --执行价格(%)
   ,a.ko_encb                                                                  as barrier_pct                       --敲出障碍(%)
   ,a.down_accum_coef                                                          as cum_coef                          --下累计系数
   ,a.tdy_trd_qty                                                              as shares_per_day                    --每日基础累计股数
   ,a.bgng_pric                                                                as initial_spot                      --Mt其明初价格
   ,case when a.ko_flag = '1' then 'true'
         when a.ko_flag = '0' then 'false'
         else a.ko_flag end                                                    as hasko                             --是否已敲出
   ,case when a.ko_trmt_flag = '1' then 'true'
         when a.ko_trmt_flag = '0' then 'false'
         else a.ko_trmt_flag end                                               as is_ko_termination                 --是否为敲出终止型
   ,case when a.ko_cont_flag = '1' then 'true'
         when a.ko_cont_flag = '0' then 'false'
         else a.ko_cont_flag end                                               as is_ko_paid_eariler                --是否为敲出即付型
   ,a.trmt_defr_days                                                           as settlement_defer_days             --敲出结算日在敲出日基础上递延天数
   ,a.pay_delay_days                                                           as payment_defer_days                --敲出结算日在敲出日基础上递延天数
   ,a.up_accum_stk_prtc_rate                                                   as participate_rate                  --适用于上累计的股数
   ,a.fix_amt                                                                  as fixed_amount                      --每日若为上方累计支付固定金额值
   ,a.prtc_pd_strt_date                                                        as guarantee_period_start_date       --保护期开始日   
   ,a.prtc_pd_end_date                                                         as guarantee_period_end_date         --保护期结束日   
   ,a.ko_sett_date                                                             as ko_settle_date                    --敲出后结算日    
   ,a.obsv_scop_trd_days_str                                                   as obs_days                          --每个结算期观察日天数
   ,a.obsv_scop_sett_date_str                                                  as settlement_schedule               --合约所有的定期结算日日期
   ,a.obsv_scop_pay_date_str                                                   as payment_schedule                  --合约所有的定期兑付日日期
   ,a.opt_sub_trd_nom_prin                                                     as abs_fined
   ,a.prtc_rate                                                                as contract_rate
   ,a.prtc_rate                                                                as contract_rate2
   ,a.qty                                                                      as amount
   ,a.ko_yield                                                                 as option_rebate
   ,a.opt_fee                                                                  as premium_cost
   ,a.opt_fee_paid_date                                                        as premium_date
   ,a.call_put_type_cd                                                         as rise_fall
   ,a.up_encb_type                                                             as up_obstruct
   ,a.up_encb_pric                                                             as up_obstruct_price
   ,a.undrl_cd                                                                 as wind_code
   ,concat(substr(a.obsv_pd_type_cd,1,1),lower(substr(a.obsv_pd_type_cd,2)))   as monitoring_duration
   ,a.obsv_strt_date                                                           as begin_date
   ,a.obsv_day_coup_rate_str                                                   as couponrate
   ,a.obsv_end_date                                                            as end_date
   ,a.creator                                                                  as entered_user
   ,a.exp_date                                                                 as final_date
   ,a.inr_comp_no                                                              as internal_reference
   ,a.coup_encb_obsv_day_str                                                   as p_coupondates
   ,a.prd_abbr                                                                 as qx
   ,a.obsv_strt_date                                                           as start_date                        
   ,a.src_prd_sub_type                                                         as sub_type
   ,rods.basket_type                                                           as basket_type                       --篮子类型
   ,''                                                                         as amortization_type
   ,''                                                                         as fee_rebate_amount
   ,''                                                                         as fixed_rate
   ,''                                                                         as hedge
   ,''                                                                         as notional_exchange_amortization
   ,''                                                                         as notional_exchange_final
   ,''                                                                         as notional_exchange_initial
   ,''                                                                         as payment_daycount
   ,''                                                                         as accrualdates
   ,''                                                                         as trading_portfolio
   ,a.risk_obsv_date_str                                                       as p_kidates
   ,null                                                                       as nranges                           
   ,null                                                                       as payment_freq                      
   ,null                                                                       as struct    
   ,null                                                                       as bundle_id                        
   ,rb.bel_dept                                                                as department
   ,rb.cntr                                                                    as desk
   ,a.obsv_scop_schd_end_date_str                                              as schedule_end_date
   ,a.auto_call_opt_fee_rate                                                   as autocall_premium_rate
   ,a.trmt_ki                                                                  as termination_knock_in
   ,a.obsv_scop_drop_qty_str                                                   as actual_settlement_qty
   ,if(nvl(rb_ori.mapping_wind_code,'')='',ri.summary_mapping,rb_ori.mapping_wind_code)    as underlying_summary_mapping  --汇总分类
   ,tot.business_type                                                                      as business_type               --业务类型
   ,rood.front_fee_payment_date                                                            as front_fee_payment_date      --前端费支付日
   ,rood.time_to_maturity                                                                  as time_to_maturity            --期限
   ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')                                  as data_time
   ,'${yyyy-MM-dd,-1e}'                                                                    as busi_date
from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_OPT_COMP_SUB_TRD_BASE_INFO a
  left join PDATA_N.REF_CD_CVT_MAP b                           --CONTR_STATUS 转码
    on a.opt_comp_stat_cd = b.dw_cd_val
    and b.tgt_tab_name = 'T03_AGT_STAT_H'
    and b.tgt_tab_fld  = 'Agt_Stat_Cd'
    and b.src_tab_name = 'REF_TRS'
    and b.src_fld_name = 'CONTR_STATUS'
    and b.src_sys_name = 'TIT'
  left join PDATA_N.REF_CD_CVT_MAP c                           --TRADESTATUS 转码
    on a.sub_trd_trd_stat_cd = c.dw_cd_val
    and c.tgt_tab_name = 'T98_OTC_OPT_COMP_SUB_TRD_BASE_INFO'
    and c.tgt_tab_fld  = 'Sub_Trd_Trd_Stat_Cd'
    and c.src_tab_name = 'V_RISK_OPTION_INFO'
    and c.src_fld_name = 'TRADESTATUS'
    and c.src_sys_name = 'TIT'
  left join (
    select agt_clas_cd as business_type,agt_id as key_otc_trade_id
    from PDATA_N.T03_AGT_CLAS_H  
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE'
      and strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) tot
    ON a.opt_comp_agt_id = tot.key_otc_trade_id
  left join MAPPING ON a.opt_comp_agt_id = MAPPING.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID
  left join (
    select book_agt_id as key_book_id,map_undrl_cd as mapping_wind_code
    from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_ADTNL_INFO
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) rb_ori 
    on mapping.key_book_id_from = rb_ori.key_book_id
  left join (
      select opt_comp_agt_id as key_otc_trade_id,src_prd_id as underlying_ins_id,bask_type as basket_type
      from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_STRU_ELMN_INFO 
      where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_OPTION_DEAL_STRUCTURE'
        and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) rods  
    on a.opt_comp_agt_id = rods.key_otc_trade_id
  left join (
      select opt_comp_agt_id as key_otc_trade_id,fred_fee_paid_date as front_fee_payment_date,term_days as time_to_maturity
      from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO
      where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_OTC_OPTION_DEAL'
        and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) rood
    ON tot.key_otc_trade_id = ROOD.key_otc_trade_id
  left join (
        select in_code as key_instrument_id,undrl_clas as summary_mapping 
        from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info 
        where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01' 
  ) RI  
    ON rods.underlying_ins_id = ri.key_instrument_id
  left join (
      select a.book_agt_id,a.bel_dept,a.cntr,b.agt_full_name
      from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_ADTNL_INFO a
      left join PDATA_N.T03_AGT_NAME_H b 
        on a.book_agt_id = b.agt_id and b.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK' and b.strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and b.end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
      where a.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) rb 
    on MAPPING.KEY_BOOK_ID_TO = RB.book_agt_id
where a.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_V_RISK_OPTION_INFO'
  and a.busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' 
	) castTable

SELECT
DR.BUSI_DATE as src_busi_date, --日期
DR.BUNDLE_ID, --组合编号
TOT.INTERNAL_TRADE_ID, --合约编号
BU.UNDERLYING_INFO AS UNDERLYING_INFO, --标的证券
BUT.UNDERLYING_TYPE AS INTEROTC_NAME, --标的类型
CASE WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'DIGITAL' THEN '二值'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'EUROPEAN_VANILLA' THEN '欧式香草'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'SPREAD' THEN '价差'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'SHARKFIN' THEN '鲨鱼鳍'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'BUTTERFLY' THEN '蝶式'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'STRADDLE' THEN '跨式'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'BARRIER' THEN '障碍'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'DAILYRANGEACCRUAL' THEN '区间累积'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'AUTOCALL' THEN '自动赎回'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'AIRBAG' THEN '安全气囊'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'RISKY' THEN 'Risky'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'AMERICAN_VANILLA' THEN '美式香草'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'PARTICIPATORY' THEN '参与型看涨'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'AIRBAGX' THEN '安全气囊X'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'LADDER_CALL' THEN '阶梯看涨'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'ACCUMULATOR' THEN '累购'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'DECCUMULATOR' THEN '累沽'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'AIRBAGL' THEN '安全气囊L'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'KIPUT' THEN '敲入看跌'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'AIRBAGM' THEN '安全气囊M'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'CUSTOMISED' THEN '自定义'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'CALL_SWAP' THEN '多头互换'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'PUT_SWAP' THEN '空头互换'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'LEND_SWAP' THEN '借券互换'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'INDEX_ENHANCE_SWAP' THEN '指数增强'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'S_CROSS_SWAP' THEN '南下跨境'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'N_CROSS_SWAP' THEN '北上跨境'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'CROSS_LEND_SWAP' THEN '跨境借券'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'AB_LONG_SWAP' THEN '项目多头'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'AB_SHORT_SWAP' THEN '项目空头'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'LONG_HOLD_SWAP' THEN '多头持券'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'N_CROSS_QFII_SWAP' THEN '北上QFII'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'N_CROSS_FUTURE_SWAP' THEN '北上跨境(期货)'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'S_CROSS_FUTURE_SWAP' THEN '南下跨境(期货)'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'CHN_FUTURE_SWAP' THEN '境内互换(期货)'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'FEE_SWAP' THEN '互换费用'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'HK_LONG_HOLD_SWAP' THEN '香港多头持券'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'S_CROSS_OPTION_SWAP' THEN '南下跨境(场内期权)'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'SBL' THEN 'SBL'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'LONG_SHORT_SWAP' THEN '多空互换'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'N_CROSS_DMA_SWAP' THEN '北上极速'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'FLAT_LONG_SHORT_SWAP' THEN '平层多空'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'DOMESTIC_DMA_SHORT_SWAP' THEN '境内空头(极速)'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'DOMESTIC_DMA_LONG_SWAP' THEN '境内多头(极速)'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'S_CROSS_DMA_SHORT_SWAP' THEN '南下空头(极速)'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'S_CROSS_DMA_LONG_SWAP' THEN '南下多头(极速)'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'CHN_BOND_SWAP' THEN '境内互换(债券)'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'Regular' THEN '普通组合'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'ShortNORMAL' THEN '普通借券'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'ShortDT' THEN '可转债套利'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'LSDMA' THEN '多空互换'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'CSTLendswap' THEN '多空组合'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'CSTLLSnoowball' THEN '券抵不追保雪球'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'CSTOption' THEN '券抵期权'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'N_CROSS_AB_SWAP' THEN '北上产品'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'S_CROSS_FUTURE_SWAP' THEN '南下跨境期货'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'SPDTRS' THEN '互换极速'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'NSPDTRS' THEN '北上极速'
WHEN DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'N_CROSS_FUTURE_SWAP' THEN '北上跨境期货'
When DR.BUSI_TYPE = 'OTHERS' THEN '其它'
ELSE DR.BUSI_TYPE END AS BUSI_TYPE, --业务类型!
BA.MTM_CURRENCY, --盯市币种
CTPTY.CTPTY_SHORT_NAME, --交易对手
DR.DYNAMIC_NOTIONAL, --名义本金
DR.MGR_BALANCE, --批次保证金余额
CB.CURRENT_BALANCE, --实时保证金余额
DR.MRG_WITHDRAWED, --可提取保证金
DR.MRG_RATE, --履约保障比例(%)
CASE WHEN DR.MGR_STATUS = 0 THEN '正常'
WHEN DR.MGR_STATUS = '1' THEN '预警'
WHEN DR.MGR_STATUS = '2' THEN '追保'
WHEN DR.MGR_STATUS = '3' THEN '未知'
WHEN DR.MGR_STATUS = '4' THEN '平仓'
ELSE DR.MGR_STATUS END AS MGR_STATUS,--履保状态
DR.MGR_REMARGINABLE, --需追加金额
CP.INITIAL_MARGIN,--保证金初始线(%)
CP.WARNING, --保证金预警线(%)
CP.MARGIN_CALL, --保证金追保线(%)
CP.WITHDRAW, --保证金提取线(%)
CP.WITHDRAW_FLOOR, --保证金提取维持线(%)
CP.MARGIN_CALL_FLOOR, --保证金追保维持线(%)
CP.BASIC_MARGIN_RATE, --基础保证金率(%)
DR.DYNAMIC_NOTIONAL AS NOTIONAL1, --名义本金1
CP.FLOAT_PNL, --收益
CP.INNER_VALUE, --内在价值
CP.INNER_VALUE AS MARK_INNER_VALUE, --盯市价值
CP.FEE AS UNPAY_FEE, --应付未付费用
CP.FEE, --费用
CP.ACCRUED_INTEREST, --累计应计利息
DR.DYNAMIC_NOTIONAL AS NOTIONAL_OR_VALUE, --分母的动态名义本金或市值
'0' AS NOTIONAL2, --名义本金2
CP.MARKET_VALUE, --浮动市值
DR.UPDATED_DATETIME, --最近一次计算时间
DR.ADVANCE_AMOUNT, --垫资金额
DR.MGR_REMARGINABLE + NVL(DR.ADVANCE_AMOUNT,0) AS ADD_REMARGINABLE, --合计应追加金额
CASE WHEN DR.ADVANCE_AMOUNT > 0 THEN '是'
WHEN DR.ADVANCE_AMOUNT <= 0 THEN '否' END AS ADVANCE_STATUS, --垫资状态
DR.SUPPORT_MARGIN, --履保类型
DR.MARGIN_GREEKS, --保证金敞口
MP.CUSTOM_RATIO, --客户系数
DR.CALL_REQUIRE,--履约保障要求
DR.CALL_REQUIRE AS MARGIN_REQUIRE,--追保维持要求
DR.WITHDRAW_REQUIRE, --提取维持要求
CP.PV, -- pv
CP.PV1, -- pv1
CP.PV2, -- pv2
CP.PV3, -- pv3
CP.PV4, -- pv4
CP.PV5, -- pv5
CP.PV6, -- pv6
DR.IS_CALC, -- 是否履保
BA.TRD_COMPOSITION, -- 用途
NVL(RB.DEPARTMENT,DR.DEPARTMENT) AS DEPARTMENT , -- 所属部门
CTPTY.CTPTY_LONG_NAME, -- 交易对手长名
BA.KEY_CTPTY_ID,  --交易对手ID
from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') as DATA_TIME, --数据时间
'${yyyy-MM-dd}' as busi_date    --业务日期
FROM
BUNDLE_MARGIN_DAILY_RESULT DR
left JOIN (select *
from BUNDLE_DAILY_CONTR_PARAM
where IS_BUNDLE_VIEW = 'Y'
-- AND KEY_INSTRUMENT_ID <> '-'
) CP
ON DR.BUNDLE_ID = CP.BUNDLE_ID
AND to_date(DR.BUSI_DATE) = to_date(CP.BUSI_DATE)
INNER JOIN MARGIN_BUNDLE_ACCT BA ON DR.BUNDLE_ID = BA.BUNDLE_ID AND BA.TRD_COMPOSITION IN ('OPTION','TRS','MIXTURE','N_CROSS_DMA')
INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT BUNDLE_ID FROM MARGIN_ACCT_BUNDLE_MAPPING) MCB ON MCB.BUNDLE_ID = DR.BUNDLE_ID
LEFT JOIN (
SELECT KEY_CTPTY_ID,MAX(CTPTY_SHORT_NAME) CTPTY_SHORT_NAME,max(CTPTY_LONG_NAME) CTPTY_LONG_NAME, MAX(CTPTY_DEPARTMENT) CTPTY_DEPARTMENT
FROM MARGIN_ACCOUNT ma
GROUP BY KEY_CTPTY_ID
) CTPTY ON CTPTY.KEY_CTPTY_ID = BA.KEY_CTPTY_ID
LEFT JOIN TRD_OTC_TRADE TOT
ON CP.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID = TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID
LEFT JOIN REF_BOOK RB
ON TOT.KEY_BOOK_ID = RB.KEY_BOOK_ID
LEFT JOIN MARGIN_PLAN MP
ON BA.KEY_PLAN_ID = MP.ID
LEFT JOIN CURRENT_BALANCE_T CB
ON DR.BUNDLE_ID = CB.BUNDLE_ID
LEFT JOIN BUNDLE_UNDERLYING BU
ON DR.BUNDLE_ID = BU.BUNDLE_ID and DR.BUSI_DATE = BU.BUSI_DATE
LEFT JOIN BUNDLE_UNDERLYING_TYPE BUT
ON DR.BUNDLE_ID = BUT.BUNDLE_ID
