CB.CURRENT_BALANCE, --实时保证金余额
DR.MRG_WITHDRAWED, --可提取保证金
DR.MRG_RATE, --履约保障比例(%)
CASE WHEN DR.MGR_STATUS = 0 THEN '正常'
WHEN DR.MGR_STATUS = '1' THEN '预警'
WHEN DR.MGR_STATUS = '2' THEN '追保'
WHEN DR.MGR_STATUS = '3' THEN '未知'
WHEN DR.MGR_STATUS = '4' THEN '平仓'
ELSE DR.MGR_STATUS END AS MGR_STATUS,--履保状态
DR.MGR_REMARGINABLE, --需追加金额
CP.INITIAL_MARGIN,--保证金初始线(%)
CP.WARNING, --保证金预警线(%)
CP.MARGIN_CALL, --保证金追保线(%)
CP.WITHDRAW, --保证金提取线(%)
CP.WITHDRAW_FLOOR, --保证金提取维持线(%)
CP.MARGIN_CALL_FLOOR, --保证金追保维持线(%)
CP.BASIC_MARGIN_RATE, --基础保证金率(%)
DR.DYNAMIC_NOTIONAL AS NOTIONAL1, --名义本金1
CP.FLOAT_PNL, --收益
CP.INNER_VALUE, --内在价值
CP.INNER_VALUE AS MARK_INNER_VALUE, --盯市价值
CP.FEE AS UNPAY_FEE, --应付未付费用
CP.FEE, --费用
CP.ACCRUED_INTEREST, --累计应计利息
DR.DYNAMIC_NOTIONAL AS NOTIONAL_OR_VALUE, --分母的动态名义本金或市值
'0' AS NOTIONAL2, --名义本金2
CP.MARKET_VALUE, --浮动市值
DR.UPDATED_DATETIME, --最近一次计算时间
DR.ADVANCE_AMOUNT, --垫资金额
DR.MGR_REMARGINABLE + NVL(DR.ADVANCE_AMOUNT,0) AS ADD_REMARGINABLE, --合计应追加金额
CASE WHEN DR.ADVANCE_AMOUNT > 0 THEN '是'
WHEN DR.ADVANCE_AMOUNT <= 0 THEN '否' END AS ADVANCE_STATUS, --垫资状态
DR.SUPPORT_MARGIN, --履保类型
DR.MARGIN_GREEKS, --保证金敞口
MP.CUSTOM_RATIO, --客户系数
DR.CALL_REQUIRE,--履约保障要求
DR.CALL_REQUIRE AS MARGIN_REQUIRE,--追保维持要求
DR.WITHDRAW_REQUIRE, --提取维持要求
CP.PV, -- pv
CP.PV1, -- pv1
CP.PV2, -- pv2
CP.PV3, -- pv3
CP.PV4, -- pv4
CP.PV5, -- pv5
CP.PV6, -- pv6
DR.IS_CALC, -- 是否履保
BA.TRD_COMPOSITION, -- 用途
NVL(RB.DEPARTMENT,DR.DEPARTMENT) AS DEPARTMENT , -- 所属部门
CTPTY.CTPTY_LONG_NAME, -- 交易对手长名
BA.KEY_CTPTY_ID,  --交易对手ID
from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') as DATA_TIME, --数据时间
'${yyyy-MM-dd}' as busi_date    --业务日期
FROM
BUNDLE_MARGIN_DAILY_RESULT DR
left JOIN (select *
from BUNDLE_DAILY_CONTR_PARAM
where IS_BUNDLE_VIEW = 'Y'
-- AND KEY_INSTRUMENT_ID <> '-'
) CP
ON DR.BUNDLE_ID = CP.BUNDLE_ID
AND to_date(DR.BUSI_DATE) = to_date(CP.BUSI_DATE)
INNER JOIN MARGIN_BUNDLE_ACCT BA ON DR.BUNDLE_ID = BA.BUNDLE_ID AND BA.TRD_COMPOSITION IN ('OPTION','TRS','MIXTURE','N_CROSS_DMA')
INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT BUNDLE_ID FROM MARGIN_ACCT_BUNDLE_MAPPING) MCB ON MCB.BUNDLE_ID = DR.BUNDLE_ID
LEFT JOIN (
SELECT KEY_CTPTY_ID,MAX(CTPTY_SHORT_NAME) CTPTY_SHORT_NAME,max(CTPTY_LONG_NAME) CTPTY_LONG_NAME, MAX(CTPTY_DEPARTMENT) CTPTY_DEPARTMENT
FROM MARGIN_ACCOUNT ma
GROUP BY KEY_CTPTY_ID
) CTPTY ON CTPTY.KEY_CTPTY_ID = BA.KEY_CTPTY_ID
LEFT JOIN TRD_OTC_TRADE TOT
ON CP.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID = TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID
LEFT JOIN REF_BOOK RB
ON TOT.KEY_BOOK_ID = RB.KEY_BOOK_ID
LEFT JOIN MARGIN_PLAN MP
ON BA.KEY_PLAN_ID = MP.ID
LEFT JOIN CURRENT_BALANCE_T CB
ON DR.BUNDLE_ID = CB.BUNDLE_ID
LEFT JOIN BUNDLE_UNDERLYING BU
ON DR.BUNDLE_ID = BU.BUNDLE_ID and DR.BUSI_DATE = BU.BUSI_DATE
LEFT JOIN BUNDLE_UNDERLYING_TYPE BUT
ON DR.BUNDLE_ID = BUT.BUNDLE_ID 
	) castTable

targetRelations.sourceText:
select
        nvl(if(rb.Map_Undrl_Cd='',null,rb.Map_Undrl_Cd),ins.undrl_clas) as Map_Undrl_Cd,
        sum(b.Tdy_Yield) as Tdy_Yield,
        b.busi_date
    from (
        select * from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_BOOK_HOLD_SUM
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_POSITION_DAILY' and busi_date >= '2022-01-01'
        ) b
    inner join (
        select * from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_ADTNL_INFO
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Cntr = 'DYNAMIC_HEDGING'
        ) rb
    on rb.Book_Agt_Id = b.Book_Agt_Id
    left join (
        select * from PDATA_N.T03_AGT_PRD_RELA_H
        where SRC_TBL = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE' and Agt_Prd_Rela_Type_Cd = '01'
            and strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
        ) tot
    on b.Src_Prd_Id = tot.Src_Prd_Id
    left join (
        select *
        from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_LEG_INFO
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_TRS_LEG' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'STRUCTURE_LEG_TYPE'
        ) leg
    on leg.Swap_Comp_Agt_Id = tot.Agt_Id 
    left join (
        select * from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_HOLD_INFO
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_TRS_LEG_HIS_POS' and busi_date >= '2022-01-01'
        ) leg_pos
    on leg_pos.Leg_Glbl_Seq_No = leg.Leg_Glbl_Seq_No and leg_pos.busi_date = b.busi_date
    left join (
        select * from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info
        where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01'
        ) ins
    on ins.in_code = coalesce(leg_pos.Src_Prd_Id, b.Src_Prd_Id)
    group by nvl(if(rb.Map_Undrl_Cd='',null,rb.Map_Undrl_Cd),ins.undrl_clas), b.busi_date

        ) rb
    on rb.Book_Agt_Id = b.Book_Agt_Id
    left join (
        select * from PDATA_N.T03_AGT_PRD_RELA_H
        where SRC_TBL = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE' and Agt_Prd_Rela_Type_Cd = '01'
            and strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
        ) tot
    on b.Src_Prd_Id = tot.Src_Prd_Id
    left join (
        select *
        from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_LEG_INFO
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_TRS_LEG' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'STRUCTURE_LEG_TYPE'
        ) leg
    on leg.Swap_Comp_Agt_Id = tot.Agt_Id 
    left join (
        select * from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_HOLD_INFO

        ) leg_pos

    left join (
        select * from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info
        where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01'
        ) ins
    on ins.in_code = coalesce(leg_pos.Src_Prd_Id, b.Src_Prd_Id)
    group by nvl(if(rb.Map_Undrl_Cd='',null,rb.Map_Undrl_Cd),ins.undrl_clas), b.busi_date

        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Cntr = 'DYNAMIC_HEDGING'
        ) rb
    on rb.Book_Agt_Id = b.Book_Agt_Id
    left join (
        select * from PDATA_N.T03_AGT_PRD_RELA_H
        where SRC_TBL = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE' and Agt_Prd_Rela_Type_Cd = '01'
            and strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
        ) tot
    on b.Src_Prd_Id = tot.Src_Prd_Id
    left join (
        select *
        from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_LEG_INFO
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_TRS_LEG' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'STRUCTURE_LEG_TYPE'
        ) leg
    on leg.Swap_Comp_Agt_Id = tot.Agt_Id 
    left join (
        select * from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_HOLD_INFO
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_TRS_LEG_HIS_POS' and busi_date >= '2022-01-01'
        ) leg_pos
    on leg_pos.Leg_Glbl_Seq_No = leg.Leg_Glbl_Seq_No and leg_pos.busi_date = b.busi_date
    left join (
        select * from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info
        where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01'
        ) ins
    on ins.in_code = coalesce(leg_pos.Src_Prd_Id, b.Src_Prd_Id)
    group by nvl(if(rb.Map_Undrl_Cd='',null,rb.Map_Undrl_Cd),ins.undrl_clas), b.busi_date
    ) u
on info.undrl_wd_cd = u.Map_Undrl_Cd and det.busi_date = u.busi_date

select
    info.Agt_Id,  --合约编号
    info.Busi_Type,  --业务类型
    info.Cutp_Pty_Id,  --交易对手客户编号
    info.Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name,  --交易对手当事人简称
    info.Cutp_Pty_Full_Name,  --交易对手当事人名称
    info.Sign_Prd_Name,  --代签产品名称
    cp.USCC,  --统一社会信用代码
    info.Contr_Type_Cd,  --合约类型代码
    info.Contr_Type_Desc,  --合约类型描述
    info.Src_Contr_Type,  --源合约类型
    info.Src_Contr_Type_Desc,  --源合约类型描述
    info.Src_Sub_Contr_Type,  --源合约子类型
    info.Src_Sub_Contr_Type_Desc,  --源合约子类型描述
    info.Undrl_Wd_Cd,  --标的万得代码
    info.Undrl_Name,  --标的名称
    info.Init_Nom_Prin,  --初始名义本金
    coalesce(det.Dyna_Nom_Prin, 0) as Dyna_Nom_Prin,  --动态名义本金
    case when info.Src_Contr_Type in ('RISKY','AIRBAGX') and (info.Undrl_Curr = 'CNY' or (info.Cros_Crrc_Type_Cd = 'COMPOSITE' and info.Undrl_Curr = 'HKD')) then (fee.OTHER_Prvs_Fee + if(cast(fee.PREMIUM_Prvs_Fee as double) <= 0, 0, fee.PREMIUM_Prvs_Fee * (1 - 1 / info.Opt_Fee_Rate * co_c.CAPITAL_COST / if(coalesce(info.Marg_Agt_Id,'') = '', 1, (1 - info.Init_Marg_Prop)/(1 - info.Base_Marg_Rate))))) * coalesce(mid.mid_price,1)
         when info.Src_Contr_Type in ('RISKY','AIRBAGX') and info.Cros_Crrc_Type_Cd = 'FLEXO' then (fee.OTHER_Prvs_Fee + if(cast(fee.PREMIUM_Prvs_Fee as double) <= 0, 0, fee.PREMIUM_Prvs_Fee - det.Dyna_Nom_Prin * (coalesce(cr.ir/100,0) + co.CAPITAL_COST - if(coalesce(info.Marg_Agt_Id,'') = '', info.Init_Marg_Prop, info.Base_Marg_Rate) * co_c.CAPITAL_COST) / 365)) * coalesce(mid.mid_price,1)
         when info.Src_Contr_Type in ('RISKY','AIRBAGX') then (fee.OTHER_Prvs_Fee + if(cast(fee.PREMIUM_Prvs_Fee as double) <= 0, 0, fee.PREMIUM_Prvs_Fee - det.Dyna_Nom_Prin * (0.035 - if(coalesce(info.Marg_Agt_Id,'') = '', info.Init_Marg_Prop, info.Base_Marg_Rate) * co_c.CAPITAL_COST) / 365)) * coalesce(mid.mid_price,1)
         when info.Cntr = 'DYNAMIC_HEDGING' then (coalesce(pe.Simu_Hedg_Pal,0) + coalesce(pd.Tdy_Yield,0) + abs(coalesce(pe.delta,0))/sum(abs(coalesce(pe.delta,0))) over(partition by pe.Undrl_Sum_Compr, pe.busi_date) * (coalesce(u.Tdy_Yield,0) - sum(coalesce(pe.Simu_Hedg_Pal,0)) over(partition by pe.Undrl_Sum_Compr, pe.busi_date))) * coalesce(mid.mid_price,1)  --原数据均为结算币种，用人民币中间汇率转换
         when info.Cntr = 'STATIC_HEDGING' then coalesce(det.Init_Nom_Prin, 0)/sum(if(info.Cutp_Pty_Id in ('DEV1100101715','DEV1100103266','DEV1100105899'),0,coalesce(info.Init_Nom_Prin, 0))) over(partition by info.prop_group, det.busi_date) * sum(coalesce(coalesce(pd.Tdy_Yield,0) * coalesce(mid.mid_price,1), 0)) over(partition by info.prop_group, det.busi_date)
         else 0 end AS Curr_Rev,  --当日计提创收
    case when info.Cntr = 'DYNAMIC_HEDGING' then if(info.Strt_Pric_Date = det.busi_date, info.Bgng_Npv * coalesce(mid.mid_price,1), 0)
         when info.Cntr = 'STATIC_HEDGING' then if(info.Strt_Pric_Date = det.busi_date, coalesce(det.Init_Nom_Prin, 0)/sum(if(info.Cutp_Pty_Id in ('DEV1100101715','DEV1100103266','DEV1100105899'),0,coalesce(info.Init_Nom_Prin, 0))) over(partition by info.prop_group, det.busi_date) * sum(coalesce(info.Bgng_Npv * coalesce(mid.mid_price,1), 0)) over(partition by info.prop_group, det.busi_date),0)
         else 0 end as Opt_Npv_Curr_Rev,  --当日期权NPV计提创收
    info.Strt_Pric_Date,  --期初定价日
    coalesce(info.Early_Term_Date, info.End_Pric_Date) as End_Pric_Date,  --期末定价日
    IF(info.Early_Term_Date IS NULL OR info.Early_Term_Date = '', '0', '1') AS Is_Preterm_Flag,  --是否终止标志
    info.Early_Term_Date,  --提前终止日
    info.Agt_Stat_Cd,  --协议状态代码
    det.busi_date as Accrued_Date,  --计提日期
    info.Inr_Seri_No,  --内部流水号
    info.otc_seri_no,  --场外合约流水号
    info.Book_Agt_Id,  --账簿协议编号
    info.Cntr,  --柜台
    info.Cros_Crrc_Type_Cd,  --跨币种类型代码
    info.fixed_rate,  --固定腿利率
    info.Flot_Intrt_Ulmt,  --浮动利率上限
    info.Float_Base_Rate,  --浮动基础利率
    info.Intr_Marg,  --利差
    info.Float_Undrl_Cd,  --浮动腿标的代码
    info.Undrl_Curr,  --标的币种
    info.Bgng_Npv,  --期初NPV
    info.prop_group,  --关联合约分组
    info.Opt_Fee_Rate,  --期权预估期权费率
    info.Init_Marg_Prop,  --初保线
    info.Base_Marg_Rate,  --基保线
    info.Marg_Agt_Id,  --拆货基合约编号
    null as FUND_COST_RATE,  --资金成本利率
    null as MARGIN_FIXED_RATE,  --保证金固定利率
    null as COMMISSION_COST,  --佣金成本
    null as SPREAD,  --利差
    null as LONG_FIXED_RATE,  --多头持券固定利率成本
    co_c.CAPITAL_COST,  --CNY用资利率
    null as Cms_Mode_Cd,  --佣金模式代码
    null as Trd_Fee_Rate,  --交易费率
    null as Bgng_Vol,  --期初数量
    null as Peshr_Cms,  --每股佣金（标的币种）
    null as Nom_Prin_Chg_Delta,  --名义本金变动（结算币种）
    null as Occu_Qty,  --发生数量（结算币种）
    null as Divd_Tax_Amt,  --分红税金额（结算币种）
    null as intrt,  --浮动利率
    cr.ir/100 as ir,  --资金成本浮动利率
    pd.Tdy_Yield,  --当日盈亏（结算币种）
    pe.Simu_Hedg_Pal,  --模拟对冲盈亏（结算币种）
    abs(coalesce(pe.delta,0))/sum(abs(coalesce(pe.delta,0))) over(partition by pe.Undrl_Sum_Compr, pe.busi_date) as prop_ratio,  --分摊比例
    u.Map_Undrl_Cd,  --匹配标的代码
    coalesce(u.Tdy_Yield,0) as Undrl_Tdy_Yield,  --标的当日盈亏（结算币种）
    sum(coalesce(pe.Simu_Hedg_Pal,0)) over(partition by pe.Undrl_Sum_Compr, pe.busi_date) as Undrl_Simu_Hedg_Pal,  --标的模拟对冲盈亏（结算币种）
    info.Sett_Crrc_Cd,  --结算币种
    coalesce(mid.mid_price,1) as mid_price,  --人民币中间汇率
    fee.OTHER_Prvs_Fee,  --按日计提其他费
    fee.PREMIUM_Prvs_Fee,  --按日计提期权费
    from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS Data_Time,  --数据时间
    null as Trd_Cms,  --交易佣金收入
    case when info.Src_Contr_Type in ('RISKY','AIRBAGX') then 'AIRBAGX'
         when info.Cntr in ('DYNAMIC_HEDGING','STATIC_HEDGING') then 'OPT_HEDGING'
         end as Rev_Contr_Type_Cd,
    '${yyyy-MM-dd}' as busi_date,  --业务日期
    '01' as grp_id  --分组标识
from (
    select *, null as prop_group from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_DERI_COMP_SALE_INFO
    where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Book_Bel_Dept = 'OTC' and coalesce(Early_Term_Date, End_Pric_Date) >= '2022-01-01'
        and grp_id = '01' and Cntr != 'STATIC_HEDGING'
        and Agt_Clas_Cd != 'TRS_INNER'
    union all
    select  --静态对冲期权
        z.*, x.prop_group
    from (
        select agt_id, x.rel_agt_id as prop_group, row_number() over(partition by agt_id order by x.rel_agt_id) as rk
        from (
            select agt_id, concat(agt_id,',',coalesce(rel_agt_id,agt_id)) as rel_agt_id from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_DERI_COMP_SALE_INFO
            where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Book_Bel_Dept = 'OTC' and coalesce(Early_Term_Date, End_Pric_Date) >= '2022-01-01'
                and grp_id = '01' and Cntr = 'STATIC_HEDGING'
            ) t
        lateral view explode(split(rel_agt_id,',')) x as rel_agt_id
        ) x
    left join (
        select * from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_DERI_COMP_SALE_INFO
        where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
        ) z
    on x.agt_id = z.agt_id
    where x.rk = 1
    ) info
inner join (
    select * from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_DERI_COMP_SALE_ADTNL_DET
    where busi_date between Strt_Pric_Date and End_Pric_Date
    ) det
on info.agt_id = det.agt_id
left join (
    SELECT
        Src_Prd_Id,
        sum(if(Fee_Type_Cd = '37',  Tdy_Prvs_Fee, 0)) as PREMIUM_Prvs_Fee,
        sum(if(Fee_Type_Cd != '37', Tdy_Prvs_Fee, 0)) as OTHER_Prvs_Fee,
        Busi_Date
    FROM PDATA_N.T98_OTC_OPT_COMP_EDAY_PRVS_FEE
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_DAILY_ACCRUAL_FEE'
    group by Src_Prd_Id, Busi_Date
    ) fee
on fee.Src_Prd_Id = info.Otc_Seri_No and fee.Busi_Date = det.Busi_Date
left join (
    select * from PDATA_N.T01_CORP_CUST
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_OIS.O_OTC_DERIVATIVE_COUNTERPARTY' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and DEL_FLAG = '0'
    ) cp
on cp.pty_id = info.Cutp_Pty_Id
left join (
    select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_TIT_DAY_HOLD_INDX
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_EOD_CALC_METRICS' and busi_date >= '2022-01-01'
    ) pe
on info.otc_seri_no = pe.Src_Prd_Id and det.busi_date = pe.busi_date and info.Book_Agt_Id = pe.Book_Agt_Id and info.Cntr = 'DYNAMIC_HEDGING'
left join (
    select
        nvl(if(rb.Map_Undrl_Cd='',null,rb.Map_Undrl_Cd),ins.undrl_clas) as Map_Undrl_Cd,
        sum(b.Tdy_Yield) as Tdy_Yield,
        b.busi_date
    from (
        select * from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_BOOK_HOLD_SUM
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_POSITION_DAILY' and busi_date >= '2022-01-01'
        ) b
    inner join (
        select * from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_ADTNL_INFO
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Cntr = 'DYNAMIC_HEDGING'
        ) rb
    on rb.Book_Agt_Id = b.Book_Agt_Id
    left join (
        select * from PDATA_N.T03_AGT_PRD_RELA_H
        where SRC_TBL = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE' and Agt_Prd_Rela_Type_Cd = '01'
            and strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
        ) tot
    on b.Src_Prd_Id = tot.Src_Prd_Id
    left join (
        select *
        from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_LEG_INFO
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_TRS_LEG' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'STRUCTURE_LEG_TYPE'
        ) leg
    on leg.Swap_Comp_Agt_Id = tot.Agt_Id 
    left join (
        select * from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_HOLD_INFO
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_TRS_LEG_HIS_POS' and busi_date >= '2022-01-01'
        ) leg_pos
    on leg_pos.Leg_Glbl_Seq_No = leg.Leg_Glbl_Seq_No and leg_pos.busi_date = b.busi_date
    left join (
        select * from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info
        where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01'
        ) ins
    on ins.in_code = coalesce(leg_pos.Src_Prd_Id, b.Src_Prd_Id)
    group by nvl(if(rb.Map_Undrl_Cd='',null,rb.Map_Undrl_Cd),ins.undrl_clas), b.busi_date
    ) u
on info.undrl_wd_cd = u.Map_Undrl_Cd and det.busi_date = u.busi_date
left join (
    select * from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_BOOK_HOLD_SUM
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_POSITION_DAILY'
    ) pd
on info.otc_seri_no = pd.Src_Prd_Id and det.busi_date = pd.busi_date and info.Book_Agt_Id = pd.Book_Agt_Id
left join (--安全气囊X，当月取上月最后一个交易日数据
    select Curr, ir, date_add(trd_dt, pos) as trd_dt
    from (
        select
            date_add(last_day(default.datekey2date(trd_dt)),1) as trd_dt, 
            case scr_cd when 'HIBOR3M' then 'HKD'
                        when 'SOFR' then 'OTHER'
                        end as Curr, ir,
            lead(date_add(last_day(default.datekey2date(trd_dt)),1), 1, date_add('${yyyy-MM-dd}',1)) over(partition by scr_cd order by default.datekey2date(trd_dt)) as next_date
        from pdata_news_n.t02_ira_ibor
        where src_id = 'WD' and scr_cd in ('HIBOR3M','SOFR') and trd_dt >= '20201201'
            and default.datekey2date(trd_dt) = default.pretradedate(date_add(last_day(default.datekey2date(trd_dt)),1),1)
        ) t
    lateral view posexplode(split(space(datediff(next_date, trd_dt)-1), ' ')) t as pos, val
    ) cr
on cr.Curr = if(info.Undrl_Curr = 'HKD', 'HKD', 'OTHER') and cr.trd_dt = det.busi_date
left join (
    select default.datekey2date(trd_dt) as trd_dt, src_crrc_cd, mid_price
    from pdata_news_n.t02_fxr_cfets_quot
    where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01'
    ) mid
on mid.src_crrc_cd = info.Sett_Crrc_Cd and mid.trd_dt = det.busi_date
left join (--美股、港股安全垫利率
    select
        currency,
        value as CAPITAL_COST,
        date_add(strt_date, pos) as busi_date
    from (
        select
            currency,
            value,
            effective_date as strt_date,
            date_sub(lead(effective_date, 1, date_add('${yyyy-MM-dd}', 1)) over(partition by currency order by effective_date), 1) as end_Date
        from odata_n_ois.g_client_revenue_coefficient
        where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and is_del = 'N' and contract_type = 'AIRBAGX' and coefficient_type = 'CAPITAL_COST' and currency != 'CNY'
        ) x
    lateral view posexplode(split(space(datediff(end_date, strt_date)), ' ')) y as pos, val
    ) co
on co.busi_date = det.busi_date and co.currency = if(info.Undrl_Curr = 'HKD', 'HKD', 'OTHER') and info.Src_Contr_Type in ('RISKY','AIRBAGX')
left join (--人民币用资利率
    select
        value as CAPITAL_COST,
        date_add(strt_date, pos) as busi_date
    from (
        select
            value,
            effective_date as strt_date,
            date_sub(lead(effective_date, 1, date_add('${yyyy-MM-dd}', 1)) over(order by effective_date), 1) as end_Date
        from odata_n_ois.g_client_revenue_coefficient
        where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and is_del = 'N' and contract_type = 'AIRBAGX' and coefficient_type = 'CAPITAL_COST' and currency = 'CNY'
        ) x
    lateral view posexplode(split(space(datediff(end_date, strt_date)), ' ')) y as pos, val
    ) co_c
on co_c.busi_date = det.busi_date and info.Src_Contr_Type in ('RISKY','AIRBAGX')

         else 0 end AS Curr_Rev,  --当日计提创收
    case when info.Cntr = 'DYNAMIC_HEDGING' then if(info.Strt_Pric_Date = det.busi_date, info.Bgng_Npv * coalesce(mid.mid_price,1), 0)
         when info.Cntr = 'STATIC_HEDGING' then if(info.Strt_Pric_Date = det.busi_date, coalesce(det.Init_Nom_Prin, 0)/sum(if(info.Cutp_Pty_Id in ('DEV1100101715','DEV1100103266','DEV1100105899'),0,coalesce(info.Init_Nom_Prin, 0))) over(partition by info.prop_group, det.busi_date) * sum(coalesce(info.Bgng_Npv * coalesce(mid.mid_price,1), 0)) over(partition by info.prop_group, det.busi_date),0)
         else 0 end as Opt_Npv_Curr_Rev,  --当日期权NPV计提创收
    info.Strt_Pric_Date,  --期初定价日
    coalesce(info.Early_Term_Date, info.End_Pric_Date) as End_Pric_Date,  --期末定价日
    IF(info.Early_Term_Date IS NULL OR info.Early_Term_Date = '', '0', '1') AS Is_Preterm_Flag,  --是否终止标志
    info.Early_Term_Date,  --提前终止日
    info.Agt_Stat_Cd,  --协议状态代码
    det.busi_date as Accrued_Date,  --计提日期
    info.Inr_Seri_No,  --内部流水号
    info.otc_seri_no,  --场外合约流水号
    info.Book_Agt_Id,  --账簿协议编号
    info.Cntr,  --柜台
    info.Cros_Crrc_Type_Cd,  --跨币种类型代码
    info.fixed_rate,  --固定腿利率
    info.Flot_Intrt_Ulmt,  --浮动利率上限
    info.Float_Base_Rate,  --浮动基础利率
    info.Intr_Marg,  --利差
    info.Float_Undrl_Cd,  --浮动腿标的代码
    info.Undrl_Curr,  --标的币种
    info.Bgng_Npv,  --期初NPV
    info.prop_group,  --关联合约分组
    info.Opt_Fee_Rate,  --期权预估期权费率
    info.Init_Marg_Prop,  --初保线
    info.Base_Marg_Rate,  --基保线
    info.Marg_Agt_Id,  --拆货基合约编号
    null as FUND_COST_RATE,  --资金成本利率
    null as MARGIN_FIXED_RATE,  --保证金固定利率
    null as COMMISSION_COST,  --佣金成本
    null as SPREAD,  --利差
    null as LONG_FIXED_RATE,  --多头持券固定利率成本
    co_c.CAPITAL_COST,  --CNY用资利率
    null as Cms_Mode_Cd,  --佣金模式代码
    null as Trd_Fee_Rate,  --交易费率
    null as Bgng_Vol,  --期初数量
    null as Peshr_Cms,  --每股佣金（标的币种）
    null as Nom_Prin_Chg_Delta,  --名义本金变动（结算币种）
    null as Occu_Qty,  --发生数量（结算币种）
    null as Divd_Tax_Amt,  --分红税金额（结算币种）
    null as intrt,  --浮动利率
    cr.ir/100 as ir,  --资金成本浮动利率
    pd.Tdy_Yield,  --当日盈亏（结算币种）
    pe.Simu_Hedg_Pal,  --模拟对冲盈亏（结算币种）
    abs(coalesce(pe.delta,0))/sum(abs(coalesce(pe.delta,0))) over(partition by pe.Undrl_Sum_Compr, pe.busi_date) as prop_ratio,  --分摊比例
    u.Map_Undrl_Cd,  --匹配标的代码
    coalesce(u.Tdy_Yield,0) as Undrl_Tdy_Yield,  --标的当日盈亏（结算币种）
    sum(coalesce(pe.Simu_Hedg_Pal,0)) over(partition by pe.Undrl_Sum_Compr, pe.busi_date) as Undrl_Simu_Hedg_Pal,  --标的模拟对冲盈亏（结算币种）
    info.Sett_Crrc_Cd,  --结算币种
    coalesce(mid.mid_price,1) as mid_price,  --人民币中间汇率
    fee.OTHER_Prvs_Fee,  --按日计提其他费
    fee.PREMIUM_Prvs_Fee,  --按日计提期权费
    from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS Data_Time,  --数据时间
    null as Trd_Cms,  --交易佣金收入
    case when info.Src_Contr_Type in ('RISKY','AIRBAGX') then 'AIRBAGX'
         when info.Cntr in ('DYNAMIC_HEDGING','STATIC_HEDGING') then 'OPT_HEDGING'
         end as Rev_Contr_Type_Cd,
    '${yyyy-MM-dd}' as busi_date,  --业务日期
    '01' as grp_id  --分组标识
from (
    select *, null as prop_group from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_DERI_COMP_SALE_INFO
    where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Book_Bel_Dept = 'OTC' and coalesce(Early_Term_Date, End_Pric_Date) >= '2022-01-01'
        and grp_id = '01' and Cntr != 'STATIC_HEDGING'
        and Agt_Clas_Cd != 'TRS_INNER'
    union all
    select  --静态对冲期权
        z.*, x.prop_group
    from (
        select agt_id, x.rel_agt_id as prop_group, row_number() over(partition by agt_id order by x.rel_agt_id) as rk
        from (
            select agt_id, concat(agt_id,',',coalesce(rel_agt_id,agt_id)) as rel_agt_id from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_DERI_COMP_SALE_INFO
            where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Book_Bel_Dept = 'OTC' and coalesce(Early_Term_Date, End_Pric_Date) >= '2022-01-01'
                and grp_id = '01' and Cntr = 'STATIC_HEDGING'
            ) t
        lateral view explode(split(rel_agt_id,',')) x as rel_agt_id
        ) x
    left join (
        select * from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_DERI_COMP_SALE_INFO
        where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
        ) z
    on x.agt_id = z.agt_id
    where x.rk = 1
    ) info
inner join (
    select * from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_DERI_COMP_SALE_ADTNL_DET
    where busi_date between Strt_Pric_Date and End_Pric_Date
    ) det
on info.agt_id = det.agt_id
left join (
    SELECT
        Src_Prd_Id,
        sum(if(Fee_Type_Cd = '37',  Tdy_Prvs_Fee, 0)) as PREMIUM_Prvs_Fee,
        sum(if(Fee_Type_Cd != '37', Tdy_Prvs_Fee, 0)) as OTHER_Prvs_Fee,
        Busi_Date
    FROM PDATA_N.T98_OTC_OPT_COMP_EDAY_PRVS_FEE
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_DAILY_ACCRUAL_FEE'
    group by Src_Prd_Id, Busi_Date
    ) fee
on fee.Src_Prd_Id = info.Otc_Seri_No and fee.Busi_Date = det.Busi_Date
left join (
    select * from PDATA_N.T01_CORP_CUST
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_OIS.O_OTC_DERIVATIVE_COUNTERPARTY' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and DEL_FLAG = '0'
    ) cp
on cp.pty_id = info.Cutp_Pty_Id
left join (
    select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_TIT_DAY_HOLD_INDX
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_EOD_CALC_METRICS' and busi_date >= '2022-01-01'
    ) pe
on info.otc_seri_no = pe.Src_Prd_Id and det.busi_date = pe.busi_date and info.Book_Agt_Id = pe.Book_Agt_Id and info.Cntr = 'DYNAMIC_HEDGING'
left join (
    select
        nvl(if(rb.Map_Undrl_Cd='',null,rb.Map_Undrl_Cd),ins.undrl_clas) as Map_Undrl_Cd,
        sum(b.Tdy_Yield) as Tdy_Yield,
        b.busi_date
    from (
        select * from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_BOOK_HOLD_SUM
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_POSITION_DAILY' and busi_date >= '2022-01-01'
        ) b
    inner join (
        select * from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_ADTNL_INFO
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Cntr = 'DYNAMIC_HEDGING'
        ) rb
    on rb.Book_Agt_Id = b.Book_Agt_Id
    left join (
        select * from PDATA_N.T03_AGT_PRD_RELA_H
        where SRC_TBL = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE' and Agt_Prd_Rela_Type_Cd = '01'
            and strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
        ) tot
    on b.Src_Prd_Id = tot.Src_Prd_Id
    left join (
        select *
        from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_LEG_INFO
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_TRS_LEG' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'STRUCTURE_LEG_TYPE'
        ) leg
    on leg.Swap_Comp_Agt_Id = tot.Agt_Id 
    left join (
        select * from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_HOLD_INFO
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_TRS_LEG_HIS_POS' and busi_date >= '2022-01-01'
        ) leg_pos
    on leg_pos.Leg_Glbl_Seq_No = leg.Leg_Glbl_Seq_No and leg_pos.busi_date = b.busi_date
    left join (
        select * from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info
        where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01'
        ) ins
    on ins.in_code = coalesce(leg_pos.Src_Prd_Id, b.Src_Prd_Id)
    group by nvl(if(rb.Map_Undrl_Cd='',null,rb.Map_Undrl_Cd),ins.undrl_clas), b.busi_date
    ) u
on info.undrl_wd_cd = u.Map_Undrl_Cd and det.busi_date = u.busi_date
left join (
    select * from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_BOOK_HOLD_SUM
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_POSITION_DAILY'
    ) pd
on info.otc_seri_no = pd.Src_Prd_Id and det.busi_date = pd.busi_date and info.Book_Agt_Id = pd.Book_Agt_Id
left join (--安全气囊X，当月取上月最后一个交易日数据
    select Curr, ir, date_add(trd_dt, pos) as trd_dt
    from (
        select
            date_add(last_day(default.datekey2date(trd_dt)),1) as trd_dt, 
            case scr_cd when 'HIBOR3M' then 'HKD'
                        when 'SOFR' then 'OTHER'
                        end as Curr, ir,
            lead(date_add(last_day(default.datekey2date(trd_dt)),1), 1, date_add('${yyyy-MM-dd}',1)) over(partition by scr_cd order by default.datekey2date(trd_dt)) as next_date
        from pdata_news_n.t02_ira_ibor
        where src_id = 'WD' and scr_cd in ('HIBOR3M','SOFR') and trd_dt >= '20201201'
            and default.datekey2date(trd_dt) = default.pretradedate(date_add(last_day(default.datekey2date(trd_dt)),1),1)
        ) t
    lateral view posexplode(split(space(datediff(next_date, trd_dt)-1), ' ')) t as pos, val
    ) cr
on cr.Curr = if(info.Undrl_Curr = 'HKD', 'HKD', 'OTHER') and cr.trd_dt = det.busi_date
left join (
    select default.datekey2date(trd_dt) as trd_dt, src_crrc_cd, mid_price
    from pdata_news_n.t02_fxr_cfets_quot
    where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01'
    ) mid
on mid.src_crrc_cd = info.Sett_Crrc_Cd and mid.trd_dt = det.busi_date
left join (--美股、港股安全垫利率
    select
        currency,
        value as CAPITAL_COST,
        date_add(strt_date, pos) as busi_date
    from (
        select
            currency,
            value,
            effective_date as strt_date,
            date_sub(lead(effective_date, 1, date_add('${yyyy-MM-dd}', 1)) over(partition by currency order by effective_date), 1) as end_Date
        from odata_n_ois.g_client_revenue_coefficient
        where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and is_del = 'N' and contract_type = 'AIRBAGX' and coefficient_type = 'CAPITAL_COST' and currency != 'CNY'
        ) x
    lateral view posexplode(split(space(datediff(end_date, strt_date)), ' ')) y as pos, val
    ) co
on co.busi_date = det.busi_date and co.currency = if(info.Undrl_Curr = 'HKD', 'HKD', 'OTHER') and info.Src_Contr_Type in ('RISKY','AIRBAGX')
left join (--人民币用资利率
    select
        value as CAPITAL_COST,
        date_add(strt_date, pos) as busi_date
    from (
        select
            value,
            effective_date as strt_date,
            date_sub(lead(effective_date, 1, date_add('${yyyy-MM-dd}', 1)) over(order by effective_date), 1) as end_Date
        from odata_n_ois.g_client_revenue_coefficient
        where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and is_del = 'N' and contract_type = 'AIRBAGX' and coefficient_type = 'CAPITAL_COST' and currency = 'CNY'
        ) x
    lateral view posexplode(split(space(datediff(end_date, strt_date)), ' ')) y as pos, val
    ) co_c
on co_c.busi_date = det.busi_date and info.Src_Contr_Type in ('RISKY','AIRBAGX')

SELECT Agt_Id,
	Busi_Type,
	Cutp_Pty_Id,
	Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name,
	Cutp_Pty_Full_Name,
	Sign_Prd_Name,
	USCC,
	Contr_Type_Cd,
	Contr_Type_Desc,
	Src_Contr_Type,
	Src_Contr_Type_Desc,
	Src_Sub_Contr_Type,
	Src_Sub_Contr_Type_Desc,
	Undrl_Wd_Cd,
	Undrl_Name,
	Init_Nom_Prin,
	Dyna_Nom_Prin,
	Curr_Rev,
	Opt_Npv_Curr_Rev,
	Strt_Pric_Date,
	End_Pric_Date,
	Is_Preterm_Flag,
	Early_Term_Date,
	Agt_Stat_Cd,
	Accrued_Date,
	Inr_Seri_No,
	otc_seri_no,
	Book_Agt_Id,
	Cntr,
	Cros_Crrc_Type_Cd,
	fixed_rate,
	Flot_Intrt_Ulmt,
	Float_Base_Rate,
	Intr_Marg,
	Float_Undrl_Cd,
	Undrl_Curr,
	Bgng_Npv,
	prop_group,
	Opt_Fee_Rate,
	Init_Marg_Prop,
	Base_Marg_Rate,
	Marg_Agt_Id,
	FUND_COST_RATE,
	MARGIN_FIXED_RATE,
	COMMISSION_COST,
	SPREAD,
	LONG_FIXED_RATE,
	CAPITAL_COST,
	Cms_Mode_Cd,
	Trd_Fee_Rate,
	Bgng_Vol,
	Peshr_Cms,
	Nom_Prin_Chg_Delta,
	Occu_Qty,
	Divd_Tax_Amt,
	intrt,
	ir,
	Tdy_Yield,
	Simu_Hedg_Pal,
	prop_ratio,
	Map_Undrl_Cd,
	Undrl_Tdy_Yield,
	Undrl_Simu_Hedg_Pal,
	Sett_Crrc_Cd,
	mid_price,
	OTHER_Prvs_Fee,
	PREMIUM_Prvs_Fee,
	Data_Time,
	Trd_Cms,
	Rev_Contr_Type_Cd,
	busi_date,
	grp_id FROM (
	 select
    info.Agt_Id,  --合约编号
    info.Busi_Type,  --业务类型
    info.Cutp_Pty_Id,  --交易对手客户编号
    info.Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name,  --交易对手当事人简称
    info.Cutp_Pty_Full_Name,  --交易对手当事人名称
    info.Sign_Prd_Name,  --代签产品名称
    cp.USCC,  --统一社会信用代码
    info.Contr_Type_Cd,  --合约类型代码
    info.Contr_Type_Desc,  --合约类型描述
    info.Src_Contr_Type,  --源合约类型
    info.Src_Contr_Type_Desc,  --源合约类型描述
    info.Src_Sub_Contr_Type,  --源合约子类型
    info.Src_Sub_Contr_Type_Desc,  --源合约子类型描述
    info.Undrl_Wd_Cd,  --标的万得代码
    info.Undrl_Name,  --标的名称
    info.Init_Nom_Prin,  --初始名义本金
    coalesce(det.Dyna_Nom_Prin, 0) as Dyna_Nom_Prin,  --动态名义本金
    case when info.Src_Contr_Type in ('RISKY','AIRBAGX') and (info.Undrl_Curr = 'CNY' or (info.Cros_Crrc_Type_Cd = 'COMPOSITE' and info.Undrl_Curr = 'HKD')) then (fee.OTHER_Prvs_Fee + if(cast(fee.PREMIUM_Prvs_Fee as double) <= 0, 0, fee.PREMIUM_Prvs_Fee * (1 - 1 / info.Opt_Fee_Rate * co_c.CAPITAL_COST / if(coalesce(info.Marg_Agt_Id,'') = '', 1, (1 - info.Init_Marg_Prop)/(1 - info.Base_Marg_Rate))))) * coalesce(mid.mid_price,1)
         when info.Src_Contr_Type in ('RISKY','AIRBAGX') and info.Cros_Crrc_Type_Cd = 'FLEXO' then (fee.OTHER_Prvs_Fee + if(cast(fee.PREMIUM_Prvs_Fee as double) <= 0, 0, fee.PREMIUM_Prvs_Fee - det.Dyna_Nom_Prin * (coalesce(cr.ir/100,0) + co.CAPITAL_COST - if(coalesce(info.Marg_Agt_Id,'') = '', info.Init_Marg_Prop, info.Base_Marg_Rate) * co_c.CAPITAL_COST) / 365)) * coalesce(mid.mid_price,1)
         when info.Src_Contr_Type in ('RISKY','AIRBAGX') then (fee.OTHER_Prvs_Fee + if(cast(fee.PREMIUM_Prvs_Fee as double) <= 0, 0, fee.PREMIUM_Prvs_Fee - det.Dyna_Nom_Prin * (0.035 - if(coalesce(info.Marg_Agt_Id,'') = '', info.Init_Marg_Prop, info.Base_Marg_Rate) * co_c.CAPITAL_COST) / 365)) * coalesce(mid.mid_price,1)
         when info.Cntr = 'DYNAMIC_HEDGING' then (coalesce(pe.Simu_Hedg_Pal,0) + coalesce(pd.Tdy_Yield,0) + abs(coalesce(pe.delta,0))/sum(abs(coalesce(pe.delta,0))) over(partition by pe.Undrl_Sum_Compr, pe.busi_date) * (coalesce(u.Tdy_Yield,0) - sum(coalesce(pe.Simu_Hedg_Pal,0)) over(partition by pe.Undrl_Sum_Compr, pe.busi_date))) * coalesce(mid.mid_price,1)  --原数据均为结算币种，用人民币中间汇率转换
         when info.Cntr = 'STATIC_HEDGING' then coalesce(det.Init_Nom_Prin, 0)/sum(if(info.Cutp_Pty_Id in ('DEV1100101715','DEV1100103266','DEV1100105899'),0,coalesce(info.Init_Nom_Prin, 0))) over(partition by info.prop_group, det.busi_date) * sum(coalesce(coalesce(pd.Tdy_Yield,0) * coalesce(mid.mid_price,1), 0)) over(partition by info.prop_group, det.busi_date)
         else 0 end AS Curr_Rev,  --当日计提创收
    case when info.Cntr = 'DYNAMIC_HEDGING' then if(info.Strt_Pric_Date = det.busi_date, info.Bgng_Npv * coalesce(mid.mid_price,1), 0)
         when info.Cntr = 'STATIC_HEDGING' then if(info.Strt_Pric_Date = det.busi_date, coalesce(det.Init_Nom_Prin, 0)/sum(if(info.Cutp_Pty_Id in ('DEV1100101715','DEV1100103266','DEV1100105899'),0,coalesce(info.Init_Nom_Prin, 0))) over(partition by info.prop_group, det.busi_date) * sum(coalesce(info.Bgng_Npv * coalesce(mid.mid_price,1), 0)) over(partition by info.prop_group, det.busi_date),0)
         else 0 end as Opt_Npv_Curr_Rev,  --当日期权NPV计提创收
    info.Strt_Pric_Date,  --期初定价日
    coalesce(info.Early_Term_Date, info.End_Pric_Date) as End_Pric_Date,  --期末定价日
    IF(info.Early_Term_Date IS NULL OR info.Early_Term_Date = '', '0', '1') AS Is_Preterm_Flag,  --是否终止标志
    info.Early_Term_Date,  --提前终止日
    info.Agt_Stat_Cd,  --协议状态代码
    det.busi_date as Accrued_Date,  --计提日期
    info.Inr_Seri_No,  --内部流水号
    info.otc_seri_no,  --场外合约流水号
    info.Book_Agt_Id,  --账簿协议编号
    info.Cntr,  --柜台
    info.Cros_Crrc_Type_Cd,  --跨币种类型代码
    info.fixed_rate,  --固定腿利率
    info.Flot_Intrt_Ulmt,  --浮动利率上限
    info.Float_Base_Rate,  --浮动基础利率
    info.Intr_Marg,  --利差
    info.Float_Undrl_Cd,  --浮动腿标的代码
    info.Undrl_Curr,  --标的币种
    info.Bgng_Npv,  --期初NPV
    info.prop_group,  --关联合约分组
    info.Opt_Fee_Rate,  --期权预估期权费率
    info.Init_Marg_Prop,  --初保线
    info.Base_Marg_Rate,  --基保线
    info.Marg_Agt_Id,  --拆货基合约编号
    null as FUND_COST_RATE,  --资金成本利率
    null as MARGIN_FIXED_RATE,  --保证金固定利率
    null as COMMISSION_COST,  --佣金成本
    null as SPREAD,  --利差
    null as LONG_FIXED_RATE,  --多头持券固定利率成本
    co_c.CAPITAL_COST,  --CNY用资利率
    null as Cms_Mode_Cd,  --佣金模式代码
    null as Trd_Fee_Rate,  --交易费率
    null as Bgng_Vol,  --期初数量
    null as Peshr_Cms,  --每股佣金（标的币种）
    null as Nom_Prin_Chg_Delta,  --名义本金变动（结算币种）
    null as Occu_Qty,  --发生数量（结算币种）
    null as Divd_Tax_Amt,  --分红税金额（结算币种）
    null as intrt,  --浮动利率
    cr.ir/100 as ir,  --资金成本浮动利率
    pd.Tdy_Yield,  --当日盈亏（结算币种）
    pe.Simu_Hedg_Pal,  --模拟对冲盈亏（结算币种）
    abs(coalesce(pe.delta,0))/sum(abs(coalesce(pe.delta,0))) over(partition by pe.Undrl_Sum_Compr, pe.busi_date) as prop_ratio,  --分摊比例
    u.Map_Undrl_Cd,  --匹配标的代码
    coalesce(u.Tdy_Yield,0) as Undrl_Tdy_Yield,  --标的当日盈亏（结算币种）
    sum(coalesce(pe.Simu_Hedg_Pal,0)) over(partition by pe.Undrl_Sum_Compr, pe.busi_date) as Undrl_Simu_Hedg_Pal,  --标的模拟对冲盈亏（结算币种）
    info.Sett_Crrc_Cd,  --结算币种
    coalesce(mid.mid_price,1) as mid_price,  --人民币中间汇率
    fee.OTHER_Prvs_Fee,  --按日计提其他费
    fee.PREMIUM_Prvs_Fee,  --按日计提期权费
    from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS Data_Time,  --数据时间
    null as Trd_Cms,  --交易佣金收入
    case when info.Src_Contr_Type in ('RISKY','AIRBAGX') then 'AIRBAGX'
         when info.Cntr in ('DYNAMIC_HEDGING','STATIC_HEDGING') then 'OPT_HEDGING'
         end as Rev_Contr_Type_Cd,
    '${yyyy-MM-dd}' as busi_date,  --业务日期
    '01' as grp_id  --分组标识
from (
    select *, null as prop_group from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_DERI_COMP_SALE_INFO
    where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Book_Bel_Dept = 'OTC' and coalesce(Early_Term_Date, End_Pric_Date) >= '2022-01-01'
        and grp_id = '01' and Cntr != 'STATIC_HEDGING'
        and Agt_Clas_Cd != 'TRS_INNER'
    union all
    select  --静态对冲期权
        z.*, x.prop_group
    from (
        select agt_id, x.rel_agt_id as prop_group, row_number() over(partition by agt_id order by x.rel_agt_id) as rk
        from (
            select agt_id, concat(agt_id,',',coalesce(rel_agt_id,agt_id)) as rel_agt_id from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_DERI_COMP_SALE_INFO
            where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Book_Bel_Dept = 'OTC' and coalesce(Early_Term_Date, End_Pric_Date) >= '2022-01-01'
                and grp_id = '01' and Cntr = 'STATIC_HEDGING'
            ) t
        lateral view explode(split(rel_agt_id,',')) x as rel_agt_id
        ) x
    left join (
        select * from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_DERI_COMP_SALE_INFO
        where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
        ) z
    on x.agt_id = z.agt_id
    where x.rk = 1
    ) info
inner join (
    select * from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_DERI_COMP_SALE_ADTNL_DET
    where busi_date between Strt_Pric_Date and End_Pric_Date
    ) det
on info.agt_id = det.agt_id
left join (
    SELECT
        Src_Prd_Id,
        sum(if(Fee_Type_Cd = '37',  Tdy_Prvs_Fee, 0)) as PREMIUM_Prvs_Fee,
        sum(if(Fee_Type_Cd != '37', Tdy_Prvs_Fee, 0)) as OTHER_Prvs_Fee,
        Busi_Date
    FROM PDATA_N.T98_OTC_OPT_COMP_EDAY_PRVS_FEE
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_DAILY_ACCRUAL_FEE'
    group by Src_Prd_Id, Busi_Date
    ) fee
on fee.Src_Prd_Id = info.Otc_Seri_No and fee.Busi_Date = det.Busi_Date
left join (
    select * from PDATA_N.T01_CORP_CUST
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_OIS.O_OTC_DERIVATIVE_COUNTERPARTY' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and DEL_FLAG = '0'
    ) cp
on cp.pty_id = info.Cutp_Pty_Id
left join (
    select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_TIT_DAY_HOLD_INDX
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_EOD_CALC_METRICS' and busi_date >= '2022-01-01'
    ) pe
on info.otc_seri_no = pe.Src_Prd_Id and det.busi_date = pe.busi_date and info.Book_Agt_Id = pe.Book_Agt_Id and info.Cntr = 'DYNAMIC_HEDGING'
left join (
    select
        nvl(if(rb.Map_Undrl_Cd='',null,rb.Map_Undrl_Cd),ins.undrl_clas) as Map_Undrl_Cd,
        sum(b.Tdy_Yield) as Tdy_Yield,
        b.busi_date
    from (
        select * from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_BOOK_HOLD_SUM
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_POSITION_DAILY' and busi_date >= '2022-01-01'
        ) b
    inner join (
        select * from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_ADTNL_INFO
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Cntr = 'DYNAMIC_HEDGING'
        ) rb
    on rb.Book_Agt_Id = b.Book_Agt_Id
    left join (
        select * from PDATA_N.T03_AGT_PRD_RELA_H
        where SRC_TBL = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE' and Agt_Prd_Rela_Type_Cd = '01'
            and strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
        ) tot
    on b.Src_Prd_Id = tot.Src_Prd_Id
    left join (
        select *
        from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_LEG_INFO
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_TRS_LEG' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'STRUCTURE_LEG_TYPE'
        ) leg
    on leg.Swap_Comp_Agt_Id = tot.Agt_Id 
    left join (
        select * from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_HOLD_INFO
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_TRS_LEG_HIS_POS' and busi_date >= '2022-01-01'
        ) leg_pos
    on leg_pos.Leg_Glbl_Seq_No = leg.Leg_Glbl_Seq_No and leg_pos.busi_date = b.busi_date
    left join (
        select * from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info
        where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01'
        ) ins
    on ins.in_code = coalesce(leg_pos.Src_Prd_Id, b.Src_Prd_Id)
    group by nvl(if(rb.Map_Undrl_Cd='',null,rb.Map_Undrl_Cd),ins.undrl_clas), b.busi_date
    ) u
on info.undrl_wd_cd = u.Map_Undrl_Cd and det.busi_date = u.busi_date
left join (
    select * from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_BOOK_HOLD_SUM
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_POSITION_DAILY'
    ) pd
on info.otc_seri_no = pd.Src_Prd_Id and det.busi_date = pd.busi_date and info.Book_Agt_Id = pd.Book_Agt_Id
left join (--安全气囊X，当月取上月最后一个交易日数据
    select Curr, ir, date_add(trd_dt, pos) as trd_dt
    from (
        select
            date_add(last_day(default.datekey2date(trd_dt)),1) as trd_dt, 
            case scr_cd when 'HIBOR3M' then 'HKD'
                        when 'SOFR' then 'OTHER'
                        end as Curr, ir,
            lead(date_add(last_day(default.datekey2date(trd_dt)),1), 1, date_add('${yyyy-MM-dd}',1)) over(partition by scr_cd order by default.datekey2date(trd_dt)) as next_date
        from pdata_news_n.t02_ira_ibor
        where src_id = 'WD' and scr_cd in ('HIBOR3M','SOFR') and trd_dt >= '20201201'
            and default.datekey2date(trd_dt) = default.pretradedate(date_add(last_day(default.datekey2date(trd_dt)),1),1)
        ) t
    lateral view posexplode(split(space(datediff(next_date, trd_dt)-1), ' ')) t as pos, val
    ) cr
on cr.Curr = if(info.Undrl_Curr = 'HKD', 'HKD', 'OTHER') and cr.trd_dt = det.busi_date
left join (
    select default.datekey2date(trd_dt) as trd_dt, src_crrc_cd, mid_price
    from pdata_news_n.t02_fxr_cfets_quot
    where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01'
    ) mid
on mid.src_crrc_cd = info.Sett_Crrc_Cd and mid.trd_dt = det.busi_date
left join (--美股、港股安全垫利率
    select
        currency,
        value as CAPITAL_COST,
        date_add(strt_date, pos) as busi_date
    from (
        select
            currency,
            value,
            effective_date as strt_date,
            date_sub(lead(effective_date, 1, date_add('${yyyy-MM-dd}', 1)) over(partition by currency order by effective_date), 1) as end_Date
        from odata_n_ois.g_client_revenue_coefficient
        where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and is_del = 'N' and contract_type = 'AIRBAGX' and coefficient_type = 'CAPITAL_COST' and currency != 'CNY'
        ) x
    lateral view posexplode(split(space(datediff(end_date, strt_date)), ' ')) y as pos, val
    ) co
on co.busi_date = det.busi_date and co.currency = if(info.Undrl_Curr = 'HKD', 'HKD', 'OTHER') and info.Src_Contr_Type in ('RISKY','AIRBAGX')
left join (--人民币用资利率
    select
        value as CAPITAL_COST,
        date_add(strt_date, pos) as busi_date
    from (
        select
            value,
            effective_date as strt_date,
            date_sub(lead(effective_date, 1, date_add('${yyyy-MM-dd}', 1)) over(order by effective_date), 1) as end_Date
        from odata_n_ois.g_client_revenue_coefficient
        where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and is_del = 'N' and contract_type = 'AIRBAGX' and coefficient_type = 'CAPITAL_COST' and currency = 'CNY'
        ) x
    lateral view posexplode(split(space(datediff(end_date, strt_date)), ' ')) y as pos, val
    ) co_c
on co_c.busi_date = det.busi_date and info.Src_Contr_Type in ('RISKY','AIRBAGX') 
	) castTable
targetRelations.fullCondition:
SELECT Agt_Id,
	Busi_Type,
	Cutp_Pty_Id,
	Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name,
	Cutp_Pty_Full_Name,
	Sign_Prd_Name,
	USCC,
	Contr_Type_Cd,
	Contr_Type_Desc,
	Src_Contr_Type,
	Src_Contr_Type_Desc,
	Src_Sub_Contr_Type,
	Src_Sub_Contr_Type_Desc,
	Undrl_Wd_Cd,
	Undrl_Name,
	Init_Nom_Prin,
	Dyna_Nom_Prin,
	Curr_Rev,
	Opt_Npv_Curr_Rev,
	Strt_Pric_Date,
	End_Pric_Date,
	Is_Preterm_Flag,
	Early_Term_Date,
	Agt_Stat_Cd,
	Accrued_Date,
	Inr_Seri_No,
	otc_seri_no,
	Book_Agt_Id,
	Cntr,
	Cros_Crrc_Type_Cd,
	fixed_rate,
	Flot_Intrt_Ulmt,
	Float_Base_Rate,
	Intr_Marg,
	Float_Undrl_Cd,
	Undrl_Curr,
	Bgng_Npv,
	prop_group,
	Opt_Fee_Rate,
	Init_Marg_Prop,
	Base_Marg_Rate,
	Marg_Agt_Id,
	FUND_COST_RATE,
	MARGIN_FIXED_RATE,
	COMMISSION_COST,
	SPREAD,
	LONG_FIXED_RATE,
	CAPITAL_COST,
	Cms_Mode_Cd,
	Trd_Fee_Rate,
	Bgng_Vol,
	Peshr_Cms,
	Nom_Prin_Chg_Delta,
	Occu_Qty,
	Divd_Tax_Amt,
	intrt,
	ir,
	Tdy_Yield,
	Simu_Hedg_Pal,
	prop_ratio,
	Map_Undrl_Cd,
	Undrl_Tdy_Yield,
	Undrl_Simu_Hedg_Pal,
	Sett_Crrc_Cd,
	mid_price,
	OTHER_Prvs_Fee,
	PREMIUM_Prvs_Fee,
	Data_Time,
	Trd_Cms,
	Rev_Contr_Type_Cd,
	busi_date,
	grp_id FROM (
	 select
    info.Agt_Id,  --合约编号
    info.Busi_Type,  --业务类型
    info.Cutp_Pty_Id,  --交易对手客户编号
    info.Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name,  --交易对手当事人简称
    info.Cutp_Pty_Full_Name,  --交易对手当事人名称
    info.Sign_Prd_Name,  --代签产品名称
    cp.USCC,  --统一社会信用代码
    info.Contr_Type_Cd,  --合约类型代码
    info.Contr_Type_Desc,  --合约类型描述
    info.Src_Contr_Type,  --源合约类型
    info.Src_Contr_Type_Desc,  --源合约类型描述
    info.Src_Sub_Contr_Type,  --源合约子类型
    info.Src_Sub_Contr_Type_Desc,  --源合约子类型描述
    info.Undrl_Wd_Cd,  --标的万得代码
    info.Undrl_Name,  --标的名称
    info.Init_Nom_Prin,  --初始名义本金
    coalesce(det.Dyna_Nom_Prin, 0) as Dyna_Nom_Prin,  --动态名义本金
    case when info.Src_Contr_Type in ('RISKY','AIRBAGX') and (info.Undrl_Curr = 'CNY' or (info.Cros_Crrc_Type_Cd = 'COMPOSITE' and info.Undrl_Curr = 'HKD')) then (fee.OTHER_Prvs_Fee + if(cast(fee.PREMIUM_Prvs_Fee as double) <= 0, 0, fee.PREMIUM_Prvs_Fee * (1 - 1 / info.Opt_Fee_Rate * co_c.CAPITAL_COST / if(coalesce(info.Marg_Agt_Id,'') = '', 1, (1 - info.Init_Marg_Prop)/(1 - info.Base_Marg_Rate))))) * coalesce(mid.mid_price,1)
         when info.Src_Contr_Type in ('RISKY','AIRBAGX') and info.Cros_Crrc_Type_Cd = 'FLEXO' then (fee.OTHER_Prvs_Fee + if(cast(fee.PREMIUM_Prvs_Fee as double) <= 0, 0, fee.PREMIUM_Prvs_Fee - det.Dyna_Nom_Prin * (coalesce(cr.ir/100,0) + co.CAPITAL_COST - if(coalesce(info.Marg_Agt_Id,'') = '', info.Init_Marg_Prop, info.Base_Marg_Rate) * co_c.CAPITAL_COST) / 365)) * coalesce(mid.mid_price,1)
         when info.Src_Contr_Type in ('RISKY','AIRBAGX') then (fee.OTHER_Prvs_Fee + if(cast(fee.PREMIUM_Prvs_Fee as double) <= 0, 0, fee.PREMIUM_Prvs_Fee - det.Dyna_Nom_Prin * (0.035 - if(coalesce(info.Marg_Agt_Id,'') = '', info.Init_Marg_Prop, info.Base_Marg_Rate) * co_c.CAPITAL_COST) / 365)) * coalesce(mid.mid_price,1)
         when info.Cntr = 'DYNAMIC_HEDGING' then (coalesce(pe.Simu_Hedg_Pal,0) + coalesce(pd.Tdy_Yield,0) + abs(coalesce(pe.delta,0))/sum(abs(coalesce(pe.delta,0))) over(partition by pe.Undrl_Sum_Compr, pe.busi_date) * (coalesce(u.Tdy_Yield,0) - sum(coalesce(pe.Simu_Hedg_Pal,0)) over(partition by pe.Undrl_Sum_Compr, pe.busi_date))) * coalesce(mid.mid_price,1)  --原数据均为结算币种，用人民币中间汇率转换
         when info.Cntr = 'STATIC_HEDGING' then coalesce(det.Init_Nom_Prin, 0)/sum(if(info.Cutp_Pty_Id in ('DEV1100101715','DEV1100103266','DEV1100105899'),0,coalesce(info.Init_Nom_Prin, 0))) over(partition by info.prop_group, det.busi_date) * sum(coalesce(coalesce(pd.Tdy_Yield,0) * coalesce(mid.mid_price,1), 0)) over(partition by info.prop_group, det.busi_date)
         else 0 end AS Curr_Rev,  --当日计提创收
    case when info.Cntr = 'DYNAMIC_HEDGING' then if(info.Strt_Pric_Date = det.busi_date, info.Bgng_Npv * coalesce(mid.mid_price,1), 0)
         when info.Cntr = 'STATIC_HEDGING' then if(info.Strt_Pric_Date = det.busi_date, coalesce(det.Init_Nom_Prin, 0)/sum(if(info.Cutp_Pty_Id in ('DEV1100101715','DEV1100103266','DEV1100105899'),0,coalesce(info.Init_Nom_Prin, 0))) over(partition by info.prop_group, det.busi_date) * sum(coalesce(info.Bgng_Npv * coalesce(mid.mid_price,1), 0)) over(partition by info.prop_group, det.busi_date),0)
         else 0 end as Opt_Npv_Curr_Rev,  --当日期权NPV计提创收
    info.Strt_Pric_Date,  --期初定价日
    coalesce(info.Early_Term_Date, info.End_Pric_Date) as End_Pric_Date,  --期末定价日
    IF(info.Early_Term_Date IS NULL OR info.Early_Term_Date = '', '0', '1') AS Is_Preterm_Flag,  --是否终止标志
    info.Early_Term_Date,  --提前终止日
    info.Agt_Stat_Cd,  --协议状态代码
    det.busi_date as Accrued_Date,  --计提日期
    info.Inr_Seri_No,  --内部流水号
    info.otc_seri_no,  --场外合约流水号
    info.Book_Agt_Id,  --账簿协议编号
    info.Cntr,  --柜台
    info.Cros_Crrc_Type_Cd,  --跨币种类型代码
    info.fixed_rate,  --固定腿利率
    info.Flot_Intrt_Ulmt,  --浮动利率上限
    info.Float_Base_Rate,  --浮动基础利率
    info.Intr_Marg,  --利差
    info.Float_Undrl_Cd,  --浮动腿标的代码
    info.Undrl_Curr,  --标的币种
    info.Bgng_Npv,  --期初NPV
    info.prop_group,  --关联合约分组
    info.Opt_Fee_Rate,  --期权预估期权费率
    info.Init_Marg_Prop,  --初保线
    info.Base_Marg_Rate,  --基保线
    info.Marg_Agt_Id,  --拆货基合约编号
    null as FUND_COST_RATE,  --资金成本利率
    null as MARGIN_FIXED_RATE,  --保证金固定利率
    null as COMMISSION_COST,  --佣金成本
    null as SPREAD,  --利差
    null as LONG_FIXED_RATE,  --多头持券固定利率成本
    co_c.CAPITAL_COST,  --CNY用资利率
    null as Cms_Mode_Cd,  --佣金模式代码
    null as Trd_Fee_Rate,  --交易费率
    null as Bgng_Vol,  --期初数量
    null as Peshr_Cms,  --每股佣金（标的币种）
    null as Nom_Prin_Chg_Delta,  --名义本金变动（结算币种）
    null as Occu_Qty,  --发生数量（结算币种）
    null as Divd_Tax_Amt,  --分红税金额（结算币种）
    null as intrt,  --浮动利率
    cr.ir/100 as ir,  --资金成本浮动利率
    pd.Tdy_Yield,  --当日盈亏（结算币种）
    pe.Simu_Hedg_Pal,  --模拟对冲盈亏（结算币种）
    abs(coalesce(pe.delta,0))/sum(abs(coalesce(pe.delta,0))) over(partition by pe.Undrl_Sum_Compr, pe.busi_date) as prop_ratio,  --分摊比例
    u.Map_Undrl_Cd,  --匹配标的代码
    coalesce(u.Tdy_Yield,0) as Undrl_Tdy_Yield,  --标的当日盈亏（结算币种）
    sum(coalesce(pe.Simu_Hedg_Pal,0)) over(partition by pe.Undrl_Sum_Compr, pe.busi_date) as Undrl_Simu_Hedg_Pal,  --标的模拟对冲盈亏（结算币种）
    info.Sett_Crrc_Cd,  --结算币种
    coalesce(mid.mid_price,1) as mid_price,  --人民币中间汇率
    fee.OTHER_Prvs_Fee,  --按日计提其他费
    fee.PREMIUM_Prvs_Fee,  --按日计提期权费
    from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS Data_Time,  --数据时间
    null as Trd_Cms,  --交易佣金收入
    case when info.Src_Contr_Type in ('RISKY','AIRBAGX') then 'AIRBAGX'
         when info.Cntr in ('DYNAMIC_HEDGING','STATIC_HEDGING') then 'OPT_HEDGING'
         end as Rev_Contr_Type_Cd,
    '${yyyy-MM-dd}' as busi_date,  --业务日期
    '01' as grp_id  --分组标识
from (
    select *, null as prop_group from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_DERI_COMP_SALE_INFO
    where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Book_Bel_Dept = 'OTC' and coalesce(Early_Term_Date, End_Pric_Date) >= '2022-01-01'
        and grp_id = '01' and Cntr != 'STATIC_HEDGING'
        and Agt_Clas_Cd != 'TRS_INNER'
    union all
    select  --静态对冲期权
        z.*, x.prop_group
    from (
        select agt_id, x.rel_agt_id as prop_group, row_number() over(partition by agt_id order by x.rel_agt_id) as rk
        from (
            select agt_id, concat(agt_id,',',coalesce(rel_agt_id,agt_id)) as rel_agt_id from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_DERI_COMP_SALE_INFO
            where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Book_Bel_Dept = 'OTC' and coalesce(Early_Term_Date, End_Pric_Date) >= '2022-01-01'
                and grp_id = '01' and Cntr = 'STATIC_HEDGING'
            ) t
        lateral view explode(split(rel_agt_id,',')) x as rel_agt_id
        ) x
    left join (
        select * from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_DERI_COMP_SALE_INFO
        where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
        ) z
    on x.agt_id = z.agt_id
    where x.rk = 1
    ) info
inner join (
    select * from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_DERI_COMP_SALE_ADTNL_DET
    where busi_date between Strt_Pric_Date and End_Pric_Date
    ) det
on info.agt_id = det.agt_id
left join (
    SELECT
        Src_Prd_Id,
        sum(if(Fee_Type_Cd = '37',  Tdy_Prvs_Fee, 0)) as PREMIUM_Prvs_Fee,
        sum(if(Fee_Type_Cd != '37', Tdy_Prvs_Fee, 0)) as OTHER_Prvs_Fee,
        Busi_Date
    FROM PDATA_N.T98_OTC_OPT_COMP_EDAY_PRVS_FEE
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_DAILY_ACCRUAL_FEE'
    group by Src_Prd_Id, Busi_Date
    ) fee
on fee.Src_Prd_Id = info.Otc_Seri_No and fee.Busi_Date = det.Busi_Date
left join (
    select * from PDATA_N.T01_CORP_CUST
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_OIS.O_OTC_DERIVATIVE_COUNTERPARTY' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and DEL_FLAG = '0'
    ) cp
on cp.pty_id = info.Cutp_Pty_Id
left join (
    select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_TIT_DAY_HOLD_INDX
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_EOD_CALC_METRICS' and busi_date >= '2022-01-01'
    ) pe
on info.otc_seri_no = pe.Src_Prd_Id and det.busi_date = pe.busi_date and info.Book_Agt_Id = pe.Book_Agt_Id and info.Cntr = 'DYNAMIC_HEDGING'
left join (
    select
        nvl(if(rb.Map_Undrl_Cd='',null,rb.Map_Undrl_Cd),ins.undrl_clas) as Map_Undrl_Cd,
        sum(b.Tdy_Yield) as Tdy_Yield,
        b.busi_date
    from (
        select * from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_BOOK_HOLD_SUM
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_POSITION_DAILY' and busi_date >= '2022-01-01'
        ) b
    inner join (
        select * from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_ADTNL_INFO
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Cntr = 'DYNAMIC_HEDGING'
        ) rb
    on rb.Book_Agt_Id = b.Book_Agt_Id
    left join (
        select * from PDATA_N.T03_AGT_PRD_RELA_H
        where SRC_TBL = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE' and Agt_Prd_Rela_Type_Cd = '01'
            and strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
        ) tot
    on b.Src_Prd_Id = tot.Src_Prd_Id
    left join (
        select *
        from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_LEG_INFO
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_TRS_LEG' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'STRUCTURE_LEG_TYPE'
        ) leg
    on leg.Swap_Comp_Agt_Id = tot.Agt_Id 
    left join (
        select * from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_HOLD_INFO
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_TRS_LEG_HIS_POS' and busi_date >= '2022-01-01'
        ) leg_pos
    on leg_pos.Leg_Glbl_Seq_No = leg.Leg_Glbl_Seq_No and leg_pos.busi_date = b.busi_date
    left join (
        select * from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info
        where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01'
        ) ins
    on ins.in_code = coalesce(leg_pos.Src_Prd_Id, b.Src_Prd_Id)
    group by nvl(if(rb.Map_Undrl_Cd='',null,rb.Map_Undrl_Cd),ins.undrl_clas), b.busi_date
    ) u
on info.undrl_wd_cd = u.Map_Undrl_Cd and det.busi_date = u.busi_date
left join (
    select * from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_BOOK_HOLD_SUM
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_POSITION_DAILY'
    ) pd
on info.otc_seri_no = pd.Src_Prd_Id and det.busi_date = pd.busi_date and info.Book_Agt_Id = pd.Book_Agt_Id
left join (--安全气囊X，当月取上月最后一个交易日数据
    select Curr, ir, date_add(trd_dt, pos) as trd_dt
    from (
        select
            date_add(last_day(default.datekey2date(trd_dt)),1) as trd_dt, 
            case scr_cd when 'HIBOR3M' then 'HKD'
                        when 'SOFR' then 'OTHER'
                        end as Curr, ir,
            lead(date_add(last_day(default.datekey2date(trd_dt)),1), 1, date_add('${yyyy-MM-dd}',1)) over(partition by scr_cd order by default.datekey2date(trd_dt)) as next_date
        from pdata_news_n.t02_ira_ibor
        where src_id = 'WD' and scr_cd in ('HIBOR3M','SOFR') and trd_dt >= '20201201'
            and default.datekey2date(trd_dt) = default.pretradedate(date_add(last_day(default.datekey2date(trd_dt)),1),1)
        ) t
    lateral view posexplode(split(space(datediff(next_date, trd_dt)-1), ' ')) t as pos, val
    ) cr
on cr.Curr = if(info.Undrl_Curr = 'HKD', 'HKD', 'OTHER') and cr.trd_dt = det.busi_date
left join (
    select default.datekey2date(trd_dt) as trd_dt, src_crrc_cd, mid_price
    from pdata_news_n.t02_fxr_cfets_quot
    where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01'
    ) mid
on mid.src_crrc_cd = info.Sett_Crrc_Cd and mid.trd_dt = det.busi_date
left join (--美股、港股安全垫利率
    select
        currency,
        value as CAPITAL_COST,
        date_add(strt_date, pos) as busi_date
    from (
        select
            currency,
            value,
            effective_date as strt_date,
            date_sub(lead(effective_date, 1, date_add('${yyyy-MM-dd}', 1)) over(partition by currency order by effective_date), 1) as end_Date
        from odata_n_ois.g_client_revenue_coefficient
        where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and is_del = 'N' and contract_type = 'AIRBAGX' and coefficient_type = 'CAPITAL_COST' and currency != 'CNY'
        ) x
    lateral view posexplode(split(space(datediff(end_date, strt_date)), ' ')) y as pos, val
    ) co
on co.busi_date = det.busi_date and co.currency = if(info.Undrl_Curr = 'HKD', 'HKD', 'OTHER') and info.Src_Contr_Type in ('RISKY','AIRBAGX')
left join (--人民币用资利率
    select
        value as CAPITAL_COST,
        date_add(strt_date, pos) as busi_date
    from (
        select
            value,
            effective_date as strt_date,
            date_sub(lead(effective_date, 1, date_add('${yyyy-MM-dd}', 1)) over(order by effective_date), 1) as end_Date
        from odata_n_ois.g_client_revenue_coefficient
        where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and is_del = 'N' and contract_type = 'AIRBAGX' and coefficient_type = 'CAPITAL_COST' and currency = 'CNY'
        ) x
    lateral view posexplode(split(space(datediff(end_date, strt_date)), ' ')) y as pos, val
    ) co_c
on co_c.busi_date = det.busi_date and info.Src_Contr_Type in ('RISKY','AIRBAGX') 
	) castTable

select    
ROW_NUMBER() over(order by tot.agt_id)  as id                  -- 主键id
,tot.stati_cont_desc                                         as contract_code             -- 内部合约编号
,tot.rela_agt_id                                             as book_id                   -- 账簿Id
,bb.Agt_Full_Name                                            as book_name                 -- 账簿
,bb.Bel_Dept                                                 as department_id             -- 部门ID
,nvl(csccv.SRC_CD_VAL,rt.Comp_Stat_Cd)                       as contract_status_cd           -- 合约状态代码
,csccv.DW_CD_DESC                                            as contract_status           -- 合约状态
,rt.Pty_Id                                                   as key_ctpty_id              -- 交易对手编号
,rcp.shor_name_ch                                            as counterparty_name         -- 交易对手名称
,rcp.idty_info_cont                                          as counterparty_uscc         -- 交易对手统一社会信用代码
,rcp.cutp_legal_enty                                         as counterparty_org          -- 交易对手所属机构
,tot.agt_id                                                  as key_otc_trade_id          -- 交易流水编号
,rt.Ext_Comp_No                                              as confirmation_no           -- 交易编号/统一合约编号
,tot.Agt_Clas_Cd                                             as business_type_cd          -- 业务类型代码
,case when bycv.dw_cd_val_desc is not null then  bycv.dw_cd_val_desc
     else tot.Agt_Clas_Cd  end                               as business_type             -- 业务类型
,rtl.Leg_Glbl_Seq_No                                         as asset_id                  -- 资产端id
,rtl.Long_Shor_Clas                                          as asset_long_short          -- 资产端多空方向
,rtl.Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd                                   as asset_type                -- 资产端类型
,rtl.Paid_Dir_Cd                                             as asset_dir_cd              -- 资产端方向代码
,pcv.dw_cd_val_desc                                          as asset_direction           -- 资产端方向名称
,rtl.Crrc_Cd                                                 as asset_underlying_ccy      -- 资产端标的币种
,rtl.Res_Flag                                                as asset_lockup_flag         -- 资产端是否限售
,null                                                        as asset_ipo_flag            -- 资产端是否为ipo
,rt.Lcrrc_Ori_Bgng_Rate                                      as asset_init_fx_to_base     -- 资产端期初汇率(兑本币)
,rt.Sett_Bgng_Rate                                           as asset_init_fx_to_settle   -- 资产端期初汇率(兑结算币种)
,rtl.Lend_Scr_Src_Type_Cd                                    as asset_stock_lend_src_type -- 资产端借券券源类型
,abe.src_prd_id                                              as asset_underlying_scr_id   -- 资产端标的源ID

and Eff_Date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
and Exp_Date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
) b
on a.Agt_Id = b.Book_Agt_Id
) bb
on tot.rela_agt_id = bb.Agt_Id
join (

from pdata_n.t03_otc_swap_comp_info        -- 103941

and BUSI_DATE='${yyyy-MM-dd}'
) rt 
on rt.Swap_Comp_Agt_Id = tot.agt_id
left join ref_counterparty rcp 
on rcp.Pty_Id = rt.Pty_Id

left join (
select *
from pdata_n.T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_LEG_INFO            -- 103942 
where SRC_TBL='ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_TRS_LEG'

on rt.Swap_Comp_Agt_Id = rtl.Swap_Comp_Agt_Id
left join asset_base_ele abe 
on rtl.Leg_Glbl_Seq_No = abe.Leg_Glbl_Seq_No
 LEFT JOIN (
          SELECT SRC_CD_VAL,DW_CD_VAL,DW_CD_DESC
            FROM PDATA_N.REF_CD_CVT_MAP
          WHERE TGT_TAB_NAME = 'T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_INFO'
             AND TGT_TAB_FLD  = 'Comp_Stat_Cd'
             AND SRC_TAB_NAME = 'REF_TRS'
             AND SRC_FLD_NAME = 'CONTR_STATUS'
             AND SRC_SYS_NAME='TIT') csccv
    ON      rt.Comp_Stat_Cd =csccv.DW_CD_VAL                  --CONTR_STATUS 转码
left join (
select dw_cd_val,dw_cd_val_desc
from pdata_n.ref_dw_cd_val b
where
SRC_TBL = 'MANU_MATN'
and upper(dw_cd_eng_name)=upper('AGT_CLAS_CD')
) bycv
on tot.Agt_Clas_Cd = bycv.dw_cd_val
left join (
SELECT upper(dw_cd_val) as dw_cd_val,dw_cd_val_desc
FROM PDATA_N.REF_DW_CD_VAL
WHERE src_tbl = 'MANU_MATN'
and upper(dw_cd_eng_name)=upper('paid_dir_cd')
) pcv
on pcv.dw_cd_val = upper(rtl.Paid_Dir_Cd)
) a

,contract_code             -- 内部合约编号
,book_id                   -- 账簿Id
,book_name                 -- 账簿
,department_id             -- 部门ID
,contract_status_cd        -- 合约状态代码
,contract_status           -- 合约状态
,key_ctpty_id              -- 交易对手编号
,counterparty_name         -- 交易对手名称
,counterparty_uscc         -- 交易对手统一社会信用代码
,counterparty_org          -- 交易对手所属机构
,key_otc_trade_id          -- 交易流水编号
,confirmation_no           -- 交易编号/统一合约编号
,business_type_cd          -- 业务类型代码
,business_type             -- 业务类型
,asset_id                  -- 资产端id
,asset_long_short          -- 资产端多空方向
,asset_type                -- 资产端类型
,asset_dir_cd              -- 资产端方向代码
,asset_direction           -- 资产端方向名称
,asset_underlying_ccy      -- 资产端标的币种
,asset_lockup_flag         -- 资产端是否限售
,asset_ipo_flag            -- 资产端是否为ipo
,asset_init_fx_to_base     -- 资产端期初汇率(兑本币)
,asset_init_fx_to_settle   -- 资产端期初汇率(兑结算币种)
,asset_stock_lend_src_type -- 资产端借券券源类型
,asset_underlying_scr_id   -- 资产端标的源ID
,asset_underlying_code     -- 资产端标的代码
,asset_underlying_name     -- 资产端标的简称
,asset_init_qty            -- 资产端标的期初数量
,asset_multiplier          -- 资产标的合约乘数
,asset_open_gross_price    -- 资产端标的开仓均价(未含费)
,asset_open_net_price      -- 资产端标的开仓净价
,asset_comm_mode_cd        -- 资产端标的客户收佣模式(开仓)/佣金模式代码
,asset_comm_mode           -- 资产端标的客户收佣模式(开仓)/佣金模式
,asset_commission_rate     -- 资产端标的开仓佣金/交易费率
,asset_init_price          -- 资产端标的期初价格
,asset_init_fx_rate        -- 资产端标的期初汇率
,asset_end_price           -- 资产端标的期末价格
,asset_current_qty         -- 资产端标的当前数量
,dynamic_notional          -- 合约名义本金
,data_time                 -- 数据时间
,busi_date                 -- 数据日期
from (
select    
ROW_NUMBER() over(order by tot.agt_id)  as id                  -- 主键id
,tot.stati_cont_desc                                         as contract_code             -- 内部合约编号
,tot.rela_agt_id                                             as book_id                   -- 账簿Id
,bb.Agt_Full_Name                                            as book_name                 -- 账簿
,bb.Bel_Dept                                                 as department_id             -- 部门ID
,nvl(csccv.SRC_CD_VAL,rt.Comp_Stat_Cd)                       as contract_status_cd           -- 合约状态代码
,csccv.DW_CD_DESC                                            as contract_status           -- 合约状态
,rt.Pty_Id                                                   as key_ctpty_id              -- 交易对手编号
,rcp.shor_name_ch                                            as counterparty_name         -- 交易对手名称
,rcp.idty_info_cont                                          as counterparty_uscc         -- 交易对手统一社会信用代码
,rcp.cutp_legal_enty                                         as counterparty_org          -- 交易对手所属机构
,tot.agt_id                                                  as key_otc_trade_id          -- 交易流水编号
,rt.Ext_Comp_No                                              as confirmation_no           -- 交易编号/统一合约编号
,tot.Agt_Clas_Cd                                             as business_type_cd          -- 业务类型代码
,case when bycv.dw_cd_val_desc is not null then  bycv.dw_cd_val_desc
     else tot.Agt_Clas_Cd  end                               as business_type             -- 业务类型
,rtl.Leg_Glbl_Seq_No                                         as asset_id                  -- 资产端id
,rtl.Long_Shor_Clas                                          as asset_long_short          -- 资产端多空方向
,rtl.Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd                                   as asset_type                -- 资产端类型
,rtl.Paid_Dir_Cd                                             as asset_dir_cd              -- 资产端方向代码
,pcv.dw_cd_val_desc                                          as asset_direction           -- 资产端方向名称
,rtl.Crrc_Cd                                                 as asset_underlying_ccy      -- 资产端标的币种
,rtl.Res_Flag                                                as asset_lockup_flag         -- 资产端是否限售
,null                                                        as asset_ipo_flag            -- 资产端是否为ipo
,rt.Lcrrc_Ori_Bgng_Rate                                      as asset_init_fx_to_base     -- 资产端期初汇率(兑本币)
,rt.Sett_Bgng_Rate                                           as asset_init_fx_to_settle   -- 资产端期初汇率(兑结算币种)
,rtl.Lend_Scr_Src_Type_Cd                                    as asset_stock_lend_src_type -- 资产端借券券源类型
,abe.src_prd_id                                              as asset_underlying_scr_id   -- 资产端标的源ID
,abe.ASSET_UNDERLYING_CODE                                   as asset_underlying_code     -- 资产端标的代码
,abe.ASSET_UNDERLYING_NAME                                   as asset_underlying_name     -- 资产端标的简称
,abe.ASSET_INIT_QTY                                          as asset_init_qty            -- 资产端标的期初数量
,abe.asset_multiplier                                        as asset_multiplier          -- 资产标的合约乘数
,abe.ASSET_OPEN_GROSS_PRICE                                  as asset_open_gross_price    -- 资产端标的开仓均价(未含费)
,abe.ASSET_OPEN_NET_PRICE                                    as asset_open_net_price      -- 资产端标的开仓净价
,abe.ASSET_COMM_MODE_CD                                      as asset_comm_mode_cd        -- 资产端标的客户收佣模式(开仓)/佣金模式代码
,abe.ASSET_COMM_MODE                                         as asset_comm_mode           -- 资产端标的客户收佣模式(开仓)/佣金模式
,abe.ASSET_COMMISSION_RATE                                   as asset_commission_rate     -- 资产端标的开仓佣金/交易费率
,abe.ASSET_INIT_PRICE                                        as asset_init_price          -- 资产端标的期初价格
,abe.ASSET_INIT_FX_RATE                                      as asset_init_fx_rate        -- 资产端标的期初汇率
,abe.ASSET_END_PRICE                                         as asset_end_price           -- 资产端标的期末价格
,abe.ASSET_CURRENT_QTY                                       as asset_current_qty         -- 资产端标的当前数量
,rt.Lcrrc_Dyna_Nom_Prin                                      as dynamic_notional          -- 合约名义本金
,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')      as data_time                 -- 数据时间
,'${yyyy-MM-dd}'                                             as busi_date                 -- 数据日期
from main_trd_otc_trade tot
JOIN (
    SELECT *
    FROM pdata_n.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_ADTNL_INFO -- 105382
    WHERE SRC_TBL = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK'
        AND BUSI_DATE = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
) rb
ON rb.Book_Agt_Id = tot.rela_agt_id
JOIN 
(
select 
a.Agt_Id,a.Agt_Full_Name,b.Bel_Dept
from (
select Agt_Id,Agt_Full_Name
from pdata_n.T03_AGT_NAME_H                  -- 106660
where SRC_TBL = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK'
and strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
and end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
) a
join (
select Book_Agt_Id,Bel_Dept
from pdata_n.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_ADTNL_INFO  --105382 
where SRC_TBL = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK'
and BUSI_DATE = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
and Eff_Date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
and Exp_Date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
) b
on a.Agt_Id = b.Book_Agt_Id
) bb
on tot.rela_agt_id = bb.Agt_Id
join (
select *, substr(Cutp_Pty_Id, 8) as Pty_Id, substr(Sler_Cutp_Pty_Id, 8) as Sler_Pty_Id
from pdata_n.t03_otc_swap_comp_info        -- 103941
where SRC_TBL='ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_TRS'
and BUSI_DATE='${yyyy-MM-dd}'
) rt 
on rt.Swap_Comp_Agt_Id = tot.agt_id
left join ref_counterparty rcp 
on rcp.Pty_Id = rt.Pty_Id

left join (
select *
from pdata_n.T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_LEG_INFO            -- 103942 
where SRC_TBL='ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_TRS_LEG'
and BUSI_DATE='${yyyy-MM-dd}'
and Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'STRUCTURE_LEG_TYPE'
) rtl
on rt.Swap_Comp_Agt_Id = rtl.Swap_Comp_Agt_Id
left join asset_base_ele abe 
on rtl.Leg_Glbl_Seq_No = abe.Leg_Glbl_Seq_No
 LEFT JOIN (
          SELECT SRC_CD_VAL,DW_CD_VAL,DW_CD_DESC
            FROM PDATA_N.REF_CD_CVT_MAP
          WHERE TGT_TAB_NAME = 'T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_INFO'
             AND TGT_TAB_FLD  = 'Comp_Stat_Cd'
             AND SRC_TAB_NAME = 'REF_TRS'
             AND SRC_FLD_NAME = 'CONTR_STATUS'
             AND SRC_SYS_NAME='TIT') csccv
    ON      rt.Comp_Stat_Cd =csccv.DW_CD_VAL                  --CONTR_STATUS 转码
left join (
select dw_cd_val,dw_cd_val_desc
from pdata_n.ref_dw_cd_val b
where
SRC_TBL = 'MANU_MATN'
and upper(dw_cd_eng_name)=upper('AGT_CLAS_CD')
) bycv
on tot.Agt_Clas_Cd = bycv.dw_cd_val
left join (
SELECT upper(dw_cd_val) as dw_cd_val,dw_cd_val_desc
FROM PDATA_N.REF_DW_CD_VAL
WHERE src_tbl = 'MANU_MATN'
and upper(dw_cd_eng_name)=upper('paid_dir_cd')
) pcv
on pcv.dw_cd_val = upper(rtl.Paid_Dir_Cd)
) a 
	) castTable

left join (
    -- ② 账簿信息：取柜台(cntr)，用于判断北上QIS
    select
      book_agt_id,
      cntr
    from
      pdata_n.t03_otc_deri_book_adtnl_info
    where
      src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK'
      and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) rb on deal.book_agt_id = rb.book_agt_id
targetRelations.fullCondition: deal.book_agt_id = rb.book_agt_id

targetRelations.sourceText:
select
  deal.opt_comp_agt_id as grp_val,
  -- 内部流水号
  'OTC_DERI_CONTR' as grp_type_code,
  -- 组合类型代码
  '${yyyy-MM-dd}' as busi_date,
  -- 业务日期
  if(
    deal.bgng_prcg_date <= '2025-03-31' -- 旧版
,
    case
      when deal.src_agt_type_cd = 'AUTOCALL'
      and deal.src_agt_sub_type_cd not in ('SNOWBALL', 'SECURED')
      and coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) in ('EQUITY', 'GDR') then 'tag074452399' -- OPTION_AUTOCALL_STOCK 自动赎回（除保本雪球和保本敲入型雪球）
      when deal.src_agt_type_cd = 'AUTOCALL'
      and deal.src_agt_sub_type_cd not in ('SNOWBALL', 'SECURED')
      and coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) not in ('EQUITY', 'GDR') then 'tag074452400' -- OPTION_AUTOCALL_NONSTOCK 自动赎回（除保本雪球和保本敲入型雪球）
      when deal.src_agt_type_cd = 'AUTOCALL'
      and deal.src_agt_sub_type_cd in ('SNOWBALL', 'SECURED') then 'tag074452401' -- OPTION_SNOWBALL_SECURED 保本雪球和保本敲入型雪球
      when deal.src_agt_type_cd = 'AIRBAG'
      and coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) in ('EQUITY', 'GDR') then 'tag074452402' -- OPTION_AIRBAG_STOCK 安全气囊
      when deal.src_agt_type_cd = 'AIRBAG'
      and coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) not in ('EQUITY', 'GDR') then 'tag074452403' -- OPTION_AIRBAG_NONSTOCK 安全气囊
      when deal.src_agt_type_cd in ('RISKY', 'AIRBAGX')
      and coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) = 'EQUITY'
      and deal.res_flag = '1' then 'tag074452404' -- OPTION_RISKY_AIRBAGX_PRI_STOCK Risky和安全气囊X（限售股）
      when deal.src_agt_type_cd in ('RISKY', 'AIRBAGX')
      and coalesce(deal.res_flag, '0') <> '1' then 'tag074452405' -- OPTION_RISKY_AIRBAGX_CIR_STOCK Risky和安全气囊X（流通股）
      when rb.cntr = 'OTCHK_QIS'
      and coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) = 'QIS'
      and regexp_replace(deal.sler_cutp_pty_id, '^TIT060-', '') = '11613' then 'tag074452406' -- OPTION_N_CROSS_QTF_STRG_IDX 北上量化策略指数期权
      when (
        deal.src_agt_type_cd not in ('AUTOCALL', 'AIRBAG', 'RISKY', 'AIRBAGX')
        or deal.src_agt_type_cd is null
      )
      and coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) in ('EQUITY', 'GDR') then 'tag074452409' -- OPTION_OTHER_STOCK 其他期权（除Risky和安全气囊X）
      when (
        deal.src_agt_type_cd not in ('AUTOCALL', 'AIRBAG', 'RISKY', 'AIRBAGX')
        or deal.src_agt_type_cd is null
      )
      and coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) not in ('EQUITY', 'GDR') then 'tag074452410' -- OPTION_OTHER_NONSTOCK 其他期权（除Risky和安全气囊X）
    end -- 新版
,
    case
      when coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) in ('EQUITY', 'GDR')
      and deal.src_agt_type_cd not in (
        'RISKY',
        'AIRBAGX',
        'AIRBAGM',
        'AIRBAGL',
        'CUSTOMISED'
      )
      and not(
        deal.src_agt_type_cd = 'AUTOCALL'
        and deal.src_agt_sub_type_cd = 'SNOWBALL'
      ) then 'tag074452411' -- OPTION_STOCK 个股期权
      when coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) in ('INDEX', 'FUND')
      and (
        deal.src_agt_type_cd in ('ACCUMULATOR', 'DECCUMULATOR', 'AIRBAG')
        or (
          deal.src_agt_type_cd = 'AUTOCALL'
          and deal.src_agt_sub_type_cd <> 'SNOWBALL'
        )
      ) then 'tag074452412' -- OPTION_IDX_ETF 指数/ETF期权
      when rb.cntr = 'OTCHK_QIS'
      and coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) = 'QIS'
      and regexp_replace(deal.sler_cutp_pty_id, '^TIT060-', '') = '11613' then 'tag074452406' -- OPTION_N_CROSS_QTF_STRG_IDX 北上量化策略指数期权
      when coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) = 'QIS'
      and deal.undrl_cd not in('GAMMA.WI', 'CHARM.WI') then 'tag074452407' -- OPTION_QTF_STRG_IDX_SPOT 量化策略指数期权（现货类）
      when coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) = 'QIS'
      and deal.undrl_cd in('GAMMA.WI', 'CHARM.WI') then 'tag074452408' -- OPTION_QTF_STRG_IDX_NONSPOT 量化策略指数期权（非现货类）
      when deal.src_agt_type_cd in ('RISKY', 'AIRBAGX')
      and coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) = 'EQUITY'
      and deal.res_flag = '1' then 'tag074452404' -- OPTION_RISKY_AIRBAGX_PRI_STOCK Risky和安全气囊X（限售股）
      when deal.src_agt_type_cd in ('RISKY', 'AIRBAGX')
      and coalesce(deal.res_flag, '0') <> '1' then 'tag074452405' -- OPTION_RISKY_AIRBAGX_CIR_STOCK Risky和安全气囊X（流通股）
      else 'tag074452413' -- OPTION_OTHER_NONSTOCK 其他期权
    end
  ) as tag_id -- 标签ID
from
  (
    -- ① 自营场外期权合约信息(汇总表)：已整合合约状态、限售标志、销售方、合约类型、标的、定价日
    select
      opt_comp_agt_id,
      comp_stat_cd,
      res_flag,
      sler_cutp_pty_id,
      book_agt_id,
      src_agt_type_cd,
      src_agt_sub_type_cd,
      undrl_cd,
      bgng_prcg_date,
      src_undrl_trd_cd as src_prd_id -- 源标的交易代码，用于关联标的基础信息
    from
      pdata_n.t98_sb_otc_opt_comp_info
    where
      src_tbl = 'PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO'
      and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
      and comp_stat_cd in (
        '101',
        -- 正常、生效
        '229',
        -- 未生效
        '226',
        -- 已终止
        '225',
        -- 待终止
        '252' -- 待审核终止
      )
  ) deal
  left join (
    -- ② 账簿信息：取柜台(cntr)，用于判断北上QIS
    select
      book_agt_id,
      cntr
    from
      pdata_n.t03_otc_deri_book_adtnl_info
    where
      src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK'
      and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) rb on deal.book_agt_id = rb.book_agt_id
  left join (
    -- ③ 标的基础信息：取标的家族(EQUITY/INDEX/QIS等)，用于合约类型判断
    select
      in_code as key_instrument_id,

    from

    where

  ) ins on ins.key_instrument_id = deal.src_prd_id
  left join (
    -- ④ 一篮子成分股家族聚合：将多个成分股家族合并，优先于单标的家族
    select
      bc.key_instrument_id,
      concat_ws(';', collect_set(ins.ins_family)) as ins_family
    from
      (
        select
          bask_secu_incd as key_instrument_id,
          bask_compnt_secu_incd as underlying_inst_id
        from
          pdata_news_n.nds_ref_basket_constituent
        where
          busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
          and src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BASKET_CONSTITUENT'
      ) bc
      left join (
        select

          scr_type_src as ins_family
        from

        where
          src_id = 'TIT'
          and grp_id = '01'
      ) ins on ins.key_instrument_id = bc.underlying_inst_id
    group by

  ) bc on bc.key_instrument_id = deal.src_prd_id
