select
  rt.swap_comp_agt_id as grp_val,
  -- 互换合约协议编号
  'OTC_DERI_CONTR' as grp_type_code,
  -- 组合类型代码
  '${yyyy-MM-dd}' as busi_date,
  -- 业务日期
  if(
    rt.strt_pric_date <= '2025-03-31' -- 旧版
,
    case
      when rb.bel_dept = 'OTC_HK'
      and rt.swap_type_cd = 'CROSS_LEND_SWAP' then 'tag074452414' -- TRS_CROSS_LEND_SWAP 跨境借券
      when rb.bel_dept = 'OTC_HK'
      and rt.swap_type_cd = 'HK_LONG_HOLD_SWAP' then 'tag074452415' -- TRS_HK_LONG_HOLD_SWAP 香港多头持券
      when rb.bel_dept = 'OTC_HK'
      and rt.swap_type_cd = 'N_CROSS_FUTURE_SWAP' then 'tag074452416' -- TRS_N_CROSS_FUTURE_SWAP 北上跨境（期货）
      when rb.bel_dept = 'OTC_HK'
      and rt.swap_type_cd = 'N_CROSS_QFII_SWAP' then 'tag074452417' -- TRS_N_CROSS_QFII_SWAP 北上QFII
      when rt.swap_type_cd = 'N_CROSS_SWAP' then 'tag074452418' -- TRS_N_STOCK 北上A股
      when rt.swap_type_cd in ('CALL_SWAP', 'PUT_SWAP') then 'tag074452419' -- TRS_LONG_SHORT 多空互换
      when rt.swap_type_cd = 'S_CROSS_FUTURE_SWAP' then 'tag074452420' -- TRS_S_CROSS_FUTURES 南下期货
      when rt.swap_type_cd = 'S_CROSS_SWAP'
      and his_ini.ins_family = 'BOND' then 'tag074452421' -- TRS_S_CROSS_BOND 南下债券
      when rt.swap_type_cd = 'S_CROSS_SWAP'
      and his_ini.ins_family in ('EQUITY', 'GDR')
      and his_ini.currency != 'CNY'
      and rtl.ipo_type = 'Y' then 'tag074452422' -- TRS_S_IPO 南下IPO
      when rt.swap_type_cd = 'S_CROSS_SWAP'
      and his_ini.ins_family in ('EQUITY', 'GDR')
      and his_ini.currency != 'CNY'
      and (
        rtl.ipo_type = 'N'
        or rtl.ipo_type is null
      )
      and rtl.private_placement = 'Y' then 'tag074452432' -- TRS_S_STOCK_LIMITED 南下跨境互换（限售股）
      when rt.swap_type_cd = 'S_CROSS_SWAP'
      and his_ini.ins_family in ('EQUITY', 'GDR')
      and his_ini.currency = 'HKD'
      and (
        rtl.ipo_type = 'N'
        or rtl.ipo_type is null
      )
      and (
        rtl.private_placement = 'N'
        or rtl.private_placement is null
      ) then 'tag074452433' -- TRS_S_CROSS_HK 南下跨境港股
      when rt.swap_type_cd = 'S_CROSS_SWAP'
      and his_ini.ins_family in ('EQUITY', 'GDR')
      and his_ini.currency not in ('HKD', 'CNY')
      and (
        rtl.ipo_type = 'N'
        or rtl.ipo_type is null
      )
      and (
        rtl.private_placement = 'N'
        or rtl.private_placement is null
      ) then 'tag074452434' -- TRS_S_CROSS_OTHER 南下跨境-其他股票市场
      when rb.bel_co = 'GFS_HK'
      and rt.swap_type_cd = 'FEE_SWAP'
      and rt.contract_use = 'REBATE_INTEREST' then 'tag074452426' -- FEE_SWAP_HK 费用合约
      when rb.bel_co = 'GFS_HK'
      and rt.swap_type_cd = 'INDEX_ENHANCE_SWAP' then 'tag074452427' -- TRS_N_CROSS_INDEX_ENHANCE 北上指数增强
      else 'tag074452428' -- TRS_OTHER_SWAP 其它互换类型
    end -- 新版
,
    case
      when rt.swap_type_cd = 'LEND_SWAP'
      and his_ini.ins_family in ('EQUITY', 'GDR') then 'tag074452429' -- TRS_SHORT_SELL 借券互换
      when his_ini.ins_family = 'QIS' then 'tag074452430' -- TRS_S_CROSS_QTF_STRG_IDX 南下量化策略指数互换
      when rt.swap_type_cd = 'S_CROSS_FUTURE_SWAP' then 'tag074452420' -- TRS_S_CROSS_FUTURES 南下期货
      when rt.swap_type_cd in ('S_CROSS_SWAP', 'S_CROSS_OPTION_SWAP')
      and his_ini.ins_family in ('EQUITY', 'GDR')
      and his_ini.currency != 'CNY'
      and rtl.ipo_type = 'Y' then 'tag074452422' -- TRS_S_IPO 南下IPO
      when rt.swap_type_cd in ('S_CROSS_SWAP', 'S_CROSS_OPTION_SWAP')
      and his_ini.ins_family in ('EQUITY', 'GDR')
      and (
        rtl.ipo_type = 'N'
        or rtl.ipo_type is null
      ) then 'tag074452431' -- TRS_S_CROSS_STOCK 南下跨境股票
      when rb.bel_co = 'GFS_HK'
      and rt.swap_type_cd = 'INDEX_ENHANCE_SWAP' then 'tag074452427' -- TRS_N_CROSS_INDEX_ENHANCE 北上指数增强
      else 'tag074452428' -- TRS_OTHER_SWAP 其它互换类型
    end
  ) as tag_id -- 标签ID
from
  (
    -- ① 互换合约信息：提供合约状态、互换类型、期初定价日、合约用途（仅常速互换）
    select
      rt.swap_comp_agt_id,
      rt.comp_stat_cd,
      rt.swap_type_cd,
      rt.strt_pric_date,
      rt.book_agt_id,
      t3.comp_usag_cd as contract_use
    from
      pdata_n.t98_sb_otc_swap_comp_info rt
      left join (
        select
          swap_comp_agt_id,
          comp_usag_cd
        from
          pdata_n.t03_otc_swap_comp_info
        where
          src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_TRS'
          and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
      ) t3 on rt.swap_comp_agt_id = t3.swap_comp_agt_id
    where
      rt.busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
      and rt.swap_comp_subdv_cd = 'NORM_SWAP' -- 常速互换 ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_TRS
      and rt.comp_stat_cd in (
        '101',
        -- 正常、生效
        '229',
        -- 未生效
        '226',
        -- 已终止
        '225',
        -- 待终止
        '252' -- 待审核终止
      )
  ) rt
  inner join (
    -- ② 账簿信息：取所属部门(bel_dept)和公司(bel_co)，用于判断OTC_HK/GFS_HK
    select
      book_agt_id,
      bel_dept,
      bel_co
    from
      pdata_n.t03_otc_deri_book_adtnl_info
    where
      src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK'
      and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) rb on rt.book_agt_id = rb.book_agt_id
  left join (
    -- ③ 互换合约交易标的信息：取标的家族(Src_Scr_Type_Cd)、币种(Crrc_Cd)、限售标志(Res_Flag)
    select
      swap_comp_agt_id,
      src_scr_type_cd as ins_family,
      crrc_cd as currency,
      res_flag as private_placement
    from
      pdata_n.t98_otc_swap_comp_trd_undrl_info
    where
      busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) his_ini on rt.swap_comp_agt_id = his_ini.swap_comp_agt_id
  left join (
    -- ④ 互换腿信息：取ipo_type(Res_Type)、private_placement(Res_Flag)
    select
      swap_comp_agt_id,
      res_type as ipo_type,
      case
        when res_flag = '1' then 'Y'
        when res_flag = '0' then 'N'
        else res_flag
      end as private_placement
    from
      pdata_n.t03_otc_swap_comp_leg_info
    where

select
  rt.swap_comp_agt_id as grp_val,
  -- 互换合约协议编号
  'OTC_DERI_CONTR' as grp_type_code,
  -- 组合类型代码
  '${yyyy-MM-dd}' as busi_date,
  -- 业务日期
  if(
    rt.strt_pric_date <= '2025-03-31' -- 旧版
,
    case
      when rb.bel_dept = 'OTC_HK'
      and rt.swap_type_cd = 'CROSS_LEND_SWAP' then 'tag074452414' -- TRS_CROSS_LEND_SWAP 跨境借券
      when rb.bel_dept = 'OTC_HK'
      and rt.swap_type_cd = 'HK_LONG_HOLD_SWAP' then 'tag074452415' -- TRS_HK_LONG_HOLD_SWAP 香港多头持券
      when rb.bel_dept = 'OTC_HK'
      and rt.swap_type_cd = 'N_CROSS_FUTURE_SWAP' then 'tag074452416' -- TRS_N_CROSS_FUTURE_SWAP 北上跨境（期货）
      when rb.bel_dept = 'OTC_HK'
      and rt.swap_type_cd = 'N_CROSS_QFII_SWAP' then 'tag074452417' -- TRS_N_CROSS_QFII_SWAP 北上QFII
      when rt.swap_type_cd = 'N_CROSS_SWAP' then 'tag074452418' -- TRS_N_STOCK 北上A股
      when rt.swap_type_cd in ('CALL_SWAP', 'PUT_SWAP') then 'tag074452419' -- TRS_LONG_SHORT 多空互换
      when rt.swap_type_cd = 'S_CROSS_FUTURE_SWAP' then 'tag074452420' -- TRS_S_CROSS_FUTURES 南下期货
      when rt.swap_type_cd = 'S_CROSS_SWAP'
      and his_ini.ins_family = 'BOND' then 'tag074452421' -- TRS_S_CROSS_BOND 南下债券
      when rt.swap_type_cd = 'S_CROSS_SWAP'
      and his_ini.ins_family in ('EQUITY', 'GDR')
      and his_ini.currency != 'CNY'
      and rtl.ipo_type = 'Y' then 'tag074452422' -- TRS_S_IPO 南下IPO
      when rt.swap_type_cd = 'S_CROSS_SWAP'
      and his_ini.ins_family in ('EQUITY', 'GDR')
      and his_ini.currency != 'CNY'
      and (
        rtl.ipo_type = 'N'
        or rtl.ipo_type is null
      )
      and rtl.private_placement = 'Y' then 'tag074452432' -- TRS_S_STOCK_LIMITED 南下跨境互换（限售股）
      when rt.swap_type_cd = 'S_CROSS_SWAP'
      and his_ini.ins_family in ('EQUITY', 'GDR')
      and his_ini.currency = 'HKD'
      and (
        rtl.ipo_type = 'N'
        or rtl.ipo_type is null
      )
      and (
        rtl.private_placement = 'N'
        or rtl.private_placement is null
      ) then 'tag074452433' -- TRS_S_CROSS_HK 南下跨境港股
      when rt.swap_type_cd = 'S_CROSS_SWAP'
      and his_ini.ins_family in ('EQUITY', 'GDR')
      and his_ini.currency not in ('HKD', 'CNY')
      and (
        rtl.ipo_type = 'N'
        or rtl.ipo_type is null
      )
      and (
        rtl.private_placement = 'N'
        or rtl.private_placement is null
      ) then 'tag074452434' -- TRS_S_CROSS_OTHER 南下跨境-其他股票市场
      when rb.bel_co = 'GFS_HK'
      and rt.swap_type_cd = 'FEE_SWAP'
      and rt.contract_use = 'REBATE_INTEREST' then 'tag074452426' -- FEE_SWAP_HK 费用合约
      when rb.bel_co = 'GFS_HK'
      and rt.swap_type_cd = 'INDEX_ENHANCE_SWAP' then 'tag074452427' -- TRS_N_CROSS_INDEX_ENHANCE 北上指数增强
      else 'tag074452428' -- TRS_OTHER_SWAP 其它互换类型
    end -- 新版
,
    case
      when rt.swap_type_cd = 'LEND_SWAP'
      and his_ini.ins_family in ('EQUITY', 'GDR') then 'tag074452429' -- TRS_SHORT_SELL 借券互换
      when his_ini.ins_family = 'QIS' then 'tag074452430' -- TRS_S_CROSS_QTF_STRG_IDX 南下量化策略指数互换
      when rt.swap_type_cd = 'S_CROSS_FUTURE_SWAP' then 'tag074452420' -- TRS_S_CROSS_FUTURES 南下期货
      when rt.swap_type_cd in ('S_CROSS_SWAP', 'S_CROSS_OPTION_SWAP')
      and his_ini.ins_family in ('EQUITY', 'GDR')
      and his_ini.currency != 'CNY'
      and rtl.ipo_type = 'Y' then 'tag074452422' -- TRS_S_IPO 南下IPO
      when rt.swap_type_cd in ('S_CROSS_SWAP', 'S_CROSS_OPTION_SWAP')
      and his_ini.ins_family in ('EQUITY', 'GDR')
      and (
        rtl.ipo_type = 'N'
        or rtl.ipo_type is null
      ) then 'tag074452431' -- TRS_S_CROSS_STOCK 南下跨境股票
      when rb.bel_co = 'GFS_HK'
      and rt.swap_type_cd = 'INDEX_ENHANCE_SWAP' then 'tag074452427' -- TRS_N_CROSS_INDEX_ENHANCE 北上指数增强
      else 'tag074452428' -- TRS_OTHER_SWAP 其它互换类型
    end
  ) as tag_id -- 标签ID
from
  (
    -- ① 互换合约信息：提供合约状态、互换类型、期初定价日、合约用途（仅常速互换）
    select
      rt.swap_comp_agt_id,
      rt.comp_stat_cd,
      rt.swap_type_cd,
      rt.strt_pric_date,
      rt.book_agt_id,
      t3.comp_usag_cd as contract_use
    from
      pdata_n.t98_sb_otc_swap_comp_info rt
      left join (
        select
          swap_comp_agt_id,
          comp_usag_cd
        from
          pdata_n.t03_otc_swap_comp_info
        where
          src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_TRS'
          and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
      ) t3 on rt.swap_comp_agt_id = t3.swap_comp_agt_id
    where
      rt.busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
      and rt.swap_comp_subdv_cd = 'NORM_SWAP' -- 常速互换 ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_TRS
      and rt.comp_stat_cd in (
        '101',
        -- 正常、生效
        '229',
        -- 未生效
        '226',
        -- 已终止
        '225',
        -- 待终止
        '252' -- 待审核终止
      )
  ) rt
  inner join (
    -- ② 账簿信息：取所属部门(bel_dept)和公司(bel_co)，用于判断OTC_HK/GFS_HK
    select
      book_agt_id,
      bel_dept,
      bel_co
    from
      pdata_n.t03_otc_deri_book_adtnl_info
    where
      src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK'
      and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) rb on rt.book_agt_id = rb.book_agt_id
  left join (
    -- ③ 互换合约交易标的信息：取标的家族(Src_Scr_Type_Cd)、币种(Crrc_Cd)、限售标志(Res_Flag)
    select
      swap_comp_agt_id,
      src_scr_type_cd as ins_family,
      crrc_cd as currency,
      res_flag as private_placement
    from
      pdata_n.t98_otc_swap_comp_trd_undrl_info
    where
      busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) his_ini on rt.swap_comp_agt_id = his_ini.swap_comp_agt_id
  left join (
    -- ④ 互换腿信息：取ipo_type(Res_Type)、private_placement(Res_Flag)
    select
      swap_comp_agt_id,
      res_type as ipo_type,
      case
        when res_flag = '1' then 'Y'
        when res_flag = '0' then 'N'
        else res_flag
      end as private_placement
    from
      pdata_n.t03_otc_swap_comp_leg_info
    where
      src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_TRS_LEG'
      and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
      and swap_comp_leg_type_cd = 'STRUCTURE_LEG_TYPE'
  ) rtl on rt.swap_comp_agt_id = rtl.swap_comp_agt_id

      when deal.src_agt_type_cd = 'AUTOCALL'
      and deal.src_agt_sub_type_cd in ('SNOWBALL', 'SECURED') then 'tag074452401' -- OPTION_SNOWBALL_SECURED 保本雪球和保本敲入型雪球
      when deal.src_agt_type_cd = 'AIRBAG'
      and coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) in ('EQUITY', 'GDR') then 'tag074452402' -- OPTION_AIRBAG_STOCK 安全气囊
      when deal.src_agt_type_cd = 'AIRBAG'
      and coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) not in ('EQUITY', 'GDR') then 'tag074452403' -- OPTION_AIRBAG_NONSTOCK 安全气囊
      when deal.src_agt_type_cd in ('RISKY', 'AIRBAGX')
      and coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) = 'EQUITY'
      and deal.res_flag = '1' then 'tag074452404' -- OPTION_RISKY_AIRBAGX_PRI_STOCK Risky和安全气囊X（限售股）
      when deal.src_agt_type_cd in ('RISKY', 'AIRBAGX')
      and coalesce(deal.res_flag, '0') <> '1' then 'tag074452405' -- OPTION_RISKY_AIRBAGX_CIR_STOCK Risky和安全气囊X（流通股）
      when rb.cntr = 'OTCHK_QIS'
      and coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) = 'QIS'
      and regexp_replace(deal.sler_cutp_pty_id, '^TIT060-', '') = '11613' then 'tag074452406' -- OPTION_N_CROSS_QTF_STRG_IDX 北上量化策略指数期权
      when (
        deal.src_agt_type_cd not in ('AUTOCALL', 'AIRBAG', 'RISKY', 'AIRBAGX')
        or deal.src_agt_type_cd is null
      )
      and coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) in ('EQUITY', 'GDR') then 'tag074452409' -- OPTION_OTHER_STOCK 其他期权（除Risky和安全气囊X）
      when (
        deal.src_agt_type_cd not in ('AUTOCALL', 'AIRBAG', 'RISKY', 'AIRBAGX')
        or deal.src_agt_type_cd is null
      )
      and coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) not in ('EQUITY', 'GDR') then 'tag074452410' -- OPTION_OTHER_NONSTOCK 其他期权（除Risky和安全气囊X）
    end -- 新版
,
    case
      when coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) in ('EQUITY', 'GDR')
      and deal.src_agt_type_cd not in (
        'RISKY',
        'AIRBAGX',
        'AIRBAGM',
        'AIRBAGL',
        'CUSTOMISED'
      )
      and not(
        deal.src_agt_type_cd = 'AUTOCALL'
        and deal.src_agt_sub_type_cd = 'SNOWBALL'
      ) then 'tag074452411' -- OPTION_STOCK 个股期权
      when coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) in ('INDEX', 'FUND')
      and (
        deal.src_agt_type_cd in ('ACCUMULATOR', 'DECCUMULATOR', 'AIRBAG')
        or (
          deal.src_agt_type_cd = 'AUTOCALL'
          and deal.src_agt_sub_type_cd <> 'SNOWBALL'
        )
      ) then 'tag074452412' -- OPTION_IDX_ETF 指数/ETF期权
      when rb.cntr = 'OTCHK_QIS'
      and coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) = 'QIS'
      and regexp_replace(deal.sler_cutp_pty_id, '^TIT060-', '') = '11613' then 'tag074452406' -- OPTION_N_CROSS_QTF_STRG_IDX 北上量化策略指数期权
      when coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) = 'QIS'
      and deal.undrl_cd not in('GAMMA.WI', 'CHARM.WI') then 'tag074452407' -- OPTION_QTF_STRG_IDX_SPOT 量化策略指数期权（现货类）
      when coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) = 'QIS'
      and deal.undrl_cd in('GAMMA.WI', 'CHARM.WI') then 'tag074452408' -- OPTION_QTF_STRG_IDX_NONSPOT 量化策略指数期权（非现货类）
      when deal.src_agt_type_cd in ('RISKY', 'AIRBAGX')
      and coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) = 'EQUITY'
      and deal.res_flag = '1' then 'tag074452404' -- OPTION_RISKY_AIRBAGX_PRI_STOCK Risky和安全气囊X（限售股）
      when deal.src_agt_type_cd in ('RISKY', 'AIRBAGX')
      and coalesce(deal.res_flag, '0') <> '1' then 'tag074452405' -- OPTION_RISKY_AIRBAGX_CIR_STOCK Risky和安全气囊X（流通股）
      else 'tag074452413' -- OPTION_OTHER_NONSTOCK 其他期权
    end
  ) as tag_id

      and coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) in ('EQUITY', 'GDR') then 'tag074452402' -- OPTION_AIRBAG_STOCK 安全气囊
      when deal.src_agt_type_cd = 'AIRBAG'
      and coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) not in ('EQUITY', 'GDR') then 'tag074452403' -- OPTION_AIRBAG_NONSTOCK 安全气囊
      when deal.src_agt_type_cd in ('RISKY', 'AIRBAGX')
      and coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) = 'EQUITY'
      and deal.res_flag = '1' then 'tag074452404' -- OPTION_RISKY_AIRBAGX_PRI_STOCK Risky和安全气囊X（限售股）
      when deal.src_agt_type_cd in ('RISKY', 'AIRBAGX')
      and coalesce(deal.res_flag, '0') <> '1' then 'tag074452405' -- OPTION_RISKY_AIRBAGX_CIR_STOCK Risky和安全气囊X（流通股）
      when rb.cntr = 'OTCHK_QIS'
      and coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) = 'QIS'
      and regexp_replace(deal.sler_cutp_pty_id, '^TIT060-', '') = '11613' then 'tag074452406' -- OPTION_N_CROSS_QTF_STRG_IDX 北上量化策略指数期权
      when (
        deal.src_agt_type_cd not in ('AUTOCALL', 'AIRBAG', 'RISKY', 'AIRBAGX')
        or deal.src_agt_type_cd is null
      )
      and coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) in ('EQUITY', 'GDR') then 'tag074452409' -- OPTION_OTHER_STOCK 其他期权（除Risky和安全气囊X）
      when (
        deal.src_agt_type_cd not in ('AUTOCALL', 'AIRBAG', 'RISKY', 'AIRBAGX')
        or deal.src_agt_type_cd is null
      )
      and coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) not in ('EQUITY', 'GDR') then 'tag074452410' -- OPTION_OTHER_NONSTOCK 其他期权（除Risky和安全气囊X）
    end -- 新版
,
    case
      when coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) in ('EQUITY', 'GDR')
      and deal.src_agt_type_cd not in (
        'RISKY',
        'AIRBAGX',
        'AIRBAGM',
        'AIRBAGL',
        'CUSTOMISED'
      )
      and not(
        deal.src_agt_type_cd = 'AUTOCALL'
        and deal.src_agt_sub_type_cd = 'SNOWBALL'
      ) then 'tag074452411' -- OPTION_STOCK 个股期权
      when coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) in ('INDEX', 'FUND')
      and (
        deal.src_agt_type_cd in ('ACCUMULATOR', 'DECCUMULATOR', 'AIRBAG')
        or (
          deal.src_agt_type_cd = 'AUTOCALL'
          and deal.src_agt_sub_type_cd <> 'SNOWBALL'
        )
      ) then 'tag074452412' -- OPTION_IDX_ETF 指数/ETF期权
      when rb.cntr = 'OTCHK_QIS'
      and coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) = 'QIS'
      and regexp_replace(deal.sler_cutp_pty_id, '^TIT060-', '') = '11613' then 'tag074452406' -- OPTION_N_CROSS_QTF_STRG_IDX 北上量化策略指数期权
      when coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) = 'QIS'
      and deal.undrl_cd not in('GAMMA.WI', 'CHARM.WI') then 'tag074452407' -- OPTION_QTF_STRG_IDX_SPOT 量化策略指数期权（现货类）
      when coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) = 'QIS'
      and deal.undrl_cd in('GAMMA.WI', 'CHARM.WI') then 'tag074452408' -- OPTION_QTF_STRG_IDX_NONSPOT 量化策略指数期权（非现货类）
      when deal.src_agt_type_cd in ('RISKY', 'AIRBAGX')
      and coalesce(bc.ins_family, ins.ins_family) = 'EQUITY'
      and deal.res_flag = '1' then 'tag074452404' -- OPTION_RISKY_AIRBAGX_PRI_STOCK Risky和安全气囊X（限售股）
      when deal.src_agt_type_cd in ('RISKY', 'AIRBAGX')
      and coalesce(deal.res_flag, '0') <> '1' then 'tag074452405' -- OPTION_RISKY_AIRBAGX_CIR_STOCK Risky和安全气囊X（流通股）
      else 'tag074452413' -- OPTION_OTHER_NONSTOCK 其他期权
    end
  ) as tag_id

businessInterpretation.summary: 以GFS_FICC账簿快照为驱动，输出有效期、柜台、部门、公司、开关和映射Wind代码；再补账簿名称、持有人交易对手ID及柜台中文名。
businessInterpretation.differences: 不同于145871，它限定GFS_FICC并额外解释柜台代码；不同于只做资格筛选的FICC模式，它把大量账簿属性写入结果。

questions: 账簿、名称、持有人、代码表各自唯一性
Map_Undrl_Cd的治理含义和稳定性

targetRelations.sourceText:
select 
         Book_Agt_Id            as key_book_id
        ,Eff_Date               as valid_startdate
        ,Exp_Date               as valid_enddate
        ,Cntr                   as desk
        ,Bel_Dept               as department
        ,Bel_Co                 as company
        ,Ost_Otc_Ind            as market_type
        ,Rep_Fin_Flag           as enable_financial
        ,Rep_Risk_Flag          as enable_risk
        ,Enable_Trd_Cfm_Flag    as enable_confirmation
        ,Enable_Sett_Ntfc_Flag  as enable_settlement
        ,Enable_Scdtm_Revw_Flag as enable_repeat_check
        ,Enable_Rgst_Flag       as enable_report
        ,Enable_Ast_Module_Flag as enable_capital
        ,Enable_Risk_Qta_Flag   as enable_limit
        ,Remark                 as description
        ,Map_Undrl_Cd           as mapping_wind_code
        ,busi_date 
    from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_ADTNL_INFO    -- 105382
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK'
      and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
      and Bel_Dept = 'GFS_FICC'
